videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When actor Ritika gets a renewed threat from her stalker, Milan, she reaches out to EYES, a team specifically devoted to protecting victims of stalkers. She is disappointed to know that the team that had made her feel protected was no longer operational.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After helping the police to successfully nab Milan, EYES is persuaded to restart their mission. The team first has to confront the reality of the case that had caused them to falter the first time – the case of Varsha and Hemant.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Having restarted their work in protecting victims and helping stalkers overcome their issues, the EYES team has to go back to their old cases and make up for any lapses in their understanding – for instance, Sajin Zachariah’s side of the story his wife has said about him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As a team of mental health professionals working side by side with the police, the EYES team has to be sure of the truth of a story before they can help the victim or the stalker. In some cases, like the one between Sajin and Shobhita, the truth is not what it seems at first glance.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Unexpected setbacks from within and outside the team lead EYES to once again question what they are doing and why. But they know there is only one way to go – forward.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A team member’s actions puts the fate of EYES in jeopardy. Another’s doubt proves vital in setting a wrong right. Slowly but surely, the team moves closer to its goals.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When the protectors turn the hunted and long-hidden truths emerge, Team EYES proves beyond doubt that the mission is safe in their hands.

videos.title: The Dreamer
videos.overview: Bitten by the movie bug, Firoz dreams of becoming a film actor. Till then he makes do with album-song shoots. During a 90th birthday celebration, he gets an opportunity.

videos.title: The Hero, The Villain
videos.overview: Firoz arrives at the film shoot with his friends and asks the director for a chance. Will Firoz's dreams finally come true?

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Mammali gives Firoz an ultimatum that he better marry his friend's daughter and live according to him. But Firoz has another trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: First Sight
videos.overview: Firoz is shocked by the surprise Mammali had in store for him at the house. His mother, worried about him, recruits his friends to help him find a girl to fall in love with.

videos.title: The Wrong Salma
videos.overview: Firoz is absolutely enthralled by Salma, for all the wrong reasons. Meanwhile, Ali becomes a stumbling block in Midukkan and Charlie's plan, and he sends them to the wrong house.

videos.title: The Plan is On
videos.overview: Midukkan and Charlie try their best to get Firoz to "run into" Salma. However, Salma and her friends find such serendipity suspicious.

videos.title: The Deal
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends bribe Ali to make him work for them in their plan to woo Salma. Will Ali genuinely help Firoz, or will he take him on a merry ride?

videos.title: The Bus Ride
videos.overview: Firoz desperately follows Salma onto a bus but, instead of getting in, ends up clinging to it outside. Just then, Mammali and Sainaba spot him.

videos.title: Too Late
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends visit Salma’s house with a marriage proposal. However, Firoz is heartbroken when he learns that Salma’s wedding has already been fixed with Thaju.

videos.title: Operation Thajudeen
videos.overview: Firoz's mother investigates whether Thaju, the man whose marriage to Salma has been arranged, has another love interest. How will Firoz's friends help him?

videos.title: The New Girl
videos.overview: Ali tells Mammali that it was Firoz who brought Sneha to make Thaju fall in love with her. Sneha and Thaju become acquainted and their relationship begins to grow.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Mammali hides Sneha after she arrives at his house. Seeing this, his wife Sainaba becomes suspicious that something is going on.

videos.title: The Birthday Trap
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends learn from Salma's friends that it is her birthday. They plan to trick Mammali and buy a ring for Salma.

videos.title: The Ring
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends finally realise which Salma's family they've been chasing so far. Infuriated, they call Ali and find out something that increases their anger.

videos.title: Five Lakhs
videos.overview: At the police station, Firoz promises to pay ₹5 lakh that Thajudeen claims to have lost. Grandma assures Firoz that if Salma accepts the ring, she will fall for him.

videos.title: Love or Cinema?
videos.overview: At the coffee shop, Salma finally openly confesses her love to Firoz. However, Mammali gives Firoz an ultimatum.

videos.title: The Double Dream
videos.overview: After Salma says yes to Firoz, he worries that choosing her means giving up his dream. Seeing Firoz caught between love and cinema, Charlie and Midukkan come up with a plan.

videos.title: The Unexpected Boyfriend
videos.overview: Firoz, Charlie and Midukkan head to the hospital to meet Aliya and threaten her. However, Firoz faces a dire situation and an unpleasant surprise.

videos.title: A New Agreement
videos.overview: Following Firoz's plan, Aliya agrees to get engaged within a month and marry after a year. When he decides to tell Salma everything, his friends warn him.

videos.title: The Fake Engagement
videos.overview: While Firoz produces an album for Salma, he and Aliya go through with their fake engagement. Everything goes according to plan until an uninvited guest crashes the ceremony.

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: On the eve of Manu's wedding with Veena, he and Diya decide to elope with the help of their four close confidante cousins.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: At Manu’s wedding, the cousins search for a missing Diya. She arrives and kisses Manu on stage, shocking the families and creating chaos at the wedding, revealing hidden history.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: The cousins reunite at another wedding after ten years. Though Manu feels out of place, the others pull him back into the group and slowly try to rebuild their frayed bond.

videos.title: The Beach Story
videos.overview: Manu insists Diya show him the beach. A casual beach outing turns dangerous when Manu nearly drowns, and Diya is forced to rescue him.

videos.title: Ashwathy's CD
videos.overview: Ashwathy gets a mysterious CD that sparks Diya's curiosity. What begins as a secret plan to watch it alone creates chaos when the cousins find out, turning into a comic showdown.

videos.title: The Hard Goodbye
videos.overview: As the wedding celebrations end, the cousins face an emotional goodbye. Manu's attempt to confess his feelings to Diya goes awry, leaving them to part ways on uncertain terms.

videos.title: Four Years Later
videos.overview: At another wedding, adulthood reshapes identities. Old feelings resurface when Manu meets Diya again. New rival Prajith enters, determined to impress her and disrupt emotions.

videos.title: Disco Diya
videos.overview: A playful mishap sparks old childhood memories. As Prajith boldly pursues Diya, Manu finds himself torn between confidence and self-doubt over his feelings.

videos.title: The Family Video
videos.overview: The cousins collaborate on a wedding video project. Prajith manipulates the elders to present himself as Diya’s ideal match, intensifying rivalry as Manu silently grows uneasy.

videos.title: Onam Games
videos.overview: Festive games revive childhood chemistry. Prajith tries to impress Diya but fails when he cheats. Manu’s calm composure earns Diya’s admiration, melting the emotional distance.

videos.title: Marriage Talks
videos.overview: The elders subtly push Prajith as Diya’s groom. Family interviews unexpectedly expose old property disputes, revealing unresolved generational tensions beneath celebrations.

videos.title: Old Photos
videos.overview: Family conflicts escalate but resolve through emotional conversations. Manu and Diya share an honest discussion about life, marking a turning point in emotional openness.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: While Sanskriti seeks answers about Manu, Prajith tries to open up to Diya about his feelings. Will their search for the truth bring them closer or strain their relationships?

videos.title: The Roast Disaster
videos.overview: After Prajith hacks Chandu's computer, a roast video plays during the wedding, sparking a major family feud. As tensions rise, Megha boldly confronts the elders.

videos.title: Silent Rift
videos.overview: Chandu and Ashwathy clash over personal matters, driving a wedge between them. On the other hand, Manu is disheartened when he notices Prajith and Diya together.

videos.title: Confession Plan
videos.overview: Manu's plans to confess his love take a dramatic turn when Diya uncovers the truth about the two-timing. Elsewhere, Nima is left shaken after learning the truth about Chandu.

videos.title: Cousins Who Meet at Weddings
videos.overview: Diya tells Manu they should stay like cousins who meet at weddings. The fractured group drifts apart, but Chandu comforts Manu, promising things will mend by the next wedding

videos.title: The Problem Wedding
videos.overview: The cousins return for the next wedding, older now and carrying the weight of things life has taught them. But, this gathering feels different, a threat looms over the celebration.

videos.title: Old Wounds, New Love
videos.overview: Manu's old wounds with his mother reopen as she arrives for the wedding. Meanwhile, Diya stays glued to her phone with Jay, her new lover, as Manu watches in silence.

videos.title: Love Coach Chandu
videos.overview: Manu can't bear losing Diya. Chandu steps in as his love coach, training him Chandu-style to win her back. Meanwhile Prajith returns and is back to his old antics.

videos.title: Two Slaps and a Brawl
videos.overview: Chandu's coaching backfires. At the mall, Megha slaps Joshy for harassing the girls. When Manu defends Megha, his mother slaps him to avoid another family rift, and he storms out.

videos.title: The Walk Back
videos.overview: Diya finds Manu alone at a shop. When he opens up about his loneliness and beliefs in marriage, she silences a call from Jay. They share a tender evening under the stars.

videos.title: Unsettled
videos.overview: While Manu and Diya find a new rhythm, Megha drifts away from the cousins, as she gets blamed for Manu's walkout. Meanwhile, the antagonists quietly regroup to stop the wedding.

videos.title: In Her Defence
videos.overview: Diya defends Ashwathy when a relative's wedding proposal sparks a sharp remark from her. Meanwhile, Chandu falls for Roshini, and Megha quietly makes peace.

videos.title: Highs and Loss
videos.overview: A surprise terrace party leads to emotional confessions while Manu and Chandu dodge chores. Things take an unexpected turn when an intoxicated Diya pulls Manu towards her.

videos.title: A Ride to Remember
videos.overview: Diya persuades Manu to take her to Nakshathra Thadakam. Amidst an exchange of heartfelt conversations, Manu is suddenly jolted by an unexpected call from Sanoop.

videos.title: Police Chaos
videos.overview: Diya and Manu engage in a deep conversation about Manu's family. Tensions rise as Chandu's group and the groom set to marry the next morning are arrested for drunk driving.

videos.title: D-Day Duels
videos.overview: Fun chaos breaks at the registrar office on the wedding day while Manu teases Diya that she said she likes him. Chandu then learns a shocking revelation about the girl he likes.

videos.title: Wedding Night
videos.overview: The roadblock turns into a celebratory convoy of relatives. Sanoop's first-night preparations descend into hilarious chaos as his cousins relentlessly tease him.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: As Sanoop's wedding celebrations wind down, everyone begins to leave. At the bus stand, Manu finally confesses his feelings to Diya, but she rejects him in favour of Jay.

videos.title: End of Days and Rays of Hope
videos.overview: Prajith is preparing to get married but faces a significant challenge, Covid. Despite the restrictions, guests arrive to celebrate him while following safety precautions.

videos.title: Social Distancing
videos.overview: Prajith's lockdown wedding spirals into socially distanced chaos and masked photos. Just as Manu plans an early escape, an unexpected twist gives him a reason to stay.

videos.title: Quarantine 'Tharavadu'
videos.overview: Locked in the ancestral house, the cousins turn quarantine into a reality show under Prabhakaran's command. A late-night confession round brings long-buried heartbreaks to light.

videos.title: Ceasefires
videos.overview: As Manu and Diya call an uneasy truce, Megha's secret relationship raises alarm among the cousins. Meanwhile, a prank on Aswathy's online class pushes her to a breaking point.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Ashwathy finds her fire again. Restless in quarantine, Chandu, Manu and Diya sneak out for a night in town. But the adventure spirals into a police chase through empty streets.

videos.title: The Ambulance Ride
videos.overview: Stranded after a curfew, Manu and Diya find an unlikely ride home in an ambulance. As they laugh through the fear, the old walls between them finally begin to crumble.

videos.title: The Balcony Confession
videos.overview: A football injury leaves Diya hurt and humiliated. On a quiet balcony at night, Manu finally opens his heart to her and a single moment changes their relationship forever.

videos.title: A New Day
videos.overview: Free of her past, Diya embraces a new beginning and helps Megha break away from Shaan. But as quarantine nears its end, she realises that she isn't ready to let this world go.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: On their last night together, the cousins celebrate. Manu and Diya share a dance to remember. But one conversation the next morning threatens to end their story before it begins.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Three years on, life has moved forward for everyone except Diya, who seems withdrawn since her mother's death. Coaxed to attend a wedding, she comes face-to-face with Manu again.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: Manu and Diya navigate an awkward reunion while old family tensions resurface. As Haldi preparations begin, secrets simmer beneath the cousins' laughter and chaos.

videos.title: Stealing the Show
videos.overview: Veena's Haldi ceremony turns into a battle of egos as the cousins scramble to save face. Diya's unexpected performance stirs up feelings no one saw coming.

videos.title: Juice and Judgment
videos.overview: A prank meant to embarrass Veena spirals into public humiliation. Manu finds himself torn between duty and feelings he can't quite bury.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Fallout from the prank threatens to unravel the wedding, forcing Manu into a confrontation that tests just how far he'll go to keep the peace.

videos.title: Cracks Before the Sangeet
videos.overview: As the sangeet nears, tensions rise over Megha's troubled relationship and old rivalries. A devastating message pushes Manu closer to a dangerous breaking point.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: As celebrations continue, family conflicts boil over and Manu spirals further into heartbreak, leaving the cousins scrambling to hold things together.

videos.title: The Long Way Home
videos.overview: A raw, unfiltered night on the road forces Manu and Diya to finally confront everything left unsaid between them… and everything they still can't say.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: In the dead of night, Diya makes a decision that could change everything; one that puts her, Manu, and the family's fragile peace on the line.

videos.title: The Elopement
videos.overview: A daring plan sets the cousins into motion as Diya and Manu chase one last chance at the life they never got to have.

videos.title: Back to the Kiss
videos.overview: Diya's world comes crashing down as the day takes a turn no one could have predicted and the cousins are left to pick up the pieces.

videos.title: Three Years Later
videos.overview: With the past behind her, Diya has built a quiet life away from everyone. But a familiar face and a cousin gathering bring old memories rushing back.

videos.title: Old Photographs, New Beginnings
videos.overview: An old photograph reopens wounds Diya thought she had buried. Amid a lively shopping spree for Megha's wedding, the cousins reunite, with Diya eventually joining them for dinner.

videos.title: One Night, Not Yet Ready
videos.overview: As Megha's big day draws closer, a tearful reunion and a tense family meet test just how ready Diya really is to let this family back into her life

videos.title: Athirappilly
videos.overview: The cousins gather for another wedding. Old wounds and new beginnings collide against the stunning backdrop of Athirappilly.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: Family loyalties are tested as old grudges resurface and a shocking threat forces the cousins to close ranks around one of their own.

videos.title: Confronting the Truth
videos.overview: The cousins confront a painful truth head-on, in a night that tests just how far they'll go to protect their family.

videos.title: Truths Revealed
videos.overview: Long-buried secrets finally come to light as the celebrations reach a fever pitch, and a surprising revelation changes everything for Manu.

videos.title: A Prickly Conscience
videos.overview: On the day of the wedding, a hidden truth from the past surfaces, sending Diya on a search that could change the course of her life.

videos.title: Above the Falls
videos.overview: At the waterfalls, Manu and Diya finally say the things they have carried in their hearts for years… and make a choice that will define them.

videos.title: Full Circle
videos.overview: As one journey ends, the cousins send off one of their own in true chaotic fashion. Just then, an old story finds its way back to where it began.

Rose Valley
videos.overview: Roslin, a quiet 17 year-old, hides behind her introverted shell. Every night, a shadow with blazing green eyes invades her dreams. What starts as nightmares soon begins to change

videos.title: Visitor
videos.overview: The family's new paying guest is charming and has impeccable manners but carries  an air of mystery, leaving rose torn between nightmares and reality

videos.title: Not a Dream
videos.overview: Rose's growing distrust collides with Jerry's charm as he wins over her family. But when eerie signs escalate,the question lingers: Who is Jerry really?

videos.title: Shobha's Quest
videos.overview: Shobha begins to sense unease about Jerry. Her doubts lead her to quietly investigat, trying to  reconcile Rose's fears with her own suspicions.

videos.title: Goodbye, Jerry
videos.overview: Jerrys Departure finally restores clam to  the household, bringing Rose a sense of relief. WITH life returning to normal, the send-off feels like the closing of a tense chapter.

videos.title: A Night to Remember
videos.overview: The nightmare isn't over. Jerry's shadow return darker then before. This time , the truth is powerful enough to etch itself into Rose's memory forever.

videos.title: S1 E1 : Haunted Shift
videos.overview: Inspector Vishnu is tasked with the transfer of the damaged Avarankadu police station to the Inspection Bungalow. The team, aware of the haunted nature of the building, tries to evade the relocation

videos.title: S1 E2 : The Ordeal
videos.overview: Inspector Vishnu and his team reach out to experts for logical and spiritual solutions when they experience unsettling events in the Inspection Bungalow.

videos.title: S1 E3 : The Arrival of Mythili
videos.overview: Mythili, a researcher, arrives to investigate the supernatural occurrences. With her help, the police team finds a new lead to solve the mystery of the seemingly haunted bungalow.

videos.title: S1 E4 : The Breakthrough
videos.overview: As Vishnu and his team manage to solve half the mystery of the building, unforeseen twists drive them to a different and more dangerous path.

videos.title: S1 E5 : The Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: The main villain arrives, a new body is discovered and several unsettling facts come to light. But that isn’t the end of all mysteries for Vishnu and his team.

videos.title: S1 E6 : Revelations
videos.overview: Amidst the chaos, the police team ends up uncovering Mythili’s true identity and the purpose of her arrival to help them out.

videos.title: S1 E7 : Closing The Case
videos.overview: Vishnu and his team are glad to have solved the mystery of the haunted Inspection Bungalow. But is it really the end of all ordeals for Vishnu's team?

videos.title: Attack on the Cop
videos.overview: In 2004, a gold-smuggling heist leaves young Arikuttan scarred and entangled in violence. Fourteen years later, he arrives in Auran seeking a ghostwriter to reshape his crime-ridden past, as memories of his youth in Thiruvanjipuram - friendships, betrayals, and clashes with local goons - come flooding back.

videos.title: Gangster take over Ponakavu
videos.overview: As SI Suresh recovers, Arikuttan and his friends are drawn deeper into revenge, leading them to Bonakkad, a criminal hideout with ties to their past. When a violent act changes everything, the boys commit their first crime and go into hiding, setting in motion consequences that will haunt them all.

videos.title: Ponkashi Milk Mafia at large
videos.overview: After surviving a near-fatal shooting, Arikuttan finds himself cared for by his friends and SI Suresh. As Maniyan pursues music and love, Kanji enters PSC training, and Moonga lures the gang into a lucrative milk smuggling scam with Suresh at its core. Their newfound prosperity fuels ambition and reckless choices - from kidnapping a music director to brutal revenge on Senthil for misbehaving with women. But as the gang enjoys cars, cable TV, and influence, Inspector Stalin's pursuit puts a dent into their plan.

videos.title: Goons take over the state capital
videos.overview: While serving time in jail, Arikuttan reconnects with his estranged father, forging an uneasy bond. Meanwhile, Senthil's wealthy plantation family retaliates for his public humiliation by sending an army of workers led by Muthuvel to Thiruvanjipuram, unleashing a wave of violence against local gangs. As Maniyan's dreams are shattered in the clashes and the city descends into chaos, unlikely alliances form, but peace only returns once the Tamil gang withdraws - leaving behind broken clubs, ruined friendships, and broken Thadippalam on the brink of demolition.

videos.title: Cold-blooded Christmas
videos.overview: As SI Suresh plots to seize control of the city's flower trade from the powerful Pookada Vava, Arikuttan and his gang are drawn into a dangerous scheme of arson and revenge. Meanwhile, Maniyan's dreams of becoming a singer unravel in jealousy and violence, leaving Pranita devastated. In the present day, Arikuttan urges his ghostwriter to paint him as a victim, but the truth of Vava's death casts a darker shadow over his story.

videos.title: Gunfires at the Festival
videos.overview: After the murder of Pookada Vava, suspicion falls on Kanji, who is arrested and sentenced, while Arikuttan rises in power, winning tenders and fulfilling his childhood dream of leading a temple festival. Maniyan finds fame as a singer, but tragedy strikes when Ramani, seeking vengeance for her husband's death, unleashes a violent chain of retribution. As betrayal, love, and ambition collide, Arikuttan's world spirals into bloodshed and loss, leaving behind only fragments of memory - and a half-finished book that may be his last attempt at redemption.

videos.title: Day 1 - Crime Scene
videos.overview: A sex worker, Swapna, is found dead in a run-down lodge in Kochi. Circle Inspector Kurian and Sub-Inspector Manoj from the North Police Station begin their investigation.

videos.title: Day  2 - Mahazar
videos.overview: The investigation crew learns that only the receptionist, Sharath, has seen the culprit. With Sharath's help, Manoj tries to get Shiju's sketch made.

videos.title: Day  3 - Detection
videos.overview: Swapna's roommate, Lathika, reveals to Manoj about meeting Shiju. The SI connects the dots after she tells him about Shiju's cruelty.

videos.title: Day  4 - Findings
videos.overview: The police expand their search to the other lodges in Kochi after Manoj and his team figure out that Shiju has a practice of meeting sex workers in such places.

videos.title: Day  5 - Evidence
videos.overview: The investigative team learns about Star Shiju, a name derived from the hotel he worked at. They set out to explore Shiju's roots.

videos.title: Day  6 - Charge Sheet
videos.overview: Kurian, Manoj and their team have been chasing Shiju all over. But how long can a man hide away if he is genuinely in love?

videos.title: Shuffle in the Capital
videos.overview: A sudden police department shake-up sets the stage for an unexpected convergence of officers Kurian, Noble and Ambili Raju, but Ambili goes AWOL.

videos.title: Ambili-Ayyappan Puzzle
videos.overview: As they dig deeper into Ambili's life, a bizarre connection to an ex-convict, Ayyappan, emerges, raising more questions than answers.

videos.title: Crossing Borders
videos.overview: Clues from Thiruvananthapuram and a mysterious incident in Ernakulam involving CI Manoj connect, forming a jigsaw puzzle for Noble to assemble.

videos.title: Noble's Instinct
videos.overview: With Manoj's warm support, Noble's unorthodox approach proves pivotal as he follows his instincts to connect the dots and uncover a crucial lead.

videos.title: Back to Square One
videos.overview: New revelations about Ayyappan send Noble and the team full circle, linking back to the mysterious incidents at the dog retirement shelter.

videos.title: Noble's Stadium Theory
videos.overview: With theories aligning but witnesses lacking, Noble is driven to validate his Central Stadium theory, which he's deeply invested in.

videos.title: Foundation of Love
videos.overview: Pappan oversees the work of Vinod's new home in Kerala. In Dubai, Vinod, who is building this home for his eager parents, meets Gouri. But a job loss throws his future into turmoil.

videos.title: Building Bridges
videos.overview: Gouri pushes for marriage and a move to Canada. With no job, a half-built house, a mounting debt, and disapproving families, what will Vinod do?

videos.title: Reinforced Romance
videos.overview: Vinod and Pappan try to fast-track the marriage registration, but a vindictive officer refuses to help them. As Vinod struggles with money, he gets shocking news.

videos.title: Bricks and Hearts
videos.overview: Vinod is hit with fraud, the secret about the wall collapse and more money struggles. As Gouri's father tightens control, her mother accuses their maid of theft.

videos.title: Sealing the Cracks
videos.overview: Vinod returns the pawned jewellery but gets into a fight with Gouri's dad. When rumours start flying linking Pappan and Gouri, Vinod and Gouri realise they have no time to lose.

videos.title: The Final Coat
videos.overview: While Gouri faces her angry father, Vinod challenges the overseer. At the registration office, Gouri finally loses her patience and temper when Vinod arrives really late.

videos.title: In love’s world, gender is irrelevant
Prequel
videos.overview: Sarah and her son, Bibin, live an isolated life. As loud cries of infants haunt Sarah, she scribbles names on her walls. What secret is she keeping?

videos.title: Sequel
videos.overview: Twelve years later, CI Aji Kurian, investigating the mysterious death of actor Ancy, finds himself drawn to the name Bibin. Sanjeev Krishna is devastated by his wife's death.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Merlin's revelations lead Aji Kurian to Sarah's letters. After unravelling Sarah's most twisted secret, Aji finds himself pulled into a dark vortex of truth.

videos.title: First Half
videos.overview: The unravelling of Bibin's cryptic letters begins. Clues lead Aji and his team to Bangalore towards another death. The mystery tightens its grip.

videos.title: Interval
videos.overview: Bibin's puppeteering of human lives takes him to a prominent politician. As Aji digs deeper, he meets with fresh challenges and dreadful questions.

videos.title: Second Half
videos.overview: A tapestry of truths, theories and mysteries woven together by Aji reveals the scary extent of Bibin's killing spree. However, Aji faces a threat more perilous than Bibin. What is it?

videos.title: Anti-Climax
videos.overview: The endgame. The ultimate gamble. Aji and his team are locked in a deadly game where the stakes are high. In this life-or-death showdown, whose truth will prevail?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Mahendran, the deputy tehsildar, agrees to help Joseph, a man facing legal issues due a name mismatch in his mother's documents, upon learning that he is a close friend of a Member of Parliament. Meanwhile, the impending monsoon leads to concerns with the public over a dam that may breach due to heavy rainfall.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mahendran asks Biju to create a certificate that would help the old lady but not be used as a political weapon against him. Meanwhile, the office employees bid farewell to Tehsildar Shibu, who is replaced by Tehsildar Shobha, who has a different way of running things.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mahendran is displeased with Shobha's posting, as Prajas approaches him pledging to forget his political affiliation and join Mahendran's union if he is relieved from control room duty. Meanwhile, Shobha notices that Mahendran is not in office and marks a half-day against his attendance, infuriating him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The news of Mahendran and Shobha's suspension creates headlines in the media. While Shobha is devastated, Mahendran looks for support from his political party. However, the leaders wash their hands off the scandal and tell him there's nothing they can do for him.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Biju agrees to help Mahendran when he realises that the only way to trap those responsible for the scandal is to investigate the land document records. When news of the corruption in the land distributed to the 48 families breaks, Aravindan is pressured to find out how the files were leaked. Meanwhile, Unni tells Shobha that it would be easier to pay the bribe than expect a fair investigation.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After joining hands with Shobha to clear both their names, Mahendran meets with the leader of the opposite faction of the ruling party. Later, at a protest, Harichandran is attacked by goons who disguised themselves as the minister's supporters.

videos.title: Jaanaki
videos.overview: When an opportunity to go to the Gulf arises, Nagendran finds himself short of funds. Soman proposes an unconventional solution: marriage.

videos.title: Lillykutty
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman arrive in Pathanamthitta to see Lillykutty. While Lillykutty weaves her influence over Nagendran, can he secure Varkey’s elusive approval?

videos.title: Laila
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman encounter Laila in Kasaragod. Her mysterious past ensnares Nagendran with fear. Can he break free from her grasp?

videos.title: Saavithri
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman reach Palakkad to acquire the necessary funds and meet Saavithri. Can Nagendran save her, or will he get trapped in the palls of a dilapidated Brahmin household?

videos.title: Thangam
videos.overview: Why are the locals rushing to marry off Thangam? Nagendran meets Thangam in Kuttanad and struggles to outwit the locals. He and Soman try to escape from Varkey’s grasp.

videos.title: Mozhi
videos.overview: Bewitched by Mozhi at first sight, Nagendran is not able to deceive her. Tensions rise as he and Soman clash for the first time. Can Nagendran forge a new life with Mozhi?

videos.title: Episode 114 : Nakul Decides to Sell Malavika
videos.overview: Maheshwar prays to Sri Maheshwaran for Malavika to return home safely. Nakul decides to sell Malavika off to a begging mafia. Gokul scorns Rahul, who calls him asking about Malavika’s whereabouts.

videos.title: The Confessor
videos.overview: The Confessor Aruku, a guilt-stricken man, confesses to the murder of elephants, setting a group of forest officers and NGO workers into action — hunting for justice across India.

videos.title: The Crusader
videos.overview: The Crusader Mala and Alan crack the poachers’ call logs, which leads to their first dangerous raid on unsuspecting locals.

videos.title: The Scapegoat
videos.overview: The Scapegoat The group closes in on the gang leader, Raaz, leading to a shocking discovery when they find him.

videos.title: The Blind Eye
videos.overview: The Blind Eye Mala goes on her own to pursue the truth about Raaz, while Alan must mend his collapsing marriage with Achala.

videos.title: The Kidnapping
videos.overview: The Kidnapping Alan leads an effort to kidnap a local corrupt politician - unbeknownst to Achala - while Mala must confront the true danger she’s put everyone in as the team becomes deeper ensnared in the threatening world of animal poaching.

videos.title: The Jungle
videos.overview: The Jungle Months earlier, the poaching gang assembles and heads into the jungle for the elephant hunt; while in present day, Aruku leads Mala and her team into the jungle to retrace their steps to the crime scene.

videos.title: The Big Fish
videos.overview: The Big Fish Racing against the clock, Mala and Alan travel to Delhi to pursue the big fish - the well-connected ivory dealer - and along the way must come up with a plan to smuggle her back to Kerala, where they have the jurisdiction to arrest her.

videos.title: The Graveyard
videos.overview: The Graveyard Mala and her team face riotous crowds and corrupt local officials in Delhi while attempting to seize the largest cache of ivory in Indian history.

videos.title: Welcome to Perilloor
videos.overview: To be in power after being barred from the upcoming elections, Peethambaran, the long-standing Panchayat president, convinces his niece to contest. Will Malavika agree?

videos.title: Not Heaven, But Hell
videos.overview: Realising the trouble she invited, Malavika and her aunt scheme to intentionally lose the election. Finally, she seeks the help of Psycho Balachandran.

videos.title: Fox 1, Tiger 0
videos.overview: Winning by one vote, a reluctant Malavika becomes the Panchayat president. After spurning Malavika, Sreekuttan's desire to wed backfires each time he goes bride-seeing.

videos.title: Reality Bites
videos.overview: With the mahout's son missing from the village, the Panchayat president Malavika faces a crisis. Sneha confesses her love for Sreekuttan, and he finally feels hopeful.

videos.title: All Hope Lost
videos.overview: When Sreekuttan's shop faces a crisis, he blames Malavika and vows revenge against her. Little does he know the cause of his problem is someone else.

videos.title: Unleashing Fury
videos.overview: Malavika defies her uncle over a controversial project. While an investigation is awaited, more ploys by Peethambaran lead to heartbreak and drastic decisions.

videos.title: Thank You, Visit Again
videos.overview: As pranks, prophecies, treasure hunts, weddings and farewells unfold, things take a strange turn for Malavika and Sreekuttan.

videos.title: Oh My Dog
videos.overview: Did they fight? Are they having problems? What is with the knife? Riya and Binoy's parents have more questions for the loving couple as they barge into their house unannounced.

videos.title: Om Shanthi Home
videos.overview: The parents' intervention complicates matters for Binoy and Riya, and the blame game begins. In the middle of all that, a guest arrives.

videos.title: Happy Hours
videos.overview: After the peace in the house is fully disrupted, the couple gets a call from their friend and neighbour, Adarsh, who is up to no good and wants their help to deal with his wife.

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: Riya loses her patience with Aniyamma and Kuriyachan and blames them for insulting their guest. Things get worse when a prospective marriage proposal turns into a religious war.

videos.title: Song of Songs
videos.overview: Riya and Binoy realise that their parents' problems are more grave than theirs. Many surprises unfold as their inner conflicts come to light.

videos.title: The Story Of Yeshu's Birth
videos.overview: The Story Of Yeshu's Birth

videos.title: Episode 1 : Panki Ammavan and Ambili Fight
videos.overview: Wedding preparations are underway at the Kottilakkattu House. Panki Ammavan and Ambili fight over a vehicle. Ananthan pacifies his mother when she refuses to attend the wedding.

videos.title: Laying Plans
videos.overview:
The Calculations!

Ajayan, a failed writer, turns up on a live television show and announces that he is going to commit 7 perfect murders in 7 days. As the audience goes into panic the police force assemble outside the studio to stop him. But when he reveals the victim’s identity, every one is baffled. Will Ajayan kill on-air as he claims?

videos.title: Waging War
videos.overview: A police team is assembled under DySP Jacob Anookkaran, to investigate the crime. Ajayan announces the second victim. Jacob’s immediate challenge is to find out if Ajayan’s threat is real. Will a lonely war veteran, be saved by Jacob ?

videos.title: Attack by Stratagem
videos.overview: Ajayan chooses his next victim on the basis of “gender equality”. What is equality, when a man is playing god with the lives of others? Will Jacob and team be able to save this victim before their one hour runs out?

videos.title: Weak and Strong Points
videos.overview: Hope of Success ! A master puppeteer he claims. He pulls the strings of not just the victim, but the police force too, it appears. He sheds some feeble light on his motivation. Will that help save the victim? Finally a win for the police, looks like.

videos.title: Maneuvring
videos.overview: Mixed bag! Police find Ajayan’s last victim. The team also manages to figure out his methods and motives. Will it be enough to save the next victim? On the personal front, Jacob gets a much needed closure. Ajayan’s latest message throws some key que

videos.title: Variation in Tactics
videos.overview: Watch where you tread! The deaths send ripples across the society. On her show Sumitra continues to bring to the fore Ajayan’s real message- that all lives matter. Jacob seeks the help of Lucas, a tech expert, to track victims.

videos.title: The Army on the March
videos.overview: Puzzle unraveled? With Lucas on board, identifying the victim is a little easier. Someone connected to Ajayan surfaces and Jacob discovers a deeper pattern behind Ajayan’s choice of victims. The team is still reeling from the last blow.

videos.title: The Attack By Fire

videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates some of the housemates for their good conduct. With a quirky question for Arun and a special task for Muthu, he signs off by advising the Men's team.

videos.title: Day 14: VJS Debunks the Accusations

videos.title: Day 15: Team Swap Trouble

videos.title: Day 17: Role Reversal in the Hotel
videos.overview: The men's team takes charge as staff and the women's team as haughty guests. The ladies succeed in taking revenge, and later everyone gears up for a game of dumb charades.

videos.title: Day 18: The Hotel Gets Upgraded
videos.overview: After a review session, both teams vote for the best and worst performers. BB announces the results with a twist, and the hotel gets set to welcome their new guests and staff.

videos.title: Day 19: Sivakarthikeyan in BB House
videos.overview: Women's team win the 'Nomination Free Pass' and have a debate among them to decide who deserves it. Later, all the housemates gather to welcome Sivakarthikeyan to the house.

videos.title: Day 20: VJS Reviews the Gameplay
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan recalls last week's events and commends the 'guests' of BB hotel. He probes the fairness of the Killer Coin task and raises issues of inequality among the girls.

videos.title: Day 21: Housemates on the Hot Seat
videos.overview: VJS commends housemates for their Hotel task and probes for any bias in assignments. He resolves all disputes while assessing team-swapping decisions ahead of eviction.

videos.title: Day 22: New Week, New Strategies
videos.overview: As the week begins, team swapping and captaincy tasks are in full swing. Nominations raise tension while collecting ration points and shopping add fuel to the fire.

videos.title: Day 23: Rolling for Role Play
videos.overview: As the women's team lose, they take up all the household tasks. Next, the housemates enact each other's characters as per BB's instructions, raising the bar of entertainment.

videos.title: Day 24: Reel Ones Review the Real
videos.overview: The housemates get a reality check from their "task characters". After the Showtime, Vishal talks about Muthu's game plan while the women win the float or sink task.

videos.title: Day 25: Kavin's Diwali Surprise
videos.overview: Decked up in traditional attires, the housemates celebrate Deepavali with fun games, crackers and a special lunch. The merriment doubles when Kavin enters the house.

videos.title: Day 26: Women's Team Wins Again
videos.overview: The women’s team earn 'Nomination Free Pass', while Jeffry and Sachana receive penalties for their performance this week. Later, Sathya and Ananthi go head-to-head for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 27: Celebrating in Style with VJS
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan spreads festive cheer with his greetings and asks about the outfits he gifted the housemates. He reviews this week's tasks and the women’s team's success streak.

videos.title: Day 28: Make Way for the Wildcards
videos.overview: VJS asks Muthu about his captaincy review and offers guidance. Moreover, the arrival of new contestants and a Diwali 'bonus' from VJS leaves the housemates feeling bittersweet.

videos.title: Day 29: The First Open Nominations
videos.overview: Captain Sathya takes charge and assigns duties, while the direct nominations raise tension. Chaos ensues when Tharshika puts forth a condition for the Men's team.

videos.title: Day 30: Triumphs and Troubles
videos.overview: Men's team won the tasks, yet the border crossing debate remains unresolved. Following the unfair discussions, the women's team declare a hunger strike, leading to a verbal war.

videos.title: Day 31: Identify the Manipulator
videos.overview: The housemates are asked to vote for the most manipulative ones among them. Men secure their first Nomination Free Pass, while the story task continues without any interruptions.

videos.title: Day 32: Letters on the Way
videos.overview: Harsh nicknames and anonymous criticisms from each other, leaves the housemates wounded. Later, everyone celebrates Ulaganayagan's birthday before resuming the storytelling task.

videos.title: Day 33: Best and Worst Selection
videos.overview: The women get a task of styling the men. Additionally, BB asks the housemates to vote for the best and worst performers, while Arun secures the captaincy title this week.

videos.title: Day 34: Weekly Review
videos.overview: VJS asks housemates and wildcards about their opinions on each other, offering advice to both teams. Moreover, he dives deep into Sathya's leadership and Women's team's new rules.

videos.title: Day 35: An Advice from Makkal Selvan
videos.overview: VJS revisits the highlights of the weekly task, and emphasises the need to address behavioural challenges. Later, he offered advice to some and resolves ongoing tiffs.

videos.title: Day 36: New Rules for the Captain
videos.overview: Captain Arun is clad with a powerful cape, while the women's team dominate the shopping task. After nominations, the men panic as they fail to notice their new member Anshida.

videos.title: Day 37: Back to School
videos.overview: Excitement runs high as housemates become teachers and mischievous students for this week’s BB School task. But with clashes erupting at every corner, can order be restored?

videos.title: Day 38: Scuffles and a Secret Task
videos.overview: Feedback from students leaves the staff frustrated, while Deepak receives secret task by BB. Later, the teachers struggle to maintain order as fiery arguments erupt in the school.

videos.title: Day 39: Chaos at School
videos.overview: Students protest against Principal Varshini’s harsh actions. On the other hand, Jacquline is left in tears after Deepak and Arun misinterpret her words.

videos.title: Day 40: Captain Arun Faces the Heat
videos.overview: After losing stripes from his cape, Captain Arun mediates a dispute within the women's team. The best performers become captaincy contenders, while the worst face a penalty.

videos.title: Day 41: VJS Issues a Progress Report
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan receives feedback on the school task and student disruptions. Later, Deepak’s revelation surprises many in the house, while others clarify misunderstandings.

videos.title: Day 42: Eviction Drama and a Twist
videos.overview: VJS discusses Arun's captaincy and warns the housemates about their refusals and behaviour. After the eviction, he delivers an unexpected surprise to everyone.

videos.title: Day 43: A Costly Mistake
videos.overview: After a tearful argument with Arun, Manjari takes charge as the captain. Later, a crisis unfolds when the women’s shopping task goes wrong and they lose everything.

videos.title: Day 44: Conflict Sparks Mayhem
videos.overview: Sachana gets emotional after the women's team confront and advises her. Later, Raanav clashes with Manjari over a rule violation, while Muthu challenges her leadership.

videos.title: Day 45: BB Darbar
videos.overview: The house splits into two kingdoms - ruled by King Raanav and Queen Sachana. To claim the throne, they must conquer tasks, but what happens when unexpected hurdles arise?

videos.title: Day 46: Arimadesam Takes the Lead
videos.overview: Teams guess time and weight without gadgets to score points for the throne. The men bag a victory hat-trick, while the women prepare to fight back and take back what's theirs.

videos.title: Day 47: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: This week’s best performers compete for captaincy, while Soundarya and Shiva face harsh criticism. One is brought to tears, whereas the other attempts to clear the air with Deepak.

videos.title: Day 48: VJS Investigates the Issues
videos.overview: VJS questions the housemates about changes after the house swap and their task experiences. Later, he probes into concerns over Sachana’s penalty task and Manjari's leadership.

videos.title: Day 49: Halfway to Finale
videos.overview: The housemates open up about their milestones, the shopping mistake and the challenges in the Darbar task. Later, VJS delivers an announcement that fills everyone with excitement.

videos.title: Day 50: One Bigg Team
videos.overview: Captain Deepak's proactive efforts win him praises from BB. Though the nomination process causes friction between the housemates, an unified shopping task brings them together.

videos.title: Day 51: Doll Task
videos.overview: Anandhi and Pavithra's confrontation leaves Anshida emotional. Later, the quirky Doll task spirals out of control when housemates resist placing the dolls.

videos.title: Day 52: Traits, Talks and Tasks
videos.overview: The housemates make peace with the previous day's results, while an unwashed cup causes a stir. Match the traits activity sets in, and BB resumes the Doll task with fresh rules.

videos.title: Day 53: Disputes Over the Dolls
videos.overview: Sachana's hasty decision to cut one of the captain's roses leads to an argument. Later, a series of heated tiffs arise after Rayan and Raanav lock horns to secure the dolls.

videos.title: Day 54: Special Guests and Squabbles
videos.overview: Child artists of the Hotstar Specials show Parachute, visit the house. Later, Manjari raises a food issue with Arun, and the argument intensifies when Captain Deepak gets involved.

videos.title: Day 55: From Controversies to Captaincy
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan probes the housemates on this week's issues, from the Arun-Manjari fallout to Sachana’s unacceptable walkout. Later, he applauds captain Deepak.

videos.title: Day 56: VJS Reviews the Doll Task
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi discusses about the Doll task in detail. Strategies, gameplays and fights are questioned, while the nominated ones prepare for the eviction.

videos.title: Day 57: New Leaders Step In
videos.overview: Jeffry and Sachana are appointed captain and vice-captain respectively. The quirky shopping task stirs frustration, while Arun and Manjari resolve their differences.

videos.title: Day 58: Ranking Task with a Twist
videos.overview: After a morning activity on activeness, the housemates rank each other based on their goodwill. Tables turn when BB declares the top eight as Angels, and the rest as Demons.

videos.title: Day 59: Angels vs Devils
videos.overview: Intense emotional stress and physical challenges in the task lead the Angels to cry and argue. Meanwhile, the Devils face growing tensions within their ranks.

videos.title: Day 60: Role Reversal Round
videos.overview: BB asks the Devils to declare the count of hearts collected, and begin the next round by swapping roles. Angels of round one get set to take revenge.

videos.title: Day 61: Whom Would You Choose?
videos.overview: After intense arguments for the Nomination Free Pass, the housemates choose their friends and foes. The worst performers get punished, while the best compete for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 62: Rules or Rebellion?
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi offers a mix of praise and advice on the housemates' roles as Devils and Angels. He questions the fairness of the Goa Gang's rules and their impact on the game.

videos.title: Day 63: Double Eviction
videos.overview: VJS discusses Jeffry’s leadership, ration concerns and task conflicts. The atmosphere shifts dramatically when he announces the unexpected double eviction.

videos.title: Day 64: Stuck with the Label
videos.overview: Captain Ranjith faces a housemate's dissatisfaction during his first task. Rayan and Arun engage in a mockery feud, while housemates wear badges with labels from nominations.

videos.title: Day 65: Managers vs Labourers
videos.overview: Arun and Deepak argue, after which the housemates pick the top and bottom contestants, leading to heated exchanges. Next, the manager vs labourer task creates chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 66: Swap! Swap! Swap!
videos.overview: Heated altercations ensue over team swaps between Managers and Labourers. Later, as Muthu's actions lead to a ban, the Managers punish him for his behaviour.

videos.title: Day 67: New Rules, New Conflicts
videos.overview: 2.0 of the task begins with some twists and changes, making labourers incharge of the household chores. Commotion ensues when the teams clash and rules get violated.

videos.title: Day 68: Vidhuthalai 2 Team Pays a Visit
videos.overview: Amidst the celebrations and conflicts, Raanav gets nominated while Jeffry wins the Free pass. The best-worst performers are selected, and special guests surprise the housemates.

videos.title: Day 69: Mind-bending Questions from VJS
videos.overview: A twist in the tale occurs as VJS decides to begin the day with an eviction. He addresses the housemates' concerns and some of his questions make them rethink their decisions.

videos.title: Day 70: VJS Checks on the Housemates
videos.overview: Ranjith's captaincy is discussed in detail, after which VJS advises him to change his approach. As one more housemate bid goodbye, the rest have a one-on-one discussion with VJS.

videos.title: Day 71: Captaincy and Open Nominations
videos.overview: Raanav's unexpected move in the captaincy task changes the dynamics, resulting in Vishal's victory. Post-task arguments and open nominations escalate tensions in the house.

videos.title: Day 72: Bricks and Bruises
videos.overview: Fierce arguments and clashes erupt as housemates fight to secure and steal bricks for the task. Moreover, tension builds when Raanav’s injury triggers strange speculations.

videos.title: Day 73: Team Tiffs
videos.overview: Raanav’s exit forces a reshuffle, while foul play allegations hit Jeffry’s team. Amid the chaos, Captain Vishal succumbs to the mounting pressure during the task.

videos.title: Day 74: Muyal 2.0
videos.overview: Three teams battle intensely to catch the most rabbits and claim the NF pass. Problems arisewhen the women engage in physical struggles and sharp exchanges.

videos.title: Day 75: BB Revokes Benefits
videos.overview: Jacquline receives an audience-assigned task that leaves her in tears. Contender Muthu’s gameplay during the task upsets BB who then makes shocking announcements.

videos.title: Day 76: Applauses with a Dose of Advice
videos.overview: VJS commends the housemates for their efforts in the weekly task. Later, he interrogates those who questioned Raanav’s injury and highlights the red team's performance issues.

videos.title: Day 77: Who Will Join VJS Onstage?
videos.overview: The housemates vote for the "Attenion-seeker" while VJS delves into the details of Vishal's captaincy. Muthu gets an earful for his behaviour, and everyone preps for the eviction.

videos.title: Day 78: Bigg Buzz Over the New Chef
videos.overview: Housemates get emotional as they talk about who they miss. After Soundarya cooks solo, BB announces no kitchen help from now on, sparking lively debates on future cooking duties.

videos.title: Day 79: Family Week
videos.overview: Emotions overflow as Deepak, Manjari and Rayan reunite with their families. Vishal’s joy doubles when his loved one unexpectedly makes an entrance.

videos.title: Day 80: Emotional Surprises
videos.overview: Soundarya, Raanav, Pavithra, and Anshida’s families arrive with surprises and reveal their concerns. In the midst of this, Soundarya and Jacqueline resolve their differences.

videos.title: Day 81: Happy Reunions
videos.overview: Arun’s sadness fades as BB reveals his prank and brings in his parents. Jeffry, Jacquline and Muthu’s families enter shortly after, turning the house into a whirlwind of happiness.

videos.title: Day 82: Support and Surprises
videos.overview: As tough weeks approach, the housemates' friends bring advice and encouragement. Arun is overjoyed to see Archana, while Erode Mahesh boosts the morale of all the housemates.

videos.title: Day 83: Saturday Eviction
videos.overview: VJS asks housemates about their family interactions and their thoughts on the contradictions shared. Later, the house is left in shock as he announces an unexpected eviction.

videos.title: Day 84: Ticket to Finale
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan prompts housemates to share new year resolutions and call out the least deserving of votes. Following an eviction, he reveals the much-anticipated Ticket to Finale.

videos.title: Day 85: And the Games Begins!
videos.overview: Open nominations lead to unrest in the house, while Soundarya and Muthu clash over shopping preferences. Later, BB kick-starts TTF week with the first quirky task.

videos.title: Day 86: A Tough Fight
videos.overview: The TTF challenge heats up with two tough tasks. Muthu and Raanav get into an altercation, while two others score points—who are they?

videos.title: Day 87: New Year, New Challenges
videos.overview: Muthu, Jacquline and Soundarya find housemates to execute their Phone tasks, but each face failure. Later, BB hosts a special New Year’s dinner with a twist.

videos.title: Day 88: Deals and Disputes
videos.overview: The scoreboard turns upside down after the Ball task. Manjari strikes a deal with Rayan, while the Points Mandrum task causes chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 89: One Last Call
videos.overview: Arun and Rayan compete to pick up the last call from BB, while Soundarya and Raanav engage in a heated argument. Meanwhile, the top TTF scorers battle it out in the final round.

videos.title: Day 90: VJS Questions the Strategy
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan asks the house who they believe does not deserve the TTF and why. Further, he analyses the impact of alliances in the game, with Muthu admitting to his errors.

videos.title: Day 91: Meet Your First Finalist
videos.overview: VJS questions the housemates on who they think deserved to stay in the game. Moments later, the house erupts with excitement as he enters the house to announce the TTF winner.

videos.title: Day 92: Wildcard Knockout!
videos.overview: Soundarya sobs from the criticism, while the wildcard announcement leaves the house in panic. However, the situation lightens when they get a task to roast the ex-housemates.

videos.title: Day 93: It's Time for Feedback!
videos.overview: Ex-contestants of S8 re-enter, go through the task comments, and review the rest of the housemates, leading to chaos. Some take it sportingly, while Vishal feels overwhelmed.

videos.title: Day 94: Top 8 vs Challengers
videos.overview: Dressed as movie characters, housemates battle with the challengers in Aadiya Aatam Enna task. Minor scuffles draw attention, but BB’s strict warning leaves the wildcards in a fix.

videos.title: Day 95: Dance Battles
videos.overview: Soundarya breaks down after the top 8 and challengers nominate each other for position swaps. Later, the house buzzes with energy during the one-on-one dance showdown.

videos.title: Day 96: Clashes and Confrontations
videos.overview: Deepak's words hurt Varshini, and besties Soundarya and Jacquline have a heated argument that puts their friendship at stake. The housemates battle in the final round of the task.

videos.title: Day 97: A Surprise Eviction
videos.overview: VJS appreciates the character performances of the housemates. He also discusses the reactions and reviews of the ex-contestants and reveals the first evictee of this week.

videos.title: Day 98: An Unexpected Elimination
videos.overview: The housemates share a memory they wish to erase, and VJS discusses the animosity that the ex-contestants came in with. The eviction results sweep everyone off their feet.

videos.title: Day 99: Reunions Cause Chaos
videos.overview: BB declares that the challengers failed to replace the finalists and applauds the top six. The rest of the ex-contestants step in one by one, creating a stir in the house.

videos.title: Day 100: Pongalo Pongal!
videos.overview: The housemates happily celebrate Pongal with BBS5 winner Raju and other special guests. The much-anticipated money box has arrived, but with a twist. Will someone claim it today?

videos.title: Day 101: Ma Ka Pa in the House!
videos.overview: BB brings in the second money box, and Rayan accepts the challenge to retrieve it within a set time. Ma Ka Pa surprises the housemates and hosts an entertaining podcast with them.

videos.title: Day 102: Final Race for the Money Box
videos.overview: The next four of the top six try their luck with the money box today. The housemates warmly welcome some special guests, including their beloved Manjari, Raanav, and Deepak.

videos.title: Day 103: Let's Rewind
videos.overview: The housemates are enthralled with the video compilations of their special bonds and bigg fights of this season. Later, the top five finalists get to relive their journey of S8.

videos.title: Day 104: The Last Day in BB House
videos.overview: All the housemates together have a blast, with BB's farewell speech being a cherry on top. Later, the ex-contestants convey their wishes and bid goodbye to the finalists.

videos.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: Five contenders, one trophy and an ultimate showdown! Join Vijay Sethupathi as he crowns this season's winner in an evening of captivating entertainment.

videos.title: BBTam Day 9: Bommai Battles

videos.title: BBTam Day 13: Truth or Tactics?
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates Kani’s captaincy win and questions Kamrudin's performance in the task. Later, he probes the Bommai task strategies and asks about two-faced housemates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 16: BB Juice Factory

videos.title: BBTam Day 17: House Drama Over Cleaning Duties
videos.overview: FJ, Kemy, and Paaru argue over cleaning duties, sparking tensions in the house. Meanwhile, the Juice Factory task intensifies with QC disputes.

videos.overview: BB awards factory owners with coins for approved bottles. QC monitors face pressure from workers, while one housemate takes the lead and reaps the rewards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 19: The Best and the Worst

videos.title: BBTam Day 20: Attention, Housemates!
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi slams the housemates for toxic behaviour and serves bitter gourd juice as a reality check. He probes their task performance and issues stern warnings.

videos.overview: Housemates discuss problems during Kani’s captaincy. Subiksha, Viyana and Praveen are saved, while VJS asks who is not performing well, before eviction process.

videos.title: BBTam Day 25: Tug of Words

videos.overview: FJ and Sabari share their life stories, and two housemates win a free pass. After a clash between Vikram and Diwakar, the Locker task ends in a twist and BB issues a demand.

videos.title: BBTam Day 32: Hotel in Turmoil
