Rose Valley
videos.overview: Roslin, a quiet 17 year-old, hides behind her introverted shell. Every night, a shadow with blazing green eyes invades her dreams. What starts as nightmares soon begins to change

videos.title: Visitor
videos.overview: The family's new paying guest is charming and has impeccable manners but carries  an air of mystery, leaving rose torn between nightmares and reality

videos.title: Not a Dream
videos.overview: Rose's growing distrust collides with Jerry's charm as he wins over her family. But when eerie signs escalate,the question lingers: Who is Jerry really?

videos.title: Shobha's Quest
videos.overview: Shobha begins to sense unease about Jerry. Her doubts lead her to quietly investigat, trying to  reconcile Rose's fears with her own suspicions.

videos.title: Goodbye, Jerry
videos.overview: Jerrys Departure finally restores clam to  the household, bringing Rose a sense of relief. WITH life returning to normal, the send-off feels like the closing of a tense chapter.

videos.title: A Night to Remember
videos.overview: The nightmare isn't over. Jerry's shadow return darker then before. This time , the truth is powerful enough to etch itself into Rose's memory forever.

videos.title: S1 E1 : Haunted Shift
videos.overview: Inspector Vishnu is tasked with the transfer of the damaged Avarankadu police station to the Inspection Bungalow. The team, aware of the haunted nature of the building, tries to evade the relocation

videos.title: S1 E2 : The Ordeal
videos.overview: Inspector Vishnu and his team reach out to experts for logical and spiritual solutions when they experience unsettling events in the Inspection Bungalow.

videos.title: S1 E3 : The Arrival of Mythili
videos.overview: Mythili, a researcher, arrives to investigate the supernatural occurrences. With her help, the police team finds a new lead to solve the mystery of the seemingly haunted bungalow.

videos.title: S1 E4 : The Breakthrough
videos.overview: As Vishnu and his team manage to solve half the mystery of the building, unforeseen twists drive them to a different and more dangerous path.

videos.title: S1 E5 : The Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: The main villain arrives, a new body is discovered and several unsettling facts come to light. But that isn’t the end of all mysteries for Vishnu and his team.

videos.title: S1 E6 : Revelations
videos.overview: Amidst the chaos, the police team ends up uncovering Mythili’s true identity and the purpose of her arrival to help them out.

videos.title: S1 E7 : Closing The Case
videos.overview: Vishnu and his team are glad to have solved the mystery of the haunted Inspection Bungalow. But is it really the end of all ordeals for Vishnu's team?

videos.title: Attack on the Cop
videos.overview: In 2004, a gold-smuggling heist leaves young Arikuttan scarred and entangled in violence. Fourteen years later, he arrives in Auran seeking a ghostwriter to reshape his crime-ridden past, as memories of his youth in Thiruvanjipuram - friendships, betrayals, and clashes with local goons - come flooding back.

videos.title: Gangster take over Ponakavu
videos.overview: As SI Suresh recovers, Arikuttan and his friends are drawn deeper into revenge, leading them to Bonakkad, a criminal hideout with ties to their past. When a violent act changes everything, the boys commit their first crime and go into hiding, setting in motion consequences that will haunt them all.

videos.title: Ponkashi Milk Mafia at large
videos.overview: After surviving a near-fatal shooting, Arikuttan finds himself cared for by his friends and SI Suresh. As Maniyan pursues music and love, Kanji enters PSC training, and Moonga lures the gang into a lucrative milk smuggling scam with Suresh at its core. Their newfound prosperity fuels ambition and reckless choices - from kidnapping a music director to brutal revenge on Senthil for misbehaving with women. But as the gang enjoys cars, cable TV, and influence, Inspector Stalin's pursuit puts a dent into their plan.

videos.title: Goons take over the state capital
videos.overview: While serving time in jail, Arikuttan reconnects with his estranged father, forging an uneasy bond. Meanwhile, Senthil's wealthy plantation family retaliates for his public humiliation by sending an army of workers led by Muthuvel to Thiruvanjipuram, unleashing a wave of violence against local gangs. As Maniyan's dreams are shattered in the clashes and the city descends into chaos, unlikely alliances form, but peace only returns once the Tamil gang withdraws - leaving behind broken clubs, ruined friendships, and broken Thadippalam on the brink of demolition.

videos.title: Cold-blooded Christmas
videos.overview: As SI Suresh plots to seize control of the city's flower trade from the powerful Pookada Vava, Arikuttan and his gang are drawn into a dangerous scheme of arson and revenge. Meanwhile, Maniyan's dreams of becoming a singer unravel in jealousy and violence, leaving Pranita devastated. In the present day, Arikuttan urges his ghostwriter to paint him as a victim, but the truth of Vava's death casts a darker shadow over his story.

videos.title: Gunfires at the Festival
videos.overview: After the murder of Pookada Vava, suspicion falls on Kanji, who is arrested and sentenced, while Arikuttan rises in power, winning tenders and fulfilling his childhood dream of leading a temple festival. Maniyan finds fame as a singer, but tragedy strikes when Ramani, seeking vengeance for her husband's death, unleashes a violent chain of retribution. As betrayal, love, and ambition collide, Arikuttan's world spirals into bloodshed and loss, leaving behind only fragments of memory - and a half-finished book that may be his last attempt at redemption.

videos.title: Day 1 - Crime Scene
videos.overview: A sex worker, Swapna, is found dead in a run-down lodge in Kochi. Circle Inspector Kurian and Sub-Inspector Manoj from the North Police Station begin their investigation.

videos.title: Day  2 - Mahazar
videos.overview: The investigation crew learns that only the receptionist, Sharath, has seen the culprit. With Sharath's help, Manoj tries to get Shiju's sketch made.

videos.title: Day  3 - Detection
videos.overview: Swapna's roommate, Lathika, reveals to Manoj about meeting Shiju. The SI connects the dots after she tells him about Shiju's cruelty.

videos.title: Day  4 - Findings
videos.overview: The police expand their search to the other lodges in Kochi after Manoj and his team figure out that Shiju has a practice of meeting sex workers in such places.

videos.title: Day  5 - Evidence
videos.overview: The investigative team learns about Star Shiju, a name derived from the hotel he worked at. They set out to explore Shiju's roots.

videos.title: Day  6 - Charge Sheet
videos.overview: Kurian, Manoj and their team have been chasing Shiju all over. But how long can a man hide away if he is genuinely in love?

videos.title: Shuffle in the Capital
videos.overview: A sudden police department shake-up sets the stage for an unexpected convergence of officers Kurian, Noble and Ambili Raju, but Ambili goes AWOL.

videos.title: Ambili-Ayyappan Puzzle
videos.overview: As they dig deeper into Ambili's life, a bizarre connection to an ex-convict, Ayyappan, emerges, raising more questions than answers.

videos.title: Crossing Borders
videos.overview: Clues from Thiruvananthapuram and a mysterious incident in Ernakulam involving CI Manoj connect, forming a jigsaw puzzle for Noble to assemble.

videos.title: Noble's Instinct
videos.overview: With Manoj's warm support, Noble's unorthodox approach proves pivotal as he follows his instincts to connect the dots and uncover a crucial lead.

videos.title: Back to Square One
videos.overview: New revelations about Ayyappan send Noble and the team full circle, linking back to the mysterious incidents at the dog retirement shelter.

videos.title: Noble's Stadium Theory
videos.overview: With theories aligning but witnesses lacking, Noble is driven to validate his Central Stadium theory, which he's deeply invested in.

videos.title: Foundation of Love
videos.overview: Pappan oversees the work of Vinod's new home in Kerala. In Dubai, Vinod, who is building this home for his eager parents, meets Gouri. But a job loss throws his future into turmoil.

videos.title: Building Bridges
videos.overview: Gouri pushes for marriage and a move to Canada. With no job, a half-built house, a mounting debt, and disapproving families, what will Vinod do?

videos.title: Reinforced Romance
videos.overview: Vinod and Pappan try to fast-track the marriage registration, but a vindictive officer refuses to help them. As Vinod struggles with money, he gets shocking news.

videos.title: Bricks and Hearts
videos.overview: Vinod is hit with fraud, the secret about the wall collapse and more money struggles. As Gouri's father tightens control, her mother accuses their maid of theft.

videos.title: Sealing the Cracks
videos.overview: Vinod returns the pawned jewellery but gets into a fight with Gouri's dad. When rumours start flying linking Pappan and Gouri, Vinod and Gouri realise they have no time to lose.

videos.title: The Final Coat
videos.overview: While Gouri faces her angry father, Vinod challenges the overseer. At the registration office, Gouri finally loses her patience and temper when Vinod arrives really late.

videos.title: In love’s world, gender is irrelevant
Prequel
videos.overview: Sarah and her son, Bibin, live an isolated life. As loud cries of infants haunt Sarah, she scribbles names on her walls. What secret is she keeping?

videos.title: Sequel
videos.overview: Twelve years later, CI Aji Kurian, investigating the mysterious death of actor Ancy, finds himself drawn to the name Bibin. Sanjeev Krishna is devastated by his wife's death.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Merlin's revelations lead Aji Kurian to Sarah's letters. After unravelling Sarah's most twisted secret, Aji finds himself pulled into a dark vortex of truth.

videos.title: First Half
videos.overview: The unravelling of Bibin's cryptic letters begins. Clues lead Aji and his team to Bangalore towards another death. The mystery tightens its grip.

videos.title: Interval
videos.overview: Bibin's puppeteering of human lives takes him to a prominent politician. As Aji digs deeper, he meets with fresh challenges and dreadful questions.

videos.title: Second Half
videos.overview: A tapestry of truths, theories and mysteries woven together by Aji reveals the scary extent of Bibin's killing spree. However, Aji faces a threat more perilous than Bibin. What is it?

videos.title: Anti-Climax
videos.overview: The endgame. The ultimate gamble. Aji and his team are locked in a deadly game where the stakes are high. In this life-or-death showdown, whose truth will prevail?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Mahendran, the deputy tehsildar, agrees to help Joseph, a man facing legal issues due a name mismatch in his mother's documents, upon learning that he is a close friend of a Member of Parliament. Meanwhile, the impending monsoon leads to concerns with the public over a dam that may breach due to heavy rainfall.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mahendran asks Biju to create a certificate that would help the old lady but not be used as a political weapon against him. Meanwhile, the office employees bid farewell to Tehsildar Shibu, who is replaced by Tehsildar Shobha, who has a different way of running things.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mahendran is displeased with Shobha's posting, as Prajas approaches him pledging to forget his political affiliation and join Mahendran's union if he is relieved from control room duty. Meanwhile, Shobha notices that Mahendran is not in office and marks a half-day against his attendance, infuriating him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The news of Mahendran and Shobha's suspension creates headlines in the media. While Shobha is devastated, Mahendran looks for support from his political party. However, the leaders wash their hands off the scandal and tell him there's nothing they can do for him.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Biju agrees to help Mahendran when he realises that the only way to trap those responsible for the scandal is to investigate the land document records. When news of the corruption in the land distributed to the 48 families breaks, Aravindan is pressured to find out how the files were leaked. Meanwhile, Unni tells Shobha that it would be easier to pay the bribe than expect a fair investigation.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After joining hands with Shobha to clear both their names, Mahendran meets with the leader of the opposite faction of the ruling party. Later, at a protest, Harichandran is attacked by goons who disguised themselves as the minister's supporters.

videos.title: Jaanaki
videos.overview: When an opportunity to go to the Gulf arises, Nagendran finds himself short of funds. Soman proposes an unconventional solution: marriage.

videos.title: Lillykutty
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman arrive in Pathanamthitta to see Lillykutty. While Lillykutty weaves her influence over Nagendran, can he secure Varkey’s elusive approval?

videos.title: Laila
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman encounter Laila in Kasaragod. Her mysterious past ensnares Nagendran with fear. Can he break free from her grasp?

videos.title: Saavithri
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman reach Palakkad to acquire the necessary funds and meet Saavithri. Can Nagendran save her, or will he get trapped in the palls of a dilapidated Brahmin household?

videos.title: Thangam
videos.overview: Why are the locals rushing to marry off Thangam? Nagendran meets Thangam in Kuttanad and struggles to outwit the locals. He and Soman try to escape from Varkey’s grasp.

videos.title: Mozhi
videos.overview: Bewitched by Mozhi at first sight, Nagendran is not able to deceive her. Tensions rise as he and Soman clash for the first time. Can Nagendran forge a new life with Mozhi?

videos.title: The Confessor
videos.overview: The Confessor Aruku, a guilt-stricken man, confesses to the murder of elephants, setting a group of forest officers and NGO workers into action — hunting for justice across India.

videos.title: The Crusader
videos.overview: The Crusader Mala and Alan crack the poachers’ call logs, which leads to their first dangerous raid on unsuspecting locals.

videos.title: The Scapegoat
videos.overview: The Scapegoat The group closes in on the gang leader, Raaz, leading to a shocking discovery when they find him.

videos.title: The Blind Eye
videos.overview: The Blind Eye Mala goes on her own to pursue the truth about Raaz, while Alan must mend his collapsing marriage with Achala.

videos.title: The Kidnapping
videos.overview: The Kidnapping Alan leads an effort to kidnap a local corrupt politician - unbeknownst to Achala - while Mala must confront the true danger she’s put everyone in as the team becomes deeper ensnared in the threatening world of animal poaching.

videos.title: The Jungle
videos.overview: The Jungle Months earlier, the poaching gang assembles and heads into the jungle for the elephant hunt; while in present day, Aruku leads Mala and her team into the jungle to retrace their steps to the crime scene.

videos.title: The Big Fish
videos.overview: The Big Fish Racing against the clock, Mala and Alan travel to Delhi to pursue the big fish - the well-connected ivory dealer - and along the way must come up with a plan to smuggle her back to Kerala, where they have the jurisdiction to arrest her.

videos.title: The Graveyard
videos.overview: The Graveyard Mala and her team face riotous crowds and corrupt local officials in Delhi while attempting to seize the largest cache of ivory in Indian history.

videos.title: Welcome to Perilloor
videos.overview: To be in power after being barred from the upcoming elections, Peethambaran, the long-standing Panchayat president, convinces his niece to contest. Will Malavika agree?

videos.title: Not Heaven, But Hell
videos.overview: Realising the trouble she invited, Malavika and her aunt scheme to intentionally lose the election. Finally, she seeks the help of Psycho Balachandran.

videos.title: Fox 1, Tiger 0
videos.overview: Winning by one vote, a reluctant Malavika becomes the Panchayat president. After spurning Malavika, Sreekuttan's desire to wed backfires each time he goes bride-seeing.

videos.title: Reality Bites
videos.overview: With the mahout's son missing from the village, the Panchayat president Malavika faces a crisis. Sneha confesses her love for Sreekuttan, and he finally feels hopeful.

videos.title: All Hope Lost
videos.overview: When Sreekuttan's shop faces a crisis, he blames Malavika and vows revenge against her. Little does he know the cause of his problem is someone else.

videos.title: Unleashing Fury
videos.overview: Malavika defies her uncle over a controversial project. While an investigation is awaited, more ploys by Peethambaran lead to heartbreak and drastic decisions.

videos.title: Thank You, Visit Again
videos.overview: As pranks, prophecies, treasure hunts, weddings and farewells unfold, things take a strange turn for Malavika and Sreekuttan.

videos.title: Oh My Dog
videos.overview: Did they fight? Are they having problems? What is with the knife? Riya and Binoy's parents have more questions for the loving couple as they barge into their house unannounced.

videos.title: Om Shanthi Home
videos.overview: The parents' intervention complicates matters for Binoy and Riya, and the blame game begins. In the middle of all that, a guest arrives.

videos.title: Happy Hours
videos.overview: After the peace in the house is fully disrupted, the couple gets a call from their friend and neighbour, Adarsh, who is up to no good and wants their help to deal with his wife.

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: Riya loses her patience with Aniyamma and Kuriyachan and blames them for insulting their guest. Things get worse when a prospective marriage proposal turns into a religious war.

videos.title: Song of Songs
videos.overview: Riya and Binoy realise that their parents' problems are more grave than theirs. Many surprises unfold as their inner conflicts come to light.

videos.title: The Story Of Yeshu's Birth

videos.title: Laying Plans
videos.overview:
The Calculations!

Ajayan, a failed writer, turns up on a live television show and announces that he is going to commit 7 perfect murders in 7 days. As the audience goes into panic the police force assemble outside the studio to stop him. But when he reveals the victim’s identity, every one is baffled. Will Ajayan kill on-air as he claims?

videos.title: Waging War
videos.overview: A police team is assembled under DySP Jacob Anookkaran, to investigate the crime. Ajayan announces the second victim. Jacob’s immediate challenge is to find out if Ajayan’s threat is real. Will a lonely war veteran, be saved by Jacob ?

videos.title: Attack by Stratagem
videos.overview: Ajayan chooses his next victim on the basis of “gender equality”. What is equality, when a man is playing god with the lives of others? Will Jacob and team be able to save this victim before their one hour runs out?

videos.title: Weak and Strong Points
videos.overview: Hope of Success ! A master puppeteer he claims. He pulls the strings of not just the victim, but the police force too, it appears. He sheds some feeble light on his motivation. Will that help save the victim? Finally a win for the police, looks like.

videos.title: Maneuvring
videos.overview: Mixed bag! Police find Ajayan’s last victim. The team also manages to figure out his methods and motives. Will it be enough to save the next victim? On the personal front, Jacob gets a much needed closure. Ajayan’s latest message throws some key que

videos.title: Variation in Tactics
videos.overview: Watch where you tread! The deaths send ripples across the society. On her show Sumitra continues to bring to the fore Ajayan’s real message- that all lives matter. Jacob seeks the help of Lucas, a tech expert, to track victims.

videos.title: The Army on the March
videos.overview: Puzzle unraveled? With Lucas on board, identifying the victim is a little easier. Someone connected to Ajayan surfaces and Jacob discovers a deeper pattern behind Ajayan’s choice of victims. The team is still reeling from the last blow.

videos.title: The Attack By Fire
videos.overview: The last straw! The team has been on a long and arduous journey. And the end is in sight. But this is their last chance, one small misstep and there's no coming back from it. Who is the final victim? Will the team succeed or fail?

videos.title: The Nine Situations
videos.overview: The final showdown. Time is running out and the end that was in sight is quickly moving further away. There is a vital piece of the puzzle missing. Will the team figure it out or is Ajayan one too many steps ahead?

videos.title: Training Ground
videos.overview: Jacob takes a break from his regular work and decides to travel back to Mottakkara, where it all started. In the past, we see a young Jacob, taking charge as the S.I. and making friends, enemies and hopes of love.

videos.title: Secret Conducts
videos.overview: In the present, Jacob tries to find out more about the person who attacked him. In the past, a petty crime and the decisions made by Jacob, sets off the dominoes of death in the hill town.

videos.title: Calamities
videos.overview: The first death in the town, turns the locals against the police team. As Jacob and his men investigate the mystery, a new tragedy hits them.

videos.title: Six fold Strategy
videos.overview: The death of a much loved and respected colleague rips through the morale of the team. The investigation falters with little support from the locals. Jacob finds a new ally, who might be able to help them out.

videos.title: Eradication of Thorns
videos.overview: The ongoing series of deaths confuses everyone. Is a bigger force at play here? Jacob and team investigate a new possibility.

videos.title: Capturing a fort
videos.overview: Jacob and team are at loss trying to figure out who the next victim could be. Nothing and nowhere is safe, as the threat turns up at their doorstep.

videos.title: Weaker King
videos.overview: Jacob makes one final attempt to trap the possible killers. But, in the process, someone close to him makes a decision, which proves fatal.

videos.title: Basis of the circle
videos.overview: The Jacob of the present is finally able to understand the sequences that took place in his past. Will this prove to be the journey of his redemption? Then again, does Ajayan have a bigger plan?

videos.title: New Set Of Challenges
videos.overview: The contestants get an interesting task of dedicating proverbs to each other. Who will impress Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Twists And Turns In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns Snehan to give tongue-twisters to each contestant but the real twist comes when Juliana makes a decision!

videos.title: Big Boss Annual School Festival
videos.overview: Will Gayathri’s request to Bigg Boss for chocolate powder be accepted? Meanwhile, Bigg Boss asks Snehan to organise an annual school function with a skit and a singing and dance performance. Who will shine?

videos.title: Who Is Next?
videos.overview: Adding to the drama, Kamal Haasan surprises everyone with a no elimination episode. He questions the contestants about the Bigg Boss school and Juliana's fight. The housemates are given a task to shop food items. Who will leave the house this week?

videos.title: Unexpected Turn Of Events!
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss contestants are stunned when Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant. Why are they surprised?

videos.title: Bharani's Dramatic Escape Attempt
videos.overview: A frustrated Bharani tries to escape from the house by jumping over the wall. Will the Bigg Boss evict him?

videos.title: Virumaandis In The House!
videos.overview: The contestants dress up as Kamal Haasan's movie character, Virumaandi and dance whenever the songs assigned to them are played. Later, Bigg Boss punishes Aarav and Raisa. Why?

videos.title: Contestants Become 'Superstars'!
videos.overview: The contestants become Superstar Rajinikanth's movie character Padaiyappa and rock the house. Bigg Boss asks Ganesh to predict the order in which his fellow contestants are going to get evicted!

videos.title: Thala-Thalapathy Fever
videos.overview: As part of today's task, the contestants dress up like superstars Ajith and Vijay and perform a dance marathon!

videos.title: Juliana Is The Hot Topic
videos.overview: The drama quotient increases exponentially as Juliana becomes the topic of discussion among the housemates. Namita has two days to learn Tamil, while Razia and Snehan quarrel over the food.

videos.title: Raiza Bears The Brunt
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes Raiza for her frequently speaking in English. Kamal Haasan asks some challenging questions to the contestants. Will it create unrest in the house?

videos.title: A Dramatic Eviction
videos.overview: Amidst tension, Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. What does Bharani say about his escape attempt?

videos.title: Who Will Rule The House?
videos.overview: Shakthi, Oviya and Namitha compete in an endurance challenge to be the new leader. Who will get to rule the house?

videos.title: A Thief In The House?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a character to each contestant and asks them to protect a diamond from being stolen. But, who is the thief?

videos.title: The Hunt Begins!
videos.overview: The contestants learn that the diamond has been stolen and try to find the thief. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Tamil Thalaivas In The House
videos.overview: Tamil Thalaivas, Tamil Nadu's Pro Kabaddi League team visit and play a Kabaddi match with the Bigg Boss housemates. Later, the joy in the house disappears when Juliana falls ill!

videos.title: Nine Against One?
videos.overview: Namita and Gayathri ask the other contestants to stand with them against Oviya. The contestants compete in a fast food challenge.

videos.title: Kamal Reveals Oviya's Truth
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan makes each contestant understand the issue involving Oviya.

videos.title: Eviction Creates Confusion
videos.overview: As Kamal Haasan prepares to announce the name of the evicted contestant, Gayathri and Juliana rejoice assuming that there is no eviction this week. But is it true?

videos.title: Who Will Win?
videos.overview: Juliana tries convincing Aarav that Oviya is lying. Later, Aarav and Snehan compete in an interesting game to become this week's leader.

videos.title: Cycling Task Irks Vaiyapuri
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks assigns a cycling task to the contestants but Vaiyapuri isn't happy about it. Why?

videos.title: Oviya, Gayathri Become Reporters
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks Oviya and Gayathri to become news reporters and interview all the housemates. How will this change things in the house?

videos.title: Who Is The Jr Bigg Boss?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants by reducing their luxury budget points and assigns a task to select the Junior Bigg Boss of the house. Who will it be?

videos.title: Oviya, Juliana Clash
videos.overview: As part of a task, Juliana assigns Oviya to put out a red carpet for her. But, it ends in a fight. How?

videos.title: Kamal Sets Things Right
videos.overview: The contestants enact a scene from the movie "Avvai Shanmugi" with a motive. Kamal Hassan sets things right between the contestants.

videos.title: Welcome The New Contestant
videos.overview: Secrets are revealed as everyone gets a chance to talk for each other and answer Kamal Hassan's questions. A new contestant enters the house. Who is it?

videos.title: Shock Treatment!
videos.overview: Bindu Madhavi has a task for everyone that makes them run. Bigg Boss gives everybody a task of giving someone a shock treatment. Who is the bait?

videos.title: Oviya Isolates Herself
videos.overview: Oviya sleeps outside the living area, doesn't participate in the tasks, and snubs other contestants. Meanwhile, Aarav continues to avoid her. Will someone solve her problems?

videos.title: Oviya Wants To Leave
videos.overview: Bigg Boss organises a tug of war in the house. An unstable Oviya says that she wants to leave the house. Will she?

videos.title: Oviya Exits!
videos.overview: The crowd gives a massive reception to their favourite as Oviya leaves the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Another Departure!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan speaks personally to each contestant about the incidents that led to Oviya's exit and announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who will it be?

videos.title: A Surprising Decision!
videos.overview: After asking the contestants to give their eviction nominations for the week, Bigg Boss stuns everyone with an announcement. What is it?

videos.title: A Battle On The Cards
videos.overview: Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams with separate luxury budget points, based on their performance. Will it create a conflict?

videos.title: Unrest In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns some contestants with an alternative task as they are unhappy with the laundry task. Someone gets scared after the task is performed. What happened?

videos.title: Who Is The Lucky One?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss announces that one of the contestants can be saved from eviction and asks them to cast their votes. Later, there's a rift between Gayathri and Raiza.

videos.title: Elimination Advantage Challenge
videos.overview: A thief and clown gain entry into the house and do their best to disturb everyone. Each contestant has to answer 5 questions to gain advantage in this week's elimination. Who will win this task?

videos.title: Sathish And Sripriya Visit
videos.overview: Actors Sathish Krishnan and Sripriya visit the show with questions for Bigg Boss on his elimination strategy and situation handling with contestants and more.

videos.title: Whose Turn Is it?
videos.overview: The contestants aren't in a mood to celebrate the 50th day in the house as Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant!

videos.title: Open Nominations
videos.overview: The contestants compete in a game to become the leader for the week. Bigg Boss asks each contestant to give their eviction nominations in the presence of others!

videos.title: Ghost In The House?
videos.overview: The contestants give a short speech about India, on the occasion of Independence day. Later, Snehan and Aarav try to scare Bindu. What's their plan?

videos.title: Another Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: Raiza is annoyed with Vaiyapuri's behaviour. Later, a new contestant enters the house as a wild card entry. Who is it?

videos.title: A Surprising Entry!
videos.overview: Snehan and Bindu play a prank on Suja. Gayatri and Aarav are mad at Snehan. Later, the contestants are in for a surprise as a new member joins them.

videos.title: VJ Kajal In The House
videos.overview: Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are unhappy after the rice packing challenge. Later, VJ Kajal makes a dramatic entry. Is she in the house to stay?

videos.title: Kamal Loses His Cool
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan lashes out at the contestants for disrespecting Bigg Boss and decides to speak only to the newcomers. Later, the contestants answer some controversial questions from the viewers.

videos.title: Who Leaves This Week?
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan questions the housemates regarding the nominated contestants Raiza and Gayathri and announces the name of the evicted contestant. Later, there are some controversial questions aimed at the evicted one.

videos.title: Who Is The New Leader?
videos.overview: The newcomers compete in an exciting game to become the leader for the week. Later, the contestants give their eviction nominations!

videos.title: A Nomination Chain!
videos.overview: Aarav gets nominated for next week's eviction after pressing a buzzer but has a chance to transfer his nomination. How?

videos.title: Raiza In Trouble Again!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants for sleeping during the day and seeks an explanation from Raiza for the same. Meanwhile, Bindu has a tough task ahead.

videos.title: Killers In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss tells the contestants that there are two killers in the house and assigns Vaiyapuri and Kajal the task to catch them. Who are the killers and what's their modus operandi?

videos.title: Double Murder Mystery
videos.overview: Bigg Boss welcomes the housemates to the Bigg Boss Wrestling Federation. Ganesh and Raiza are killed by the mysterious killers. Are the others safe?

videos.title: The People's Court
videos.overview: The killers reveal themselves after two more murders. Some housemates get a chance to confront others, the legal way.

videos.title: Surprise Or Shock?
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan stuns everyone by introducing a new pattern for conducting the eviction. Does he have more surprises up his sleeve?

videos.title: Unexpected Visitors!
videos.overview: The contestants give their eviction nominations for the week. Later, they are astonished when two guests arrive at the house!

videos.title: Madurai Team Vs NRI Team
videos.overview: Bigg Boss divides the housemates into 2 teams and asks them to compete against each other. But, the first task itself creates some problems!

videos.title: Shift Of Power!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss announces that the Madurai team will gain control of the house and NRI team members should serve them. Later, Julie gets grilled about her equation with Oviya and Aarav.

videos.title: Wedding Bells in The House
videos.overview: Harish and Bindu get married but have to compete with Aarav and Suja to succeed in their marriage. Aarav gets hurt during the task. Will Harish win?

videos.title: Bindu is Punished!
videos.overview: Bindu is punished for delaying in doing a task Bigg Boss assigned to her. Aarthi and Juli argue when Bigg Boss asks them to decide the winning team.

videos.title: An Attempt to Prank Kamal
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the contestants to enact some scenes that happened in the house and also asks them to play a prank on Kamal Haasan. Will the housemates succeed?

videos.title: It's Eviction Time!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. Aarav is arrested and taken out by masked men in black, but one masked man stays in the house. What's the plan?

videos.title: Leader Election
videos.overview: Bigg Boss introduces a new method to choose the leader for the week. Later, the housemates submit their eviction nominations. Who will get maximum votes?

videos.title: The Boss Says 'Stop'
videos.overview: Bigg Boss introduces an interesting task called 'Freeze and Release'. Later, Juliana gets annoyed by something that Aarthi does.

videos.title: Bigg Boss' Surprise!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss continues the 'Freeze and Release' task and gives heartwarming surprises to Vaiyapuri, Bindu and Harish. Later, an endurance task creates tension in the house!

videos.title: Loved Ones Visit!
videos.overview: Snehan finds it difficult to control his tears when his father comes all the way from his village to see him. Ganesh also receives a delightful surprise!

videos.title: Sweet Surprise for Aarav and Suja
videos.overview: Aarav and Suja are happy when some visitors take them by surprise. Bindu loses a bag of chocolates. Did someone steal it?

videos.title: Vishnu, Catherine in the House
videos.overview: Actors Vishnu Vishal and Catherine Tresa stun everyone with their surprise entry and claim to be the new wild card entries. Are they?

videos.title: A Surprise for Suja
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan announces that Harish and Bindu are safe. Later, he asks Suja to come out of the house. What's in store for her?

videos.title: Aarav Leads The Way
videos.overview: Bigg Boss chooses Aarav as this week's leader. The housemates are surprised to see Suja back in the house. Later, they give their eviction nominations for the week.

videos.title: Ticket to The Finale!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives the housemates an endurance task to win points and secure the ticket to the finale. Looks like the real fight has just begun!

videos.title: Snehan, Suja Won't Give Up
videos.overview: As Snehan and Suja refuse to end the task, Bigg Boss toughens up the rules. After hours of endurance, will the two finally give in to Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Housemates In Knots
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to form pairs, tie each other and free themselves from a complicated knot, as part of the ticket to finale task. Later, they show their artistic talents!

videos.title: All for a Ticket to the Finale
videos.overview: The men wear Bindu's dress, do a ramp walk and dance around the house. The housemates express themselves to win points and the ticket to the finale.

videos.title: Steal and Win Points
videos.overview: Bigg Boss tells the housemates to steal things from other housemates and drop it in a basket for points. Harish, Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are nominated for eviction.

videos.title: Kamal In the House
videos.overview: Kamal goes inside the house to hand over the Golden Ticket to a surprise winner. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who is it?

videos.title: Fight to Escape Eviction
videos.overview: Bigg Boss says that everyone, except Snehan is nominated for this week's eviction and gives them a way to escape. Later, a task turns a tad bit violent.

videos.title: The Egg Challenge
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next Ticket to the Finale?

videos.title: Angels Vs Demons
videos.overview: The contestants divide themselves into teams of angels and demons for the second part of the Ticket To Finale tasks. What are they supposed to do?

videos.title: Role Reversal
videos.overview: As Aarav, Harish and Bindu fail to open the locker, Bigg Boss asks the demons to become angels and vice versa. Will the new demons win?

videos.title: The Egg Challenge
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next ticket to the finale?

videos.title: Kamal's Important Announcement
videos.overview: The contestants are assigned various tasks with eggs hanging from their necks! Kamal Haasan makes an important announcement regarding the Finale points. What is it?

videos.title: Who Will Snehan Save?
videos.overview: Snehan can save Ganesh or Suja from eviction by giving his points to them. Who will be the lucky one?

videos.title: Actress Anjali Visits
videos.overview: The housemates give a grand welcome to the gorgeous actress Anjali, from the upcoming movie Balloon. What exciting tasks will she come up with?

videos.title: Dance Marathon is Back!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to dress up like movie characters and dance whenever the song assigned to them is played. Later, Snehan gets emotional thinking about leaving the house.

videos.title: Bigg Boss Makes a Tempting Offer
videos.overview: Bigg Boss offers a huge amount of money to the housemates to leave the house immediately. Will anyone take the bait?

videos.title: The Last Eviction!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss arranges an award function for the housemates. Find out who among the last 5 contestants get evicted.

videos.title: Freeze to Get Surprises!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss brings back the Freeze And Release task to give the housemates some delightful surprises. Snehan writes a brilliant song about their stay in the house!

videos.title: Aarav or Snehan?
videos.overview: After the finalists celebrate with evicted participants, Ganesh Venkatraman and Harish find themselves out of the house. The contest is then between Aarav and Snehan. Who will be the winner of Season 1 of Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Kamal Haasan Kickstarts Season 2
videos.overview: Superstar, Kamal Haasan kickstarts the show with sixteen interesting housemates eager to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss house. Watch 'The Legend' get the ball rolling, however, with a twist in the tale.

videos.title: Day 1 in the House
videos.overview: Three candidates, one captain. Who among Janani, Mumtaz and Mahat will take charge as the first captain of Bigg Boss Season 2?

videos.title: Day 2 in the House
videos.overview: Problems are many and Janani desperately needs to prove her mettle as a captain. Will she succeed amidst all the luxury budget ruckus?

videos.title: Day 3 in the House
videos.overview: The shackles have come off and the first ever argument breaks out among the contestants. Watch Nithya's adamant demeanour turn her into the villain of the house.

videos.title: Day 4 in the House
videos.overview: A major rule violation has led to the contestants losing a significant part of their budget. What did they do?

videos.title: Day 5 in the House
videos.overview: Aishwarya and Janani kiss while Mumtaz and Bhalajie wear diapers and act like kids. All is not well between Mumtaz and Nithya. Janani is asked to name the underperfomers after three housemates are applauded for their efforts.

videos.title: Day 6 in the House
videos.overview: From the contestants' first-week experiences to Nithya and Mumtaz's onion fiasco, Kamal Haasan is here to peel it all out, layer by layer. Watch the drama unfold.

videos.title: Day 7 in the House
videos.overview: A happy ride takes a dramatic turn when Kamal Haasan brings the eviction back into focus. Who will pack their bags?

videos.title: Day 8 in the House
videos.overview: From being dominating personalities to their inability to handle a joke, the seniors are facing backlash, every step of the way. Are they being targeted for elimination?

videos.title: Day 9 in the House
videos.overview: Mumtaz and Mamathi turning rebellious has created an unrest during the master-servant task. Witness the ruckus in its purest form where solution is just a far-fetched idea.

videos.title: Day 10 in the House
videos.overview: Mumtaz disobeys Bigg Boss's order to wear her mic. Aishwarya and Yashika's raunchy dance has the men at the edge of their seats.

videos.title: Day 11 in the House
videos.overview: The tides have turned as the roles in the master-servant task have been reversed. From the husband-wife rivalry to Daniel's arrogance, witness the struggle as the house becomes an arena of total chaos.

videos.title: It's Men Vs Women!
videos.overview: A task has the housemates debating over who plays an active role in maintaining a relationship, men or women? What happens when the task ends up in an argument between two people of the same gender?

videos.title: Fake, Faker, Fakest!
videos.overview: On the brink of eliminations, the tensed housemates are in for a nail-biting session as Kamal Haasan exposes their two-faced nature, one by one.

videos.title: Groove Before You Move!
videos.overview: A groovy night comes to a screeching halt as Mamathi, Ananth and Mumtaz face their judgment day. Amidst the symphonious celebration with Kamal Haasan and Shruti Haasan, who's living their final moments in the house?

videos.title: Wrong Path to Captaincy!
videos.overview: On their run for captaincy, one amongst Vaishnavi and Senrayan reveals the secret task assigned to them. Will it result in a disqualification?

videos.title: Injustice in the House?
videos.overview: The new luxury budget task is testing Vaishnavi's captaincy as she faces criticism for her unfair evaluation. Is she doing justice to her role?

videos.title: Mumtaz has a Upper Hand
videos.overview: In the heat of the luxury budget task, the housemates engage in fierce arguments while Bhalajie opts deception as the best tactic to win. However, Mumtaz is unlikely to be fooled.

videos.title: Mumtaz Proves Herself!
videos.overview: Birthday girl, Mumtaz shows that she is in it to win. Watch as she finishes the last leg of the luxury budget task with ease where the other contestants are struggling.

videos.title: A Conjecture of Separation
videos.overview: While some of the housemates gang up on each other over trivial issues, Bigg Boss sets the stage for the contestants to pour out their feelings for their loved ones.

videos.title: Kamal Haasan in Tears
videos.overview: The Universal Actor, Kamal Haasan sheds tears on stage, listening to Daniel's heartbreaking story. Amidst the overwhelming emotions, one among the nominated escapes eliminations.

videos.title: The Evicted Holds Authority!
videos.overview: As the door to reality slides open, Ponnambalam and Ananth take their final steps towards eviction. Who amongst the housemates will make an exit and win a chance to sentence a jail term?

videos.title: United for Ponnambalam
videos.overview: Anand's decision to send Ponnambalam to jail has the housemates begging Bigg Boss to reconsider the decision. Mahat, Yashika and Aishwarya's friendship is on the line as they are forced to make a tough decision.

videos.title: Ponnambalam's Unexpected Move
videos.overview: As the eager contestants buckle up for the upcoming task, the house decends into total chaos after Ponnambalam does something unexpected.

videos.title: Taking It Too Far!
videos.overview: A major breach of the rules in the task brings out the nasty side of the contestants. From cut throat arguments to a few housemates quitting the game midway, it's a bigg confusion in the house.

videos.title: Everything Has a Price
videos.overview: The luxury budget task has the commoners coming up with ingenious ways to make the others cough up money. Catch what happens when Bigg Boss gives the housemates a chance to resolve all their conflicts.

videos.title: Kadaikutty Singam in the House
videos.overview: Karthi and Soori's surprise visit to the house has the contestants in a festive mood. Catch the cast of Kadaikutty Singam as they join the housemates in a fun-filled game of dumb charades.

videos.title: Through Hunger and Poverty
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan questions Ramya regarding her poor judgment as a captain. Catch Senrayan and Kamal Haasan share their heart-wrenching experience with hunger and poverty.

videos.title: Kamal Haasan Gets Playful
videos.overview: As the clock ticks closer to eviction, Kamal Haasan gets playful before making the big announcement. Will it be Aishwarya's best friend, Yashika or Bhalajie's love, Nithya?

videos.title: Sneak Peek to Finale?
videos.overview: The captaincy task has Mahat, Bhalajie and Shariq choosing their helper who will take the plunge for them. Catch the housemates reveal their thoughts of who might be the finalist.

videos.title: Recite Your Flaws with Snehan
videos.overview: Wearing a school uniform and coming to terms with their flaws through poems with hidden meanings is the only way to win a luxury budget. Who will win the special appreciation from Snehan?

videos.title: Aishwarya Pens Her Feelings
videos.overview: Aishwarya writes a heartfelt letter to her special friend. Tune in to find out why the housemates reveal their emotions and frustrations to Vaishnavi.

videos.title: Senrayan Faces the Heat
videos.overview: Senrayan stands in the line of fire when his repeated questioning leads to a major brawl. Will it be a moment of self-realisation as special guests from various children's homes share their life stories with the contestants?

videos.title: Daniel Gains Authority
videos.overview: The contestants are tasked to introduce their favourite personality from among the housemates. Later, the nominated contestants are given an opportunity to justify themselves. By the powers vested by Bigg Boss, Daniel sends a housemate to jail.

videos.title: Ponnambalam’s Many Problems
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan gives a social message after Ponnambalam speaks about his childhood. Ponnambalam and Vaishnavi complain about a housemate to Kamal Haasan. All is not well between Ponnambalam and Aishwarya. Why?

videos.title: Will Ramya's Wish Come True?
videos.overview: With the threat of elimination looming over her head, Ramya confesses to Kamal Haasan that she would be much happier away from all the conflicts and drama of the house. Tune in to find out if her wish comes true.

videos.title: Time for Punishment
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes Mahat for being the one to break most of the rules in the house. Watch what happens when Vaishnavi tries to clear Aishwarya's misconceptions.

videos.title: Shariq Gets Grilled
videos.overview: While the housemates fight during the luxury budget task which is dedicated in honour of the Kargil Heroes, Shariq gets grilled when he tries to bring peace in the house.

videos.title: Mumtaj and Shariq Lock Horns!
videos.overview: Mumtaj's attempt to set foot into the other team's territory turns into an ugly dispute between her and Shariq. With fingers being pointed at one another and ego's hurt, is this an end to the mother-son relationship between the two?

videos.title: Mumtaz, a Villain?
videos.overview: Mumtaz's adamant demeanour topped by her rudeness is testing the contestants' patience, one task at a time. Will Shariq manage to mellow it down as the captain, or will they stand up against her?

videos.title: Dogfight for Dominance
videos.overview: Mahat openly disobeys his team leader's orders. The unique luxury budget task has the housemates engage in a brutal battle for dominance.

videos.title: Vishwaroopam 2 Cast in the House
videos.overview: The housemates join Andrea Jeremiah, Pooja Kumar and the crew of Vishwaroopam 2 as they launch the latest song from the film. Witness the contestants confess their opinions about their fellow housemates.

videos.title: Fate of the Nominated
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan kicks off the show in a playful mood with funny bloopers from around the house. Tune into find out the fate that awaits the nominated housemates in this nail-biting episode.

videos.title: Bhalajie Faces the Heat!
videos.overview: A house meeting turns ugly when Aishwarya lashes out at Bhalajie for using abusive language. Catch all the action and drama as the contestants are divided into two teams for the Maggi cooking challenge.

videos.title: All Hail the Queen
videos.overview: Some of the contestants are in for a tough time as Aishwarya is made the queen of the house as a part of this week's luxury budget task. A major drama unfolds in the house as Aishwarya dumps garbage on Bhalajie during the task.

videos.title: Aishwarya, a Tyrant?
videos.overview: Aishwarya's rule has the housemates dissatisfied and rebelling against her decisions. Tune in to witness Bhalajie protest against her show of power.

videos.title: End to Aishwarya's Dictatorship?
videos.overview: Aishwarya orders all the housemates to be jailed. Tune in to find out what happens when the housemates decide to put an end to her tyrannical rule.

videos.title: Ghajinikanth in the House!
videos.overview: Arya and the cast of Ghajinikanth spend a fun-filled evening with the housemates. Tune in to find out what punishment awaits the housemates for breaking the rules of the house.

videos.title: Kamal Haasan Demands Answers!
videos.overview: Aishwarya challenges Mumtaz to prove herself by winning the competition. Join Kamal Haasan as he questions the housemates about their actions during the task.

videos.title: An Emotional Farewell
videos.overview: Tears break out in the house as an unexpected eviction leaves the housemates in shock. Catch all the fun and drama as the contestants celebrate Riythvika's birthday.

videos.title: What's Your Complaint?
videos.overview: It's finally time to address the issues inside the house as each contestant is asked to jot down the injustices faced by them. Watch the drama unfold as some of the housemates accuse Daniel of playing a double game.

videos.title: Get Into the Character!
videos.overview: After an intense court session, the contestants are in for a fun time as they are given a role-playing activity. Things get interesting as one team is given a secret task to trigger certain reactions out of the other team members.

videos.title: Prayers for M. Karunanidhi
videos.overview: Mahat goes an extra mile in his attempt to impersonate Mumtaz. Catch the housemates as they pay their heartfelt last respect to M. Karunanidhi.

videos.title: No More Luxury Supplies?
videos.overview: Janani makes a calculation error that threatens the entire house's luxury supplies. Join the housemates as they speak a few words about M. Karunanidhi.

videos.title: Love Is in the Air!

videos.title: Day 54: Special Guests and Squabbles
videos.overview: Child artists of the Hotstar Specials show Parachute, visit the house. Later, Manjari raises a food issue with Arun, and the argument intensifies when Captain Deepak gets involved.

videos.title: Day 55: From Controversies to Captaincy
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan probes the housemates on this week's issues, from the Arun-Manjari fallout to Sachana’s unacceptable walkout. Later, he applauds captain Deepak.

videos.title: Day 56: VJS Reviews the Doll Task
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi discusses about the Doll task in detail. Strategies, gameplays and fights are questioned, while the nominated ones prepare for the eviction.

videos.title: Day 57: New Leaders Step In
videos.overview: Jeffry and Sachana are appointed captain and vice-captain respectively. The quirky shopping task stirs frustration, while Arun and Manjari resolve their differences.

videos.title: Day 58: Ranking Task with a Twist
videos.overview: After a morning activity on activeness, the housemates rank each other based on their goodwill. Tables turn when BB declares the top eight as Angels, and the rest as Demons.

videos.title: Day 59: Angels vs Devils
videos.overview: Intense emotional stress and physical challenges in the task lead the Angels to cry and argue. Meanwhile, the Devils face growing tensions within their ranks.

videos.title: Day 60: Role Reversal Round
videos.overview: BB asks the Devils to declare the count of hearts collected, and begin the next round by swapping roles. Angels of round one get set to take revenge.

videos.title: Day 61: Whom Would You Choose?
videos.overview: After intense arguments for the Nomination Free Pass, the housemates choose their friends and foes. The worst performers get punished, while the best compete for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 62: Rules or Rebellion?
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi offers a mix of praise and advice on the housemates' roles as Devils and Angels. He questions the fairness of the Goa Gang's rules and their impact on the game.

videos.title: Day 63: Double Eviction
videos.overview: VJS discusses Jeffry’s leadership, ration concerns and task conflicts. The atmosphere shifts dramatically when he announces the unexpected double eviction.

videos.title: Day 64: Stuck with the Label
videos.overview: Captain Ranjith faces a housemate's dissatisfaction during his first task. Rayan and Arun engage in a mockery feud, while housemates wear badges with labels from nominations.

videos.title: Day 65: Managers vs Labourers
videos.overview: Arun and Deepak argue, after which the housemates pick the top and bottom contestants, leading to heated exchanges. Next, the manager vs labourer task creates chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 66: Swap! Swap! Swap!
videos.overview: Heated altercations ensue over team swaps between Managers and Labourers. Later, as Muthu's actions lead to a ban, the Managers punish him for his behaviour.

videos.title: Day 67: New Rules, New Conflicts
videos.overview: 2.0 of the task begins with some twists and changes, making labourers incharge of the household chores. Commotion ensues when the teams clash and rules get violated.

videos.title: Day 68: Vidhuthalai 2 Team Pays a Visit
videos.overview: Amidst the celebrations and conflicts, Raanav gets nominated while Jeffry wins the Free pass. The best-worst performers are selected, and special guests surprise the housemates.

videos.title: Day 69: Mind-bending Questions from VJS
videos.overview: A twist in the tale occurs as VJS decides to begin the day with an eviction. He addresses the housemates' concerns and some of his questions make them rethink their decisions.

videos.title: Day 70: VJS Checks on the Housemates
videos.overview: Ranjith's captaincy is discussed in detail, after which VJS advises him to change his approach. As one more housemate bid goodbye, the rest have a one-on-one discussion with VJS.

videos.title: Day 71: Captaincy and Open Nominations
videos.overview: Raanav's unexpected move in the captaincy task changes the dynamics, resulting in Vishal's victory. Post-task arguments and open nominations escalate tensions in the house.

videos.title: Day 72: Bricks and Bruises
videos.overview: Fierce arguments and clashes erupt as housemates fight to secure and steal bricks for the task. Moreover, tension builds when Raanav’s injury triggers strange speculations.

videos.title: Day 73: Team Tiffs
videos.overview: Raanav’s exit forces a reshuffle, while foul play allegations hit Jeffry’s team. Amid the chaos, Captain Vishal succumbs to the mounting pressure during the task.

videos.title: Day 74: Muyal 2.0
videos.overview: Three teams battle intensely to catch the most rabbits and claim the NF pass. Problems arisewhen the women engage in physical struggles and sharp exchanges.

videos.title: Day 75: BB Revokes Benefits
videos.overview: Jacquline receives an audience-assigned task that leaves her in tears. Contender Muthu’s gameplay during the task upsets BB who then makes shocking announcements.

videos.title: Day 76: Applauses with a Dose of Advice
videos.overview: VJS commends the housemates for their efforts in the weekly task. Later, he interrogates those who questioned Raanav’s injury and highlights the red team's performance issues.

videos.title: Day 77: Who Will Join VJS Onstage?
videos.overview: The housemates vote for the "Attenion-seeker" while VJS delves into the details of Vishal's captaincy. Muthu gets an earful for his behaviour, and everyone preps for the eviction.

videos.title: Day 78: Bigg Buzz Over the New Chef
videos.overview: Housemates get emotional as they talk about who they miss. After Soundarya cooks solo, BB announces no kitchen help from now on, sparking lively debates on future cooking duties.

videos.title: Day 79: Family Week
videos.overview: Emotions overflow as Deepak, Manjari and Rayan reunite with their families. Vishal’s joy doubles when his loved one unexpectedly makes an entrance.

videos.title: Day 80: Emotional Surprises
videos.overview: Soundarya, Raanav, Pavithra, and Anshida’s families arrive with surprises and reveal their concerns. In the midst of this, Soundarya and Jacqueline resolve their differences.

videos.title: Day 81: Happy Reunions
videos.overview: Arun’s sadness fades as BB reveals his prank and brings in his parents. Jeffry, Jacquline and Muthu’s families enter shortly after, turning the house into a whirlwind of happiness.

videos.title: Day 82: Support and Surprises
videos.overview: As tough weeks approach, the housemates' friends bring advice and encouragement. Arun is overjoyed to see Archana, while Erode Mahesh boosts the morale of all the housemates.

videos.title: Day 83: Saturday Eviction
videos.overview: VJS asks housemates about their family interactions and their thoughts on the contradictions shared. Later, the house is left in shock as he announces an unexpected eviction.

videos.title: Day 84: Ticket to Finale
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan prompts housemates to share new year resolutions and call out the least deserving of votes. Following an eviction, he reveals the much-anticipated Ticket to Finale.

videos.title: Day 85: And the Games Begins!
videos.overview: Open nominations lead to unrest in the house, while Soundarya and Muthu clash over shopping preferences. Later, BB kick-starts TTF week with the first quirky task.

videos.title: Day 86: A Tough Fight
videos.overview: The TTF challenge heats up with two tough tasks. Muthu and Raanav get into an altercation, while two others score points—who are they?

videos.title: Day 87: New Year, New Challenges
videos.overview: Muthu, Jacquline and Soundarya find housemates to execute their Phone tasks, but each face failure. Later, BB hosts a special New Year’s dinner with a twist.

videos.title: Day 88: Deals and Disputes
videos.overview: The scoreboard turns upside down after the Ball task. Manjari strikes a deal with Rayan, while the Points Mandrum task causes chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 89: One Last Call
videos.overview: Arun and Rayan compete to pick up the last call from BB, while Soundarya and Raanav engage in a heated argument. Meanwhile, the top TTF scorers battle it out in the final round.

videos.title: Day 90: VJS Questions the Strategy
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan asks the house who they believe does not deserve the TTF and why. Further, he analyses the impact of alliances in the game, with Muthu admitting to his errors.

videos.title: Day 91: Meet Your First Finalist
videos.overview: VJS questions the housemates on who they think deserved to stay in the game. Moments later, the house erupts with excitement as he enters the house to announce the TTF winner.

videos.title: Day 92: Wildcard Knockout!
videos.overview: Soundarya sobs from the criticism, while the wildcard announcement leaves the house in panic. However, the situation lightens when they get a task to roast the ex-housemates.

videos.title: Day 93: It's Time for Feedback!
videos.overview: Ex-contestants of S8 re-enter, go through the task comments, and review the rest of the housemates, leading to chaos. Some take it sportingly, while Vishal feels overwhelmed.

videos.title: Day 94: Top 8 vs Challengers
videos.overview: Dressed as movie characters, housemates battle with the challengers in Aadiya Aatam Enna task. Minor scuffles draw attention, but BB’s strict warning leaves the wildcards in a fix.

videos.title: Day 95: Dance Battles
videos.overview: Soundarya breaks down after the top 8 and challengers nominate each other for position swaps. Later, the house buzzes with energy during the one-on-one dance showdown.

videos.title: Day 96: Clashes and Confrontations
videos.overview: Deepak's words hurt Varshini, and besties Soundarya and Jacquline have a heated argument that puts their friendship at stake. The housemates battle in the final round of the task.

videos.title: Day 97: A Surprise Eviction
videos.overview: VJS appreciates the character performances of the housemates. He also discusses the reactions and reviews of the ex-contestants and reveals the first evictee of this week.

videos.title: Day 98: An Unexpected Elimination
videos.overview: The housemates share a memory they wish to erase, and VJS discusses the animosity that the ex-contestants came in with. The eviction results sweep everyone off their feet.

videos.title: Day 99: Reunions Cause Chaos
videos.overview: BB declares that the challengers failed to replace the finalists and applauds the top six. The rest of the ex-contestants step in one by one, creating a stir in the house.

videos.title: Day 100: Pongalo Pongal!
videos.overview: The housemates happily celebrate Pongal with BBS5 winner Raju and other special guests. The much-anticipated money box has arrived, but with a twist. Will someone claim it today?

videos.title: Day 101: Ma Ka Pa in the House!
videos.overview: BB brings in the second money box, and Rayan accepts the challenge to retrieve it within a set time. Ma Ka Pa surprises the housemates and hosts an entertaining podcast with them.

videos.title: Day 102: Final Race for the Money Box
videos.overview: The next four of the top six try their luck with the money box today. The housemates warmly welcome some special guests, including their beloved Manjari, Raanav, and Deepak.

videos.title: Day 103: Let's Rewind
videos.overview: The housemates are enthralled with the video compilations of their special bonds and bigg fights of this season. Later, the top five finalists get to relive their journey of S8.

videos.title: Day 104: The Last Day in BB House
videos.overview: All the housemates together have a blast, with BB's farewell speech being a cherry on top. Later, the ex-contestants convey their wishes and bid goodbye to the finalists.

videos.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: Five contenders, one trophy and an ultimate showdown! Join Vijay Sethupathi as he crowns this season's winner in an evening of captivating entertainment.

videos.title: BBTam: Grand Launch

videos.overview: Hungry housemates stir chaos by waking Super Deluxe members with noise and sabotaging their meal. Nadigan Da Nadigan Da task ends with a swap, and so the nominations begin.

videos.overview: The Bommai task restarts with a twist, sparking a massive clash between the houses over the game and stolen onions. Later, Ramya shares her emotional life story.

videos.overview: Kani and Sabari are picked as the best performers, while Aathirai and Aurora are sent to jail. The Kuthunga Yajaman Kuthunga task sparks a heated argument among the contenders.

videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates Kani’s captaincy win and questions Kamrudin's performance in the task. Later, he probes the Bommai task strategies and asks about two-faced housemates.

videos.overview: Housemates celebrate Diwali with a Tamil-style oil bath, followed by nominations and a house swap. Dhruv Vikram, along with Team Bison, joins them for the festivities.

videos.title: BBTam Day 16: BB Juice Factory
videos.overview: A tea-time clash sparks tension between FJ and Paaru. Super Deluxe faces friction with the other team, while juice task planning stirs fresh conflicts.

videos.title: BBTam Day 17: House Drama Over Cleaning Duties
videos.overview: FJ, Kemy, and Paaru argue over cleaning duties, sparking tensions in the house. Meanwhile, the Juice Factory task intensifies with QC disputes.

videos.overview: BB awards factory owners with coins for approved bottles. QC monitors face pressure from workers, while one housemate takes the lead and reaps the rewards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 20: Attention, Housemates!
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi slams the housemates for toxic behaviour and serves bitter gourd juice as a reality check. He probes their task performance and issues stern warnings.

videos.overview: Housemates discuss problems during Kani’s captaincy. Subiksha, Viyana and Praveen are saved, while VJS asks who is not performing well, before eviction process.

videos.overview: A new captain is chosen, and a swap task is held. Tensions rise as Kani and Paaru clash. After nominations, BB drops a massive twist, taking away all belongings for a hard reset.

videos.overview: BB takes all food and essentials. Captain Praveen's army rules spark a clash with Paaru. Arguments erupt with Vinoth and Diwakar during the locker task, leaving the house divided.

videos.title: BBTam Day 24: Non-stop Drama
videos.overview: Watermelon Star clashes with housemates over acting lessons. Tensions ease as the team aces the locker challenge before a surprise visit from team Aan Paavam Pollathathu.

videos.title: BBTam Day 25: Tug of Words
videos.overview: An array of arguments unfolds when Watermelon Star shares his grievances. BB housemates secure 1000 points, while the Yaar Antha Paiyan task gets interrupted by intense tiffs.

videos.title: BBTam Day 26: Lockers Open, Truths Spoken
videos.overview: FJ and Sabari share their life stories, and two housemates win a free pass. After a clash between Vikram and Diwakar, the Locker task ends in a twist and BB issues a demand.

videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi opens the episode with a loudspeaker, scolding housemates for constant shouting. He questions Ramya and Sabari about groupism and warns against team play.

videos.overview: Praveen faced criticism for his captaincy, prompting VJS to guide him on improvements. Later, VJS welcomed wild cards Prajin, Sandra, Divya, and Amit into the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 29: One House, One Rule
videos.overview: Divya becomes Thala after BB ends house divisions. Open nominations rattle the house, and contestants share their thoughts on the new wildcards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 30: Aaha Oho Hotel
videos.overview: Kamrudin, Prajan and Praveen’s prank ends on an emotional note. The Aaha Oho Hotel task kicks off with Priyanka, Manjari and Deepak’s arrival, bringing fun and drama to the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 31: Manager Under Fire
videos.overview: Manager Divya calls an urgent assembly, sparking a fight with Tushaar. Later, tensions during a staff meeting lead BB to announce a management change, voted on by the staff.

videos.overview: Chaos hits the hotel as Sandra’s wild behaviour and secret spills rattle the guests. Overwhelmed by the turmoil, Manager Vikram gives up. Later, singer Mano visits BB house.

videos.overview: Spotlight shines on Paaru as concern turns to tears when she's crowned this week's best performer. While two land in jail, clashes ripple through the house after the selection.

videos.title: BBTam Day 34: All Eyes on the Wild Cards
videos.overview: This week’s conflicts and a controversial prank draw Vijay Sethupathi's scrutiny. He also puts wild cards under the microscope before unveiling this week’s eviction twist.

videos.title: BBTam Day 35: Weekly Recap
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi clears the air over the Hotel task drama and shocks everyone with Sandra’s secret mission. He confronts idle contestants before proceeding with an eviction.

videos.overview: Aurora and Paaru’s clash turns emotional, after which a new Thala is elected. Wild cards aim to split Kani’s group and form a new alliance ahead of nominations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 37: Gana vs Tharbees Samrajyam
videos.overview: Thala Sabari steps in after a complaint from Watermelon Star stirs chaos in the Kitchen team. Later, kingdoms Gana and Tharbees ignite the royal task with special showcases.

videos.title: BBTam Day 38: The Clash of Samrajyams
videos.overview: Vikram and Paaru ascend the thrones, with Paaru addressing grievances against Watermelon Star. As tensions ease, the Samrajyams clash in the Kodi Parakuthu task.

videos.overview: Heated arguments and punishments shake the Royals task. Later, BB selects Kani, Amit and Vikram to rank housemates by maturity, sparking chaos and drama.

videos.title: BBTam Day 40: Fights and a Fallout
videos.overview: Viyana and Subiksha part ways, while BB punishes FJ for rule breaches. The house descends into chaos during the Worst Performer selection before the Captaincy Mathil task begins.

videos.title: BBTam Day 41: VJS Warns Against Blind Loyalty
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi highlighted mistakes in the task and warned Watermelon Star and Paaru against blind support. He later questioned FJ and Sabari for neglecting others’ injuries.

videos.title: BBTam Day 42: VJS Probes Task Abandonment
videos.overview: During the kingdom-task discussion, VJS questioned Watermelon Star about why he abandoned the task midway. He then asked all housemates about their 'protection shield

videos.title: BBTam Day 43: Special Guests and Selection
videos.overview: FJ becomes the new house Thala, while BB hosts a open-nomination that leaves the housemates perplexed. Later, they identify their competitors, and Team Nadu Center visit them.

videos.title: BBTam Day 44: Soru Soapu Mopu Task Kicks Off
videos.overview: BB housemates competed in the 'Soru Soapu Mopu' task across three squads, following their themed rules. FJ, Vinoth, and Amith later insisted the rules shouldn’t affect eating.

videos.title: BBTam Day 45: From Arguments to Achievements
videos.overview: The selection of the Star and Worst Performer leads to chaos, while Ramya and Kemy break down over the remarks. The Mop Mayavis take the lead in Konjam Paatu Konjam Point task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 46: Only One Team Stands Tall
videos.overview: Team clashes and kitchen walkouts spark tension as captains and housemates argue their way through the week. Poornima’s visit brings brief joy before one team emerges victorious.

videos.title: BBTam Day 47: Kavin Shows Up with a Surprise
videos.overview: Sandra and Divya face penalty as the week’s worst performers. Prajin clashes with Vikram over harsh remarks, and Kavin enters the house with a twist - mid-week eviction.

videos.title: BBTam Day 48: No Mercy for the Wildcards!
videos.overview: Delays, comments and team choices put Sandra and Divya under Vijay Sethupathi's scrutiny. Moreover, Prajin faces a hard-hitting reality check post weekly task's analysis.

videos.title: BBTam Day 49: Half-Century, Full Surprise
videos.overview: Marking 50 days, VJS questions the housemates on who surprised them by making it this far. He probes nomination strategies, sparks eviction drama and hints at a mystery surprise.

videos.title: BBTam Day 50: A Reality Check from Home
videos.overview: Viyana and Divya clash over sugar. Following nominations and the Saanja Pochu captaincy task, housemates receive gameplay tips via video messages from friends.

videos.title: BBTam Day 51: From School Bells to Star Visit

videos.title: BBTam Day 52: Commotion in the Campus
videos.overview: Vikram’s haircut prank sparks chatter, Sabari explodes over food, and Amit criticises Viyana. Students share their views on hostel and school before protesting against staff FJ.

videos.title: BBTam Day 53: Uniforms Lost, Secrets Found
videos.overview: Vikram scolds Viyana for tearing the task letter before she’s hit with a humiliating penalty. Paaru’s missing uniform and a troubling letter about her and Amit leave her in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 54: A Day of Lessons and Penalties
videos.overview: Students explore the BB Museum while Viyana sits out for mischief. Later, Ramya and Prajin become the best performers, while FJ and Vinoth land in trouble.

videos.title: BBTam Day 55: VJS Evaluates Task and Attitude
videos.overview: VJS praised the housemates’ efforts in the weekly school task with a framed group photo. FJ was criticised for poor leadership, role mishandling, and a remark about Sandra.

videos.title: BBTam Day 56: Letters Unveiled, Bonds Shake
videos.overview: Housemates read their ‘Mottai Kadithasi’ letters, sparking laughter and fun. Later, the ‘Neetippu Thundippu’ task put friendships and rivalries to the test.

videos.title: BBTam Day 57: Heartfelt Talks to Heated Debates
videos.overview: FJ–Aadhirai and Aurora–Paaru resolve their issues, and a new Thala steps up. Post nominations, boys and girls clash in exciting debates. Who’ll emerge victorious?

videos.overview: Paaru, Aurora and Kamrudin discuss their dynamics, while Vikram and Subiksha mend their rift. Later, Modern vs Retro teams challenge each other to protect the prized necklaces.

videos.overview: Sabari’s theft lands him in jail, Aurora breaks down over Paaru’s words, and FJ is kicked out. In the Jodi task, chaos erupts as teams clash with fights and fierce verbal wars.

videos.title: BBTam Day 61: Race to Escape
videos.overview: BB makes the house name six best performers and sends the others into jail. While arguments explode, the 10 jailed contestants try to save themselves. Who will stay behind?

videos.overview: VJS questioned Viyana on the bucket issue but dropped it after her confused answers. He then called out the housemates for ignoring their roles and being careless.

videos.title: BBTam Day 63: Recap with VJS
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan asks housemates to name who puts others down and digs into task clashes and grievances. Thala Ramya faces a sharp reality check before eviction begins.

videos.title: BBTam Day 64: New Week, Same Old Drama
videos.overview: Kamrudin’s harsh comments backfire when Aurora and Aadhirai confront him. Later, a new Thala is chosen, and the housemates participate in a new nomination process.

videos.overview: Vikram pranks Subhiksha for singing and sues her in a funny trial. Aurora fights a case against Paaru, leaving the decision to the Audience. Later, kitchen duties spark a clash.

videos.title: BBTam Day 68: Chaos at the BB Court
videos.overview: The court trial turns chaotic with constant interruptions. FJ fights Kamrudin. Later, the worst performer is named and Divya clashes with Kamrudin.

videos.title: BBTam Day 69: House in the Hot Seat

videos.title: BBTam Day 70: VJS Delivers the Verdict
videos.overview: Housemates are schooled by Vijay Sethupathi for poor court decorum as he reviews the cases. After Aurora speaks up against FJ, he earns a warning for his conduct.

videos.overview: Paaru's mom exits as Vikram and Subiksha’s families enter the house. Tensions flare as Divya clashes with Vinoth and Paaru over the sponsor task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 85: Ticket to Finale Begins

videos.title: BBTam Day 86: Drama Peaks In Ticket to finale task
videos.overview: The Ticket to Finale intensifies! Paaru and Kamrudin clash during the game. In the aftermath, Kamrudin apologizes for his outburst, while Vikram makes peace with Divya.

videos.title: BBTam Day 87: Task Victories Amidst The Drama

videos.title: BBTam Day 89: Secure Your Spot!
