videos.title: BBTam Day 90: No More Warnings!
videos.overview: Housemates face intense questioning from VJS over the car task chaos, as he grills them on why no one stopped Paaru and Kamrudin. Later, the duo face the harsh reality.

videos.title: BBTam Day 91: Meet the First Finalist
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns to meet the contestants! Get ready for a rollercoaster of drama, laughter, emotions, and unexpected twists.

videos.title: BBTam Day 92: Panapetti 2.0
videos.overview: BB offers housemates a daring chance to save a nominee. Viyana’s entry and eviction drama triggers panic. Later, the housemates scramble to stack the cash in the money box.

videos.title: BBTam Day 93: Big Money Temptation Starts
videos.overview: Viyana targets Sandra while Praveen & Diwakar join the house. BB warns Diwakar. After tasks add cash to the pot, the Pana Petti opens! Will anyone take the money box and exit?

videos.title: BBTam Day 94: Top Six vs Evictees
videos.overview: Panapetti 2.0 task intensifies as housemates race to increase the prize money. Ramya and Apsara enter the house, and evictees battle it out to raise the pot.

videos.title: BBTam Day 95: Can The Final 6 Pull It Off?
videos.overview: The finalists must execute a secret mission to hide Kemy inside the house. Can they complete the multiple levels of the task unnoticed? Meanwhile, the LBW team enters the BB House.

videos.title: BBTam Day 96: Vinoth's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Drama brews with clashes between the Top Six and evictees before the Pulambinaa Panam task. Later, as Aurora reaches the money box, Vinoth drops a shocker that stuns the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 97: First Encounters, Final Farewells
videos.overview: VJS discusses the shift in dynamics between ex-housemates and finalists. A heartfelt farewell for Vinoth follows, as housemates recall their first interactions.

videos.title: BBTam Day 98: Chinna Kurumpadam, Bigg Twists
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan gives ex-housemates a shot to campaign for the finalists, while Kurumpadam uncovers drama. In a jaw-dropping twist, just 4 finalists survive and Sandra waves goodbye.

videos.title: BBTam Day 99: Finale Week
videos.overview: The Top Four light up as Amit, Kalaiyarasan, Prajin and Tushaar arrive. Misunderstandings between Aurora and Tushaar vanish, and the house gears up for the finale with fun tasks.

videos.title: BBTam Day 100: Celebrating the Bigg Milestone
videos.overview: The winning speeches of the finalists take center stage, while Aurora hands a letter to Tushaar. A prank by Kani and Subhiksha upsets Vikram, before housemates celebrate 100 days.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 101: Friendship, Fights and Feelings
videos.overview: Diwakar fights Divya. Sandra and Vinoth return, resolving issues and consoling Aurora. The house celebrates Bhogi and bonds over friendship memories.

videos.title: BBTam Day 102: Pongalo Pongal!
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss house is buzzing! New tasks, wild missions, and explosive fights bring real drama and endless entertainment.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 103: A Blast from the Past
videos.overview: A fight compilation sparks a clash between Prajean and Diwakar. Sandy and Kavin visit for a movie promo and dance! Vikram gets emotional watching his journey video.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 104: The Final Night in the House
videos.overview: Divya, Sabari & Aurora relive their journeys. The Top four get a makeover for the finale. BB's touching words leave everyone in tears as ex-contestants bid a heavy-hearted goodbye.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: The wait is over! The 105-day journey ends tonight as Vijay Sethupathi lights up the stage to crown the winner of this season.

videos.title: BBTam: Season Premiere
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns with a new season that’s bold, unpredictable, and packed with drama. Let the chaos begin!

videos.title: BBTam Day 1: Who Deserves to be A Leader?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss welcomes everyone with the ‘Night Stars’ task.The democracy rules are read and each one gets to pitch their leadership qualities. Who will emerge as the first leader?

videos.title: BBTam Day 2: The Power Cards are Here!
videos.overview: As kitchen team does the luxury budget shopping, Avinash manages to win the Asura Pasi task. Amidst the arguments and chaos, BB announces some special power cards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 3: A Shocking Exit
videos.overview: Mukesh chooses Muniyamma and Chandini for the Style Patrol, while arguments erupt in the leader's meet. Avinash gets unlimited food, and a surprise exit leaves everyone emotional.

videos.title: BBTam Day 4: New Entry and Leadership Crisis
videos.overview: Kitchen fights end in a captaincy shift, Muniyamma breaks down in jail, and a new commoner enters. Tensions peak in the democracy question hour as leader Shatiga gets targeted.

videos.title: BBTam Day 5: The First Eviction Stuns All
videos.overview: Vinoth becomes leader and names three weakest performers. Eviction voting sends one out, while the Review Board puts Lakshmipriya in danger.

videos.title: BBTam Day 6: Vijay Sethupati Takes the Stage
videos.overview: VJS welcomes Manivannan and later discusses democracy with the housemates. He grills Shathiga on leadership and Vinoth Babu on opposition duties.

videos.title: BBTam Day 7: Eviction and New Rules
videos.overview: VJS questions the evictee and asks to describe the housemates. He checks on the contestants about the new power system, and then asks them to name two least deserving leaders.

videos.title: BBTam Day 8: Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: The new entry sparks tension. As Shama dominates the leadership task, democracy room drama triggers a walkout. Luxury shopping and nominations add more chaos.

videos.title: BBTam Day 9: Welcome to the Battleground
videos.overview: The kitchen becomes ground zero for fights when housemates clash over their duties and tea. The tasks add fuel to the fire as punishments are given and stories are stopped midway.

videos.title: BBTam Day 10: Eviction Free Pass Is Here!
videos.overview: Ansar’s ratings raise eyebrows, while kitchen drama brings Anandhi to tears. As physical tussles erupt in the cheese task for the pass, Shama changes the least deserving list.

videos.title: BBTam Day 11: Power Shifts and Food War
videos.overview: What begins with a food clash, ends in an assembly revolt. A dramatic resignation and high-stakes re-election follows. Who will become the new leader?

videos.title: BBTam Day 12: New King and Servants
videos.overview: Task disputes bring debates over fair play among the contestants. Prithvi becomes king with three servants, an eviction looms, and two members head straight to jail.

videos.title: BBTam Day 13: VJS Exposes Housemates' Bias
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupati welcomes Anandhi and grills Shama over her leadership, task U-turns. He then calls out the ruling team in the Democracy Room for failing to support their own.

videos.title: BBTam Day 14: Who Will Join VJS Onstage
videos.overview: Anandi upsets VJS while he discusses the task issues. Leaderships are compared, and Mukesh saves one with the Eviction Free Pass. Who will finally bid goodbye today?

videos.title: BBTam Day 15: New Leader and Nominations!
videos.overview: Avinash is the new leader! As he sorts the teams, ruling vs opposition clash over the cleaning rules. Ansar and Shathiga's food spat precedes a tense nomination round.

videos.title: BBTam Day 16: Titles and Transformations
videos.overview: Muniyammal’s comments raise eyebrows. Later, housemates impersonate each other in a fun content creator task before assigning sarcastic titles in a board game.

videos.title: BBTam Day 17: Avinash's Strategic Move
videos.overview: Clashes, tears and tough calls! Shama-Jason fight halts the task, but Avinash wins big. Asmitha struggles with Anandhi, while the exit board results leave Shathiga in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 18: Exit Board Triggers Tiffs
videos.overview: Muniyammal confronts Avinash over her exit board spot. Later in democracy proceedings Jason's question triggers chaos. Avinash reshuffles the board, getting into trouble again.

videos.title: BBTam Day 19: Angry Tears and Angry Exits
videos.overview: Lakshmi Priya gets evicted. However, before leaving, she has a lot to say to Avinash. Meanwhile, Bigg Boss calls the housemates to the confession room for a special selection.

videos.title: BBTam Day 20: Eviction Twist Unveiled
videos.overview: Anandhi's eviction twist is revealed, and the shame segment targets Raghav. Avinash is praised as well as criticised by VJS, while Jason and Shama get a earful for their behaviour.

videos.title: BBTam Day 21: VJS Drops A Major Game Twist
videos.overview: VJS confronts about the passive gameplay and questions Avinash's board choices. Javeed, Lakshmi Priya and Saviniya return as VJS reveals a twist, sweeping everyone off their feet.

videos.title: BBTam Day 22: Hotel Task with New Rules
videos.overview: Open nominations shake up the house, but BB twists the game. The Hotel task is launched with three pairs of guests. As manager Shama takes charge, how will this battle proceed?

videos.title: BBTam Day 23: Task Wars and Ruthless Roast
videos.overview: Housemates fight over washrooms and fake tags. The rope creates clashes and hotel guests face harsh consequences for it. The debate and roast battle intensifies the situations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 24: The Big Cash Box Dilemma
videos.overview: Asmitha and Saviniya clash over sleep, leaving Saviniya in tears. BB drops a cash box offer, leaving Kumaran contemplating his choice before the house turns into a wild jungle.

videos.title: BBTam Day 25: Grand Opening, Grand Problem
videos.overview: BB Hotel opens with outrage as food delays anger guests. Manager Lakshmi Priya confronts Dhanya and Javeed over kitchen blunders, leaving Dhanya in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 26: BB Hotel Gets Reviewed
videos.overview: Fights, tears and tough reviews mark BB Hotel 2.0. Kumaran cuts the rope to save Lakshmipriya, while Saviniya–Asmitha and Danya–Javeed fail to agree on who stays.

videos.title: BBTam Day 27: VJS Reviews BB Hotel 2.0
videos.overview: VJS quizzes the housemates on the rope choices and the re-entered trio's promises. Shama's managerial stint draws mixed views, while Vijay probes on why BB Hotel 2.0 failed.

videos.title: BBTam Day 28: Wildcards Bring Instant Drama
videos.overview: VJS interacts with Kumaran before the danger-zone housemates award an eviction-free pass. Three wildcards enter with high stake tasks that stir immediate drama in the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 29: New Leader and Nominations
videos.overview: Karishma's questions stirs the house, before a leadership task for the wildcards. Following the nominations process, a bedroom inspection triggers a fight between Vasan and Jason.

videos.title: BBTam Day 30: Chaos, Betrayals and Magic Potions
videos.overview: Avinash and Muniyammal clash disrupts the house. Amidst secret deals and betrayals, the high stakes magic potion task triggers fierce fights between Raghav and Jason.

videos.title: BBTam Day 31: Blue Bricks Rule!
videos.overview: Raghav and Muthazhagi end in tears, while a block-grabbing fairness debate divides the house. As few get eliminated from the task, Jason's comment on Avinash triggers a fight.

videos.title: BBTam Day 32: Complaints and Clarifications
videos.overview: Foul play allegations erupt after Muthazhagi's block move. Democracy room brings apologies and tears, while teams clash for survival in the magic potion task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 33: Victory and Heartfelt Letters
videos.overview: The magic potion task crowns its winners with immunity, while evicted ones face punishments. Worst players are voted for, as anonymous letters bring tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 34: Praises and Warning
videos.overview: VJS appreciates previous week's performances and asks the housemates to review wildcard gameplay. He advises Jason on his remarks.

videos.title: A Musical Salute to a Legend!

videos.title: K. Bhagyaraj's Cinematic Legacy

videos.title: Celebrating S. Janaki's Legacy
videos.overview: Celebrating S. Janaki's legacy, the stage comes alive with emotional performances and a breathtaking medley. Heartfelt memories and tributes make the celebration even more special.

videos.title: A Magical Evening Of Melodies

videos.title: Fun Fuels Fierce Competition

videos.title: Aadi Thiruvizha Special
videos.overview: Actress Radha joins Aadi Thiruvizha for a grand Divine Round. Meanwhile, the contestants captivate the crowd with divine acts and expert judge feedback.

videos.title: The Little Stars' Divine Melodies

videos.title: Heartwarming Tributes to Loved Ones
videos.overview: The dedication round celebrates inspiring bonds through heartfelt songs and meaningful gifts. Contestants honour their loved ones with emotional performances and gratitude.

videos.title: Heartfelt Tributes Fill the Stage

videos.title: Fun Max Cinematic Round
videos.overview: Movie magic meets unstoppable fun in the Cinema Round with hilarious recreations and spectacular singing acts by junior singers. Tune in for a fun-filled cinematic celebration!

videos.title: Musical Magic and Comedy Mayhem
videos.overview: A power-packed night of soulful music, side-splitting comedy, and emotional acts. Judges share warm praise and expert guidance for every stunning performance.

videos.title: Rock and Roll Extravaganza
videos.overview: Special guest Shruti Haasan lights up the stage, getting emotional over a special clip. Thrilling performances win buzzers, while judge Chithra mesmerises all.

videos.title: Retro Magic Takes Over the Stage
videos.overview: Retro classics come alive in the Rock 'n' Roll round through energetic performances. A special celebration honours Shruti Haasan's journey with a montage of her memorable moments.

videos.title: Rocking Medleys Blend with Emotion
videos.overview: An emotional family reunion for Saurabi and Shruthi's rocking performance elevates the Rock 'n' Roll round. Retro medleys from Super Singer stars steal the spotlight.

videos.title: Celebrating Deva's Musical Legacy
videos.overview: Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka welcome Deva for a special round filled with top performances and custom lyrics. Mani and Band receive a lesson, while Chithra and Deva share glowing praise.

videos.title: A Soulful Tribute to Deva's Music
videos.overview: Judges are spellbound as Little Stars deliver energetic renditions of Deva's hits. Tears of joy follow as Deva's musical troupe surprises him with a pleasant entry on stage.

videos.title: A Magical Top 10 Moon Night
videos.overview: Priyanka and Ma Ka Pa host the Top 10 Moon event. As guest stars join the fun, powerful singing acts impress the judges and lead to touching family moments.

videos.title: A Night of Unforgettable Music
videos.overview: Special guest Venkat Prabhu visits for a magical night of music! Featuring Golden Moon honours, heartwarming parent tributes, and stellar duets with legendary singers.

videos.title: Race to Finale Showdown!
videos.overview: The Race to Finale begins with the top 10 contestants competing for the Golden Buzzer and belt. As the competition heats up, tune in to see who secures the ticket to the finale!

videos.title: The Battle for Finale Tickets
videos.overview: As the competition intensifies, contestants race towards the finale while judges identify mistakes and mark corrections. With stakes rising, contestants strive to prove themselves.

videos.title: Race to Finale Phase 2 Begins
videos.overview: The contestants turn up the energy in Race to Finale Phase 2, battling it out for the finale ticket. Fuelled by confidence, they push ahead with renewed determination.

videos.title: Stars Unleash Magic
videos.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka welcome team Anbil Avan to The Race 2 Finale Phase 2. Amid stunning acts, fun music lessons, and dancing, stars honor the first finalist!

videos.title: Race to Finale Phase 3!

videos.title: The Common Man: The Bigg Boss Dream Begins
videos.overview: Maya welcomes the final 50 contestants as Raju, Aari and Oviya take the judge's seat. A race for limited seats puts the contestants through a tense test.

videos.title: The Common Man: Stories That Stand Out
videos.overview: Shobha Indrakumar makes a powerful entry, while Muniyammal wins hearts. The contestants bring unique personalities to the stage putting the judges in a dilemma.

videos.title: The Common Man: Bold Talent Battles for Selection
videos.overview: Feroz brings energy, while fiercely independent Kamatchi inspires. Venkatesan owns the stage, and Jason impresses with kickboxing as the judges search for their pick.

videos.title: The Common Man: Whom Will The Judges Choose?
videos.overview: Parveen faces tough questions, while Manivannan touches hearts. Karishma's banters and Pugazhenthi's rare talent, leaves judges in a tough spot.

videos.title: The Common Man: Extreme Personalities Audition
videos.overview: Baby Prabhakaran and Ranjith impress the judges with their natural charm and unusual talents. However, Priyavarshini and Nivya Maran end up disappointing them.

videos.title: The Common Man: An Array of Contestants Enter
videos.overview: Contestants from a wide range of profession and backgrounds audition for the round. One gets a red card, while a bunch of them succeed to secure a spot.

videos.title: The Common Man: 10 Spots, 21 Contestants
videos.overview: The contestants on hold face a high stakes questionnaire task. Bold answers from Feroz Khan, Manivannan, and Aishwarya trigger fiery debates as only 10 can advance.

videos.title: The Common Man: Mud, Grit and Glory
videos.overview: The Red Rangers and Manpulu teams battle through a muddy coin hunt in which, Priyanka Paul and Muniyamma challenge the verdicts. Was it a fair game?

videos.title: The Common Man: A Dance Marathon
videos.overview: Teams clash in a high-energy dance marathon! Standout acts, killer moves, and mid-stage prop swaps bring total fun, before votes decide the best and worst performers.

videos.title: The Common Man: A Game of Blind Football
videos.overview: 22 contestants split into three teams for Blind Football and a supermarket task. Hilarious stories, team guidance, and an argument with Muniyamma lead to dramatic star ratings.

videos.title: The Common Man: The Bigg Boss Quiz
videos.overview: Contestants battle through a chaotic BB Quiz and hilarious Guess & Act task. As three face a nerve-wracking elimination, a major surprise twist changes everything.

videos.title: The Common Man: A Fun Court Task
videos.overview: Contestants clash in an intense court task featuring fiery debates, hilarious floor arguments, and a special witness appearance. Who will get the Red and Green stars today?

videos.title: The Common Man: Courtroom Chaos
videos.overview: The Court Task gets intense as Muniyamma, Raju and Saranya make their cases, while Samyuktha and Divya face emotional twists amid a tense card selection.

videos.title: The Common Man: Five Make the Cut
videos.overview: The Ball Sack Battle sparks fierce competition and emotional moments as Darwin stands out. As the final cards revealed, what would be the final verdict?

videos.title: The Common Man: Friendship Test Triggers Tension
videos.overview: Shobha and Saranya impress in the friendship challenges, while Aravind and Karishma clash during the Q&A round. Jayson gets candid about his friends as an eviction awaits.

videos.title: The Common Man: Angels vs Demons Showdown
videos.overview: Angels and Demons go head-to-head in extreme patience tasks. Mind games, role swaps, and emotional clashes rock the house before a shocking result.

videos.title: The Common Man: Contestants Assign Titles
videos.overview: After a glamorous ramp walk, contestants assign bold titles to each other.  A surprise entry stuns everyone, while the eviction results sweep the contestants off their feet.

videos.title: The Common Man: Red vs Blue Team
videos.overview: Darwin shines in the memory challenge, while Manivannan impresses in the physical tasks. As the teams continue to battle, the elimnation leaves everyone teary eyed.

videos.title: The Common Man: Contestants Are Back to School
videos.overview: The School Task turns chaotic with hilarious classroom moments, arguments and mischief as contestants struggle to stay in character and impress the judges.

videos.title: The Common Man: The Ranking Battle
videos.overview: The Ranking Task sparks heated clashes as Jayson, Shobha, Manivannan and Priyanka Paul fight for their spots, with the final rankings and an elimination awaiting them.

videos.title: The Common Man: Endurance Under Pressure
videos.overview: Nine contestants face endurance task as Karishma Sama and Darwin battle through distractions. Who will secure the top eight positions today?

videos.title: The Common Man: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: The finalists face former Bigg Boss contestants in a fiery roasting task before opening up about their journeys. As emotions run high, the ultimate decision is declared

videos.title: Black Coats
videos.overview: Yazhini faces rejection due to her stutter, Deva loses his chamber and Veni enters the Bar Association election. However, an ATM robbery gives them a new ray of hope.

videos.title: Same Case, Different Reasons
videos.overview: Yazhini secretly investigates the ATM robbery while working for Mahesh, and Deva charms the bank manager to secure the same case. Will this case change their fortunes?

videos.title: Crossed
videos.overview: While Veni fights for an evicted tea-stall vendor, Yazhini uncovers a crucial clue in the ATM robbery. How will Mahesh and Deva handle this new discovery?

videos.title: The Wrong Interview
videos.overview: Veni spots Pandiyaraj's campaign posters and gets infuriated. Deva finally manages to get a chamber, although shared, and hijacks Yazhini's interview, which forces a choice on her.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Torn between Veni's experience and Deva's ambition, Yazhini chooses the chamber where she wants to build her future. But on her first day in court, she draws Muthu's ire.

videos.title: Undone
videos.overview: Yazhini races to secure anticipatory bail for Joe. However, things go wrong when the tampered petition is rejected and Yazhini faces the blame.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: Determined to free Joe, Yazhini strikes a bargain with the registrar. But later, she confronts Veni with proof of Muthu's sabotage.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Deva challenges Veni to represent her client's son, turning their rivalry into a contest. While Yazhini feels conflicted about her boss' actions, Raja Sekar arrives and greets her.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: When Yazhini's identity as Raj Sekar's daughter becomes public, Deva questions her choices. Meanwhile, the top lawyer's courtroom appearance uncovers old wounds.

videos.title: Vantage Point
videos.overview: Shailaja asks her dad why Yazhini can't join their firm. Yazhini finds out from Veni the conflict between Raj Sekar and Sathyan and gets a breakthrough in the drunk-driving case.

videos.title: Groundwork
videos.overview: It's the day Maari decides who will fight for his son's drunk-driving case. Veni's team feels the case is airtight. But Yazhini secures the evidence needed to challenge them.

videos.title: Alone
videos.overview: Before the drunk-driving case hearing begins, Deva is forced to leave, compelling Yazhini to take over. She begins confidently until an unexpected witness is brought in.

videos.title: Do I Belong?
videos.overview: Maari brings his goons to threaten Deva. Just as Yazhini begins questioning her choice of profession, she comes across a desperate woman with a case that nobody wants.

videos.title: Courage
videos.overview: Yazhini moves into a new home, and who her roommate is shocks her. Despite Deva and Veni's refusal and her father's disapproval, she commits to fight Anitha's case.

videos.title: Hustle
videos.overview: Yazhini and Deva discover that the ATM robbery may not be done by everyday thieves. Determined to help Anitha, she follows a disturbing trail leading to a surrogacy clinic.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: Armed with a new strategy, Yazhini enters court to fight for the abandoned special-needs child. When the defence tries to bury the truth, Yazhini turns their evidence against them.

videos.title: Hell's Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

videos.title: Unwitting Actions
videos.overview: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

videos.title: The Lid is Lifted
videos.overview: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

videos.title: Doomed
videos.overview: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

videos.title: Be Irreplaceable
videos.overview: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

videos.title: Behind the Mask
videos.overview: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

videos.title: Wave of Nostalgia
videos.overview: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

videos.title: Ghost from the Past
videos.overview: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

videos.title: Frozen in Fear
videos.overview: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

videos.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
videos.overview: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

videos.title: Gearing Up
videos.overview: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

videos.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
videos.overview: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

videos.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
videos.overview: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

videos.title: Fresh Ally
videos.overview: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

videos.title: Comeuppance
videos.overview: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

videos.title: Covetous Desire
videos.overview: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

videos.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
videos.overview: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

videos.title: Emotional Armour
videos.overview: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

videos.title: Seething Anger
videos.overview: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

videos.title: Face from the Past
videos.overview: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

videos.title: Close Confidante
videos.overview: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

videos.title: Secret Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

videos.title: Drifting Apart
videos.overview: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

videos.title: Where is Chika?
videos.overview: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

videos.title: Lovelorn Veni
videos.overview: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

videos.title: Delving into the Past
videos.overview: Leo's words remind Ragupathi of Chika and he decides to locate him. Nedumaran humiliates Aishu after seeing her with Vetri. Aishu learns about Vetri’s father and his family's past.

videos.title: The Supercilious Chef
videos.overview: When Vicky questions Nedumaran for making Aishu the Sous Chef, a cooking challenge is held between them. Ragupathi’s decision to find the truth about Chidambaram upsets Nedumaran.

videos.title: Resurfacing of Memories
videos.overview: Aishu takes Vetri's mom and sister to her house for a day and is shocked to see Nedumaran back early from his travel. What happens when he learns the truth about their background?

videos.title: New Ideas
videos.overview: Vetri gives his mom a tour of the resort. Riya shares her business plan with Ragupathi. While Vetri helps Aishu with the sous chef test, Nedumaran warns her to stay away from him.

videos.title: Dinner or Date?
videos.overview: Aishu tells Vetri that her father knows about the guests. She invites Vetri out for dinner. Nedumaran is not happy when Ragupathi tells him about Riya's new business plan.

videos.title: Chefs' Cook-Off
videos.overview: Nedumaran announces three rounds of the sous chef cook-off. While he demands that Aishu win the challenge, Vicky tries to distract her. Later, Nedumaran accepts the business idea.

videos.title: The Clock Is Ticking
videos.overview: Vetri boosts Aishu when Vicky mocks her for losing. Aishu wins the next round. She recalls Vetri’s words as she panics in the third round. Ragupathi gets a call about Chidambaram.

videos.title: The Shindig
videos.overview: Nedumaran resents Aishu's friendship with Vetri. Ragupathy leaves to find Chidambaram. Joji is miffed when no one remembers his birthday, but Vetri has a solution.

videos.title: The Apologetic Attacker
videos.overview: John tries to target Vetri to appease Nedumaran by messing up a guest's order. Vicky attends his friend's bachelor party and finds Vetri taking their 'special' food order.

videos.title: Native Charm
videos.overview: Vetri is tasked with handling an inspection officer, who comes over to thoroughly check the resort. Vicky and Srinidhi decide to investigate what Vetri and Pandi are up to.

videos.title: Busted
videos.overview: After Nedumaran warns him, Vetri avoids Aishu, leaving her upset and confused. When Aishu discovers Vetri in his secret kitchen, she leaves without listening to his explanation.

videos.title: Smoking Gun
videos.overview: Vetri is caught red-handed and faces Nedumaran’s wrath after Vicky shares video evidence of his secret kitchen. Vicky lies that Aishu took the video. Ragupathi visits Vetri's mom.

videos.title: Disillusioned
videos.overview: Aishu confronts Vicky for his heinous move. Defying a furious Nedumaran, Ragupathi handles the situation and Vetri is released from the station. Aishu tries to speak to Vetri.

videos.title: Penitent Vetri
videos.overview: Vetri's suspension surprises everyone. While Ragupathi accepts Vetri's heartfelt apology, his decision upsets Nedumaran. Vetri is glad to see Bhavani’s food cart back in business.

videos.title: Stonewalling
videos.overview: Riya launches RR Resort Masala Products. Nedumaran is shocked that Ragupathi knows Vetri's father and is looking for him. Aishu is hurt as Vetri decides to stay away from her.

videos.title: Dissolved in Tears
videos.overview: Aishu feels guilty about Vetri. Joji advices Vetri to save his friendship. Rajan shares vital news with Ragupathi about Chidambaram. Aishu has a heartfelt talk with Nedumaran.

videos.title: Mea Culpa
videos.overview: Ragupathi learns that Chidambaram is innocent. Meanwhile, Vicky's mother makes an unexpected visit to the resort and advises him to value his friendships.

videos.title: Food Fest'26
videos.overview: Vetri helps Ramya at her college food festival and is shocked by the chief guest. Vicky apologises to Aishu and tries to fix things with Veni, but things do not go as planned.

videos.title: Languishing in Prison!
videos.overview: Vetri rejoins his duty at the resort and promises Ragupathi to be loyal always. While Ragupathi is desperately looking for Chidambaram, what big secret is Nedumaran hiding?

videos.title: Flopped Business
videos.overview: Riya is upset as her business plan fails. Nedumaran rebukes Riya and Rajan when they inform him about the food’s quality at the resort. Vetri decides to talk to Shibu for Aishu.

videos.title: Nudging Friends
videos.overview: Ragupathi asks Riya to take up the pantry project with Vetri to help her. Nedumaran praises Aishu for running the kitchen smoothly. Vetri makes Shibu listen to Aishu’s rendition.

videos.title: Renewed Opportunity
videos.overview: Nedumaran gets angry that Vetri is to manage the pantry and questions Ragupathi. Shibu promises an opportunity for Aishu to Vetri. After Vicky apologises, Veni reconciles with him.

videos.title: Renaissance
videos.overview: Vetri sets up the pantry and is happy to know of a salary hike. While Aishu is ready to sacrifice her dreams for her father's happiness, Nedumaran learns about her secret identity.

videos.title: Filial Betrayal
videos.overview: Things take a turn when Nedumaran discovers Aishu's hidden identity. Tensions escalate within the Pantry team as they face new challenges and conflicts.

videos.title: Immolating Dreams
videos.overview: Aishu rejects Shibu's offer and assures Nedumaran she won't betray him like her sister. Priya hints at a plan to her brother, who warns her to be cautious.

videos.title: Culinary Stage
videos.overview: Ramya joins Nedumaran's kitchen as a trainee. Vetri's pantry sale picks up, but Riya rebukes him for not following the assigned menu. Vetri scolds Ramya for confronting Aishu.

videos.title: Entrapped
videos.overview: After Rajan advices Riya, she asks Vetri to make some dishes for the pantry. While Bhavani waits for Ramya to return, Priya traps her in a dangerous situation. Will Ramya survive?

videos.title: Frantic Search
videos.overview: Vetri and Pandi scour the resort in search of Ramya. Priya worriedly calls her brother and tells him about her mistake. Once the rescue is dealt with, Vetri goes on a field trip.

videos.title: A Daughter's Atonement
videos.overview: Aishu upsets everyone with her tyrannical behaviour. Veni spots Priya snooping around and gets suspicious. Vetri has a new menu. Will he successfully implement it?

videos.title: Contrasting Sisters
videos.overview: Divya asks for Riya's support at her wedding. Aishu tells Divya that she will not let their father down. Aishu warns Vicky for mocking Ramya. Vetri is sad as the pantry sales drop.

videos.title: Bitter Encounters
videos.overview: Vetri's new menu struggles to attract customers. Ramya tells Vetri about how Vicky bullies her, which angers him. Divya finally comes face to face with Nedumaran at the resort.

videos.title: Aishu's Complaint
videos.overview: After a complaint from Aishu reaches Rajan, Vetri faces an uncomfortable meeting. Feeling dejected, he finds support from Ramya and Pandi, who motivate him to focus on the pantry.

videos.title: Suspicions Sparked
videos.overview: Nedumaran brushes aside Aishu's wedding-related concerns, while Vetri finds inspiration for new pantry dishes. Veni grows suspicious of Priya's actions and shares it with Vicky.

videos.title: Yearning Daughters
videos.overview: Vetri works tirelessly to manage both the pantry and room service while launching fresh ideas. Meanwhile, Nedumaran's anger flares when he learns of Divya's wedding menu plans.

videos.title: Booming Pantry Sales
videos.overview: Ragupathi shares his concern about Chidambaram with Nedumaran. Vetri makes a sweet for Divya. Vetri's strategy with kids works well for the pantry business, making Nedumaran angry.

videos.title: Showered by Appreciation
videos.overview: Nedumaran fumes as the pantry food is liked by the guests. While Riya congratulates Vetri, Ragupathi praises her for the pantry's success. Nedumaran recalls his talk with Chika.

videos.title: Spurned Invitation
videos.overview: Nedumaran lashes at Divya for inviting him to her wedding. John announces the Star Chef competition. Priya plans her revenge by tarnishing Nedumaran's name at Divya's wedding.

videos.title: Wrecking the Wedding
videos.overview: Nedumaran's new signature dish becomes an instant hit. He ignores Karthik who tries to convince him to attend the wedding. Priya executes her plan amidst the wedding preparations.

videos.title: Blood is Thicker than Water
videos.overview: Priya's plan fails as Nedumaran handles the situation. Divya is elated to see her father at her wedding as Aishu gives him an earful. Nedumaran rages when Aishu shows him a photo.

videos.title: A Bride's Farewell
videos.overview: Nedumaran has a private word with Karthik before bidding the newlyweds goodbye. Uthaman introduces the new members to the room service team. Meanwhile, Vetri falls sick.

videos.title: The Hidden Truth
videos.overview: When Vicky and Veni share a private moment, Nedumaran conducts an inspection, alarming Vetri. Aishu asks about the untoward kitchen incidents and the picture from Nedumaran's desk.

videos.title: Ravaged Kitchen
videos.overview: Riya finds out the reason behind Deepak's return and confronts him. Ragupathi asks everyone to prepare for a minister's visit, but Priya has another plan up her sleeve.

videos.title: Against All Odds
videos.overview: The kitchen's destruction upsets the chefs. Nedumaran proposes that his team move into the pantry temporarily, but Riya opposes it vehemently. What will Ragupathi decide?

videos.title: Rajan's Avowal
videos.overview: Nedumaran is angry by the minister’s mother’s words. While Riya assures her dad she is happy, Rajan admits to Aishu that he loves Riya. Vetri helps Aishu with a last-minute order.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Notoriety
videos.overview: Nedumaran is shocked to see a viral video stating the fire in the kitchen was due to his neglect, but Veni has doubts. He fumes as the minister and his family enjoy pantry food.

videos.title: Minister's Misattribution
videos.overview: Ragupathi is moved by Aishu’s suggestion to get Riya and Rajan married. Priya celebrates with her brother. The minister applauds Nedumaran for the amazing dishes in the pantry.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Unpleasant Encounter
videos.overview: Nedumaran is upset by a call and the profit margin between the kitchen and pantry. Veni learns that Priya is constantly following Nedumaran. Martin visits Nedumaran at RR resort.

videos.title: All about Chika
videos.overview: Nedumaran meets Chidambaram aka Chika, who wins hearts with his cooking. Ragupathi nominates him for a Star Chef competition. Upset, Nedumaran decides to cook for a hunting party.

videos.title: Web of Deceptions
videos.overview: Nedumaran reports illegal hunting and leaves Chika alone in the forest. Chika gets arrested. At the resort, Nedumaran spins a tale about Chika’s missing, all for a Star Chef award.

videos.title: Hidden Feelings
videos.overview: Vetri is heartbroken to see Aishu’s ex-boyfriend. A complaint about a pantry dish has Nedumaran fuming. Rajan admits his feelings to Riya. Vetri is thrilled as Aishu lifts the ban.

videos.title: Old Flame
videos.overview: Nedumaran complains to Ragupathi about the pantry. Aishu and Selvin catch up after ages. Veni spies on Priya. Ramya confides in Aishu about Vetri while Ragupathi collapses in pain.

videos.title: Stricken Ragupathi
videos.overview: Priya becomes cautious when Veni and Vetri visit her house. Ragupathi is hospitalised and Nedumaran assumes that he will be taking over the resort in his absence.

videos.title: Who is the Alpha?
videos.overview: Nedumaran stops Rajan's staff meeting and lets everyone know who the boss is. Aishu is selected for the Star Chef event. Vetri is shocked as Nedumaran replaces the pantry staff.

videos.title: Rebuffed
videos.overview: Veni scolds Vicky for being rude to Vetri. Nedumaran insults Vetri for questioning about the pantry. Ragupathi tells Rajan to take charge of the resort. Ramya proposes to Vetri.

videos.title: The Next CEO!
videos.overview: Nedumaran takes complete control of the resort, and everyone worries as word spreads that he'll be the next CEO. Ragupathi recovers and immediately calls for an investor's meeting.

videos.title: Bittersweet Departure
videos.overview: RR Resort is in chaos after Nedumaran walks out with his team. Rajan handles the situation calmly. Aishu bids farewell to Vetri. Nedumaran leaves the Kitchen with bitter emotion.

videos.title: Seizing the Day
videos.overview: Vicky exploits the situation at the resort. Vetri asks Riya to help him join the Kitchen team. While admitted in the hospital, Vetri’s mother reveals the truth about his father.

videos.title: Strengthening Ties
videos.overview: Rajan confidently meets the resort's investors and explains his future plans. Since Vicky struggles to run the Kitchen with reduced staff, Riya and Rajan offer him a solution.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Minion
videos.overview: Vetri asks for help from Veni and others for the Star Chef competition and goes in search of a former winner. As Nedumaran trains Aishu, he brews a sinister plan for the resort.

videos.title: Durai, the Savior ?
videos.overview: Rajan entrusts Vicky with arranging dinner for the investors. Nedumaran plots to take over RR Resort with Luther's help. Vetri waits desperately for Durai, but will he help him?

videos.title: Persistant Chef
videos.overview: Nedumaran trains Aishu for the competition at home. A stressed Aishu meets Selvin, but she cannot get Vetri out of her mind. Hearing his struggles, Durai agrees to help Vetri.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Durai sets to train Vetri if he passes three tests. Vicky informs Nedumaran about Vetri’s move. He tells Vetri he will run the kitchen during the training. Vetri clears two tests.

videos.title: The Dead Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri clears Durai's tough task with ease, and he promises to train him. Ragupathi, Riya and Rajan feel betrayed as Vicky executes his plan and shows his colours to the investors.

videos.title: Ragupathi's Reassurance
videos.overview: The situation at the resort worsens when board members pull back. When the employees begin to fear for their jobs, Ragupathi calls for a staff meeting.

videos.title: Dark Grief
videos.overview: Durai sees Chidambaram in Vetri and tells him about how he knew his father and his tragic past. When Veni calls Aishu to vent her frustration, the latter learns a startling truth.

videos.title: Good Luck
videos.overview: Just when Vetri completes his training, he gets a call from his sister that his mother is hospitalised. On the day of the competition, Nedumaran warns the organiser about Vetri.

videos.title: The Champion Returns
videos.overview: When Vetri goes to register for the competition, they question the legitimacy of Durai's signature. However, all hope is not lost.

videos.title: Chef's Culinary Clash Begins
videos.overview: Durai wishes Vetri and leaves. Aishu confronts Selvin for hiding about partaking in the competition. Nedumaran briefs Aishu. Meanwhile, will Vetri be able to handle the rounds?

videos.title: Memory of a Father
videos.overview: Vetri freezes before the first round. Later, he recalls his childhood memories with his father and that inspires him to make his first dish of the competition.

videos.title: The Sous Chefs
videos.overview: In the new round, Veni becomes Vetri's sous chef and Vicky becomes Aishu's. Veni's presence distracts Vicky, who misses her a lot.

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: Selvin wins an advantage and chooses a toughest ingredient to break his opponents. Durai's training helps Vetri, but he uses his time to help Aishu. Selvin’s query confuses Vetri.

videos.title: A Helpless Son
videos.overview: Aishu asks Nedumaran why he's so hell-bent on her winning the competition. Just before the finals, Vetri receives a devastating call from his sister about his mother's condition.

videos.title: The Final Dish
videos.overview: While Vetri stands still, feeling helpless, a timely help from a benefactor saves the day. However, when Vetri presents his final dish, the judges get upset with his presentation.

videos.title: The Star Chef Rises
videos.overview: The judges and viewers are moved after Vetri shares the concept behind his dish. Once the competition ends, Aishu tells her father her wish.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Everyone awaits the arrival of their new CEO at RR Resort, but their identity shocks them. Vetri settles his debts and returns to the resort, but his choice surprises Ragupathi.

videos.title: First Day, First Impressions
videos.overview: Five new doctors join RK Hospitals. On the very first day, things go from bad to worse for Reena, making a poor impression on chief doctor Radhi.

videos.title: Doctor Drama
videos.overview: Reena and Rocky are tasked to work with Dr Ramanadhan, aka Cinema Doctor. The doctors are in a tizzy when a child ends up with breathing issues that they can't diagnose.

videos.title: Tug Of War
videos.overview: When a surgery becomes problematic, Dr. Ravi freezes during the procedure. Sid leaves a drawing for Radhi inside her laptop, but the busy doctor fails to notice it until Reena helps.

videos.title: Notes To Night
videos.overview: It's not all work for our doctors as senior doctors Ravi and Anitha throw a celebratory party. Amidst drinks and merriment, Arjun and Reena reconnect.

videos.title: Heartbeats and Hangovers
videos.overview: The doctors experience the aftereffects of the party. A bad fall lands RK in the hospital. He meets the new doctors and learns about Arjun's 'love' interest.

videos.title: Doubt and Denial in the Shadows
videos.overview: Radhi gets furious when Reena voices her doubts about RK's medical condition. A concerned RK confides in Radhi. Dejected, Reena chastises Arjun.

videos.title: Repaired Connections
videos.overview: Reena feels disheartened as her colleagues shun her. Rocky apologises to her for RK's case. As she reconciles with Arjun, in the hospital, RK receives alarming news from Radhi.

videos.title: Mistake
videos.overview: Radhi gets furious with Reena for treating her son during a medical emergency. Realising her mistake, she tries to make amends with Reena. But a shocking news leaves her shattered.

videos.title: Facing Reality
videos.overview: Reena likes a flat and decides to move in immediately. Arjun learns about his father's condition. Reena sticks to her ground, unnerving Radhi.

videos.title: Home Transition
videos.overview: Ravi feels troubled during a surgery. Reena shifts to her new house. But what happens when she learns about another doctor in the neighbourhood?

videos.title: Unforgiving Heart
videos.overview: The past refuses to let Arjun forgive RK despite his health condition. Radhi tries to meet Reena but in vain. Rocky 'falls' for Reena, but is she interested?

videos.title: Emotional Roller-coaster
videos.overview: A criminal who is recuperating tries to escape from the hospital. As the situation gets tense, Reena steps in to handle the offender.

videos.title: Fulfilling Wishes, Finding Love
videos.overview: Reena breaks down after an exhaustive day at work. Ravi fulfils Jagan's last wish. An impressed Anitha kisses Ravi, leaving him confused.

videos.title: Doubts in Diagnosis
videos.overview: Ravi's confrontation leaves Anitha upset. Teju wins an opportunity to assist Radhi in a complicated surgery. However, was Radhi right in her diagnosis?

videos.title: Unmasking the Threat
videos.overview: Reena's first surgery is a success. She reprimands Arjun after discovering the truth about him. Radhi learns about the unknown enemy, a threat to her hospital.

videos.title: House Party
videos.overview: The doctors gather at Reena's house for a party. Some uninvited guests join in to multiply the fun. Rocky tries to woo Reena. But is she interested?

videos.title: Healthcare Urgency
videos.overview: Radhi decides to investigate more about MNM Hospital. Arjun tries to help during an emergency case at the hospital.

videos.title: Looming Danger
videos.overview: Teju learns about the looming threat to the hospital. Reena has to reflect on her abandoned childhood to help a teenager take the right step.

videos.title: Stealth Mission
videos.overview: Radhi has to relive her past trauma as she convinces Vinusha's father to forgive his daughter. The interns help Arjun to do the unthinkable.

videos.title: Battlefront Courage
videos.overview: The unknown enemy has shown his face. But can he win against the spirit of the doctors at RK Hospital?

videos.title: New Alliance
videos.overview: Madan has a new ally while Arjun starts getting involved in hospital management. Arjun has a squabble with Reena over their relationship.

videos.title: Alzheimer's Mystery
videos.overview: Teju begins her game as she gives a piece of advice to Arjun. Reena drops an Alzheimer’s patient home and is surprised to learn his identity.

videos.title: Hopeful Hearts
videos.overview: Anitha is shocked when Ravi reveals a secret. When Arjun seeks RK's permission to get involved in the hospital's activities, he feels hopeful about their relationship.

videos.title: Heartbreaks and Favours
videos.overview: Anitha has a heartbreak. RK seeks a favour from Radhi. Both Radhi and Arjun aim to protect the hospital but are they on the same team?

videos.title: CEO's Rise
videos.overview: Amidst internal doubts and external threats, RK Hospital faces a pivotal decision. Will Radhi thwart Arjun's rise to CEO, or will RK's plan secure the hospital's future?

videos.title: Paths to Leadership
videos.overview: Dev gets caught between defending his children and facing a harsh reality. Amidst personal and professional challenges, Radhi attempts to mentor Arjun as RK Hospital's potential CEO.

videos.title: Preparing for Destiny
videos.overview: As Radhi prepares Arjun for a pivotal task, personal and professional worlds collide as secrets unravel at the hospital, friendships are tested, and unexpected connections emerge.

videos.title: Comedy and Chaos
videos.overview: A furious Anitha seeks revenge. As Radhi juggles Teju's interference, Arjun's revelation leads to a game-changing conference at RK Hospital. Meanwhile, love is in the air.

videos.title: Rekindled Connections
videos.overview: Arjun rekindles the relationship with his father as they go on a fun outing. Reena's childhood friend pays a surprise visit to the hospital.

videos.title: Unexpected Insights
videos.overview: Radhi feels defeated as Arjun's pitch gets approved by the board. Dev helps a frustrated Radhi comprehend the situation. Rocky becomes a guest in his dinner plan with Reena.

videos.title: Complimented Impact
videos.overview: Radhi acknowledges Arjun's work. Anitha sets clear boundaries for Ravi. As RK opens his heart out to Reena, his compliment shocks her.

videos.title: Breaking Barriers
videos.overview: Reena confronts RK about his compliment. Arjun gets closure as he gathers the courage to talk to RK about Pallavi. The well-guarded secret of Radhi and Reena starts to crack.

videos.title: Protecting the Past
videos.overview: Sarada, the landlady, gets restless and tries to learn about Reena's past. Naveen makes a blunder that would put his career at risk, but Teju takes a drastic step to protect him.

videos.title: Heartbeat Moments
videos.overview: Ravi asks Guna and Rocky for a favour. Sarada invites Dev's family for dinner. While Rocky struggles to convince a patient's family for surgery, things get tense between Guna and Naveen.

videos.title: Hope In Recovery
videos.overview: Rocky manages to convince the tribals for surgery, but they have a condition. RK uses his experience to save Naveen's patient. Will Naveen get a second chance?

videos.title: The Perfect Plan
videos.overview: Sarada executes her plan to perfection, making both Radhi and Reena restless. A confused Reena tries to get out of the complex situation.

videos.title: Midnight Mischief
videos.overview: Radhi and Reena feel overwhelmed when the latter joins Radhi and her family for dinner. Sid and Divi make Reena part of their midnight mischief.

videos.title: Heart-to-Heart Conversations
videos.overview: Arjun proposes a celebration for the hospital's 20th anniversary. Anitha decides to talk to Ravi after her chat with Bharathi. Reena gets cornered by the interns about her night out.

videos.title: Ethnic Elegance
videos.overview: The hospital wears a festive look on the day of its anniversary. The doctors turn up in ethnic wear. However, the happiness is short-lived as tragedy strikes RK Hospital.

videos.title: Memories of a Mentor
videos.overview: The hospital mourns the demise of RK. Everybody reminisces their pleasant memories with him. Anitha feels flustered when Ravi opens up about his marriage.

videos.title: Clear Waters, Clear Words
videos.overview: Radhi takes care of Reena when she falls ill. Reena learns about Sarada's lie and confronts her. As Ravi and Anitha are back to being best friends, Bharathi encounters Anitha.

videos.title: Emotional Tokens
videos.overview: Anitha is irked as Ravi steals her thunder. Radhi orders Naveen to assist Aruna who obliges. As Reena bids goodbye to Radhi's family, Sid's gift makes them emotional.

videos.title: Journey of Healing
videos.overview: Reena compels Arjun to go out with her to help get him out of mourning. Anitha's frustration grows as Ravi gets credit for her hard work.

videos.title: The Art of Persuasion
videos.overview: Arjun comes back to the hospital and announces his arrival with a speech. The power dynamic gets interesting as Radhi approves Ramanathan's request despite Arjun rejecting it.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: Sid and Divi ask Reena for a favour. Laya bids goodbye to Rocky. When Arjun confronts Radhi for overruling him, she firmly states that he is not the CEO of the hospital.

videos.title: Unexpected Revelations
videos.overview: The team is shocked to learn about Guna's father. Arjun gets irked when Reena tries to defend Radhi. Ravi confronts Anitha and she informs him about Bharathi's feelings.

videos.title: Clash of Egos
videos.overview: Ravi scolds Bharathi, but Anitha decides to move on. Arjun tries to prove a point, and Radhi puts him down with facts. Things turn ugly between Ravi and Anitha.

videos.title: Corporate Twist
videos.overview: Reena helps Sid get into the football team. The race for the post of the CEO takes an interesting turn when Madan makes a grand entry into the hospital.

videos.title: Team Dynamics
videos.overview: Radhi announces that two interns will become resident doctors by the end of the year and explains how they will be evaluated. She makes it clear to Madan that she is not his ally.

videos.title: Mentor Rivalry
videos.overview: Ravi and Anitha get competitive as they mentor the interns. Guna is unhappy when a celebrity dancer is admitted to the hospital. Dev grows curious as the kids lie about Reena.

videos.title: Privacy Breach
videos.overview: Teju reckons that Reena and Guna's diagnosis might be wrong. Jennifer tries to spend time with Guna. Bharathi confronts Anitha for revealing her secret to Ravi.

videos.title: Rivalry Victorious
videos.overview: Dev confronts Reena about her visit to the kid's school. As Teju cracks the case and takes it over from Reena and Guna, Ravi feels victorious.

videos.title: Strife and Solidarity
videos.overview: Reena argues with Radhi regarding a case. Charu seeks Rocky's help to plan a party. While Madan fails to manipulate Arjun, the group reunites as Guna and Naveen bury the hatchet.

videos.title: Emotional Breakdown
videos.overview: Dev runs into Ganesh and realises that Reena lied to him. In the hospital, Reena breaks down as she fails to save the baby. Radhi consoles her and gives her some advice.

videos.title: Social Tensions
videos.overview: The interns manage to get Radhi's permission to attend the party. Ravi rants to Arjun as things get tense with Anitha and Bharathi. As everyone is having fun, Naveen ends up in a spot.

videos.title: Babysitting Chaos
videos.overview: Dev tells Radhi about the lies of Reena and the kids. Reena and Arjun babysit Divi and her friends. As Radhi and Dev look for Divi, the situation goes out of hand in the pool.

videos.title: Tensions Rise
videos.overview: Radhi gives an ultimatum to the kids. When Ganesh learns of the incident, he confronts Radhi. While Madan and Teju team up again, Ravi apologises to Bharathi.

videos.title: Walk Together
videos.overview: Upset, Reena opens up to Arjun. While Rocky and Guna fight for a patient, Ravi attends to an ex-military officer. Arjun takes Reena for a walk and tries to comfort her.

videos.title: Cop Encounter
videos.overview: Guna and Rocky go out of their way to impress Kevin, but land in trouble with the cops. Babloo and Divi make a plan to apologise to Reena.

videos.title: Sneak Attempt
videos.overview: Radhi and Reena blame each other for what happened. Rocky seeks Reena's help to fulfil Kevin's wish. However, chaos ensues at the girl's hostel, landing them in trouble.

videos.title: Hospital Shock
videos.overview: Reena falls head over heels for Arjun as he takes her on a surprise date. While Teju is looking for an opportunity, a patient's unexpected death shakes the hospital.

videos.title: Chaos Advantage
videos.overview: Arjun and Anitha console Bharathi as the police take Ravi for questioning. Madan takes advantage of the entire situation. Divi and the kids outsmart Dev to apologise to Reena.

videos.title: Hospital Whispers
videos.overview: Jennifer opens up to Guna when he confronts her. Ravi feels low as everyone gossips about him. While Radhi advises Ravi not to handle critical cases, Bharathi gets a lead.

videos.title: Desperate Measures
videos.overview: Bharathi gets anxious to spot Anitha comforting Ravi. Madan resolves to dismiss Ravi, leaving Radhi feeling helpless. As Arjun is frantic to stop the arrest, Bharathi cracks the case.

videos.title: Hospital Politics
videos.overview: Ravi ploys to get close to Bharathi. Guna happily bonds with his mother. While Arjun and Madan agree on the need for a CEO in the hospital, a high-profile patient creates an uproar.

videos.title: Diagnostic Debate
videos.overview: Aruna motivates Naveen when Radhi challenges the interns to find a solution for Meera's case. Naveen comes up with a better course of treatment. What will be Radhi's decision?

videos.title: Past Actions, Present Consequences
videos.overview: The board seeks nominations for the CEO's role, and Arjun and Madan are shocked to see Radhi in the race. Anitha mocks Ravi for his past actions as she gets credit for a tough surgery.

videos.title: Tension in the Ranks
videos.overview: Irked with Ravi, Bharathi plays a prank on him. Arjun gets anxious as he learns about Madan's plans. Ravi mocks Rocky as he gets into an awkward situation with Laya and Charu.

videos.title: A Surprising Request
videos.overview: Reena seeks Rocky's help in her plan to propose to Arjun. While Asha throws tantrums about Jennifer being in Guna's hospital, Naveen gets shocked by Meera's request.

videos.title: Unwanted Attention
videos.overview: Arjun feels awkward as his past love stories become the central topic during the team's campus visit. Wary about risking his career again, Naveen refuses to comply with Meera's plea

videos.title: Failed Attempts
videos.overview: Ravi is shocked as Bharathi gets her visa. Arjun tries to make peace with Radhi but in vain. Naveen manages to confide in Radhi about Meera's case, but how will she react to him?

videos.title: Picture Mystery
videos.overview: Dev asks Radhi about a kid's photo in the closet. Teju figures out why Madan is in a hurry to take over the hospital. As Reena decides to propose to Arjun, he learns a shocking truth.

videos.title: Shattered Hopes
videos.overview: Arjun breaks up with Reena, leaving her shattered. Naveen thanks Radhi for trusting him and apologises for his mistake. Reena opens up about her past to Rocky.

videos.title: Accusations and Regrets
videos.overview: Teju confirms her theory about Madan with Kishore's help. Ravi is unhappy about Bharathi going abroad. Arjun blames Reena when Sonia confronts him about his reaction.

videos.title: The Missing Piece
videos.overview: Teju figures out the missing piece of the puzzle when she overhears Arjun and Anitha. She confronts Madan about it. Arjun is surprised as he gets a crucial piece of information.

videos.title: A Battle for Life
videos.overview: Dev gets irked as the kids' secret visits to Reena haven't stopped. Arjun confronts Teju, who justifies her actions. Naveen and Reena work towards saving their patients' lives.

videos.title: Medical Ethics at Stake
videos.overview: Reena and Naveen convince Nirmal's parents to donate his organs to Yazhini. Ravi vows to win over Bharathi before she leaves for the US. Reena scolds Sonia for causing her trouble.

videos.title: Hope Amidst Despair
videos.overview: Reena decides to save Nirmal after Yazhini succumbs to her illness. Ravi takes Bharathi out to get close to her, but she misunderstands him. Madan faces pressure from his investors.

videos.title: Misinterpreted Feelings
videos.overview: The entire hospital gathers to honour Yazhini. Ravi confesses his feelings to Bharathi but she gets irked. Guna admits the truth when Asha confronts him about Jennifer.

videos.title: Unexpected Encounters
videos.overview: Kishore overhears a shocking revelation. Radhi gets anxious after a complaint gets lodged with the medical board. As the interns discuss the leak, Madan has a surprise visitor.

videos.title: Awkward Interrogations
videos.overview: Naveen confronts Madan for misusing the data he provided. Jennifer asks Reena about her family. The medical board acts in favour of the hospital, but Radhi is curious about the leak.19

videos.title: High Stakes Game
videos.overview: As Radhi asks the interns to step up in the final month of the competition, Madan tries to up the stakes for Naveen. Guna confronts Teju about the deleted logs.

videos.title: Passing Findings
videos.overview: Sonia seeks Rocky's help to reunite Reena and Arjun. Reena asks Radhi about her father. The interns pass on their findings to Naveen and help him win the case.

videos.title: Fiasco Fallout
videos.overview: The hospital enters a crisis mode as all the patients start showing side effects. As the doctors finally figure out the issue, Arjun blames Radhi for the fiasco.

videos.title: A confrontation of Hypocrisy
videos.overview: Radhi stands her ground when Arjun calls out her hypocrisy. Sonia and Rocky's plan to reunite Arjun and Reena fails. Ravi feels dejected by Bharathi's decision to leave for the US.

videos.title: A Starting Revelation
videos.overview: Ravi seeks Anitha and Arjun's help to plan the wedding, while Guna makes Reena volunteer from Bharathi's side. Reena confronts Arjun and makes a startling disclosure.

videos.title: A Failed Surgery
videos.overview: Naveen gets tense as Teju doubts him. Arjun surprises Reena. Naveen fails in Nidhun's surgery, and lashes at the interns. Ravi and Anitha take their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Tracing the Leak
videos.overview: Teju gets curious as Radhi seeks Arjun's help to trace the leak. Naveen bids an emotional goodbye to his friends but Radhi has a surprise for him.

videos.title: A Web of Lies
videos.overview: The interns decide not to help each other in the competition. Radhi confronts Reena if Rocky knows about them. Reena ends up in a tussle with Dev.

videos.title: Party Under Pressure
videos.overview: The competition gets intense as the interns go all out to win. Teju begins to suspect Madan and Naveen. Arjun gets nervous as the group meets up for Ravi's bachelor party.

videos.title: Joy and Jeopardy
videos.overview: Anitha calms a nervous Bharathi. The friends cheer as Ravi and Bharathi get married again. One of the intern's family members is admitted to the hospital in a critical condition.

videos.title: A Father's Struggle
videos.overview: Teju breaks down on seeing her father's critical condition. Ravi bids goodbye to Bharathi as she leaves for the US. The board members announce the date for the election of the CEO.

videos.title: The Competition Countdown
videos.overview: Radhi, Madan and Arjun analyse their chances of winning the CEO election. Radhi tells the interns that the winner of their competition will be announced in two days.

videos.title: Cracking the Case
videos.overview: Teju finds a solution to the alcoholic boy's case. Naveen warns Madan when he tries to get help from Teju. Radhi is shocked as Arjun makes a startling revelation.

videos.title: Unveiling the Mole
videos.overview: Radhi gets anxious as she tries to find out who the mole is. She announces the winner of the competition, but things get tense as she confronts the interns about Arjun's revelation.

videos.title: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: The D-Day finally arrives. All three CEO contenders present their action plan for the hospital. As things heat up, the big secret gets out in the open.

videos.title: Deadlock Drama
videos.overview: The board members announce the results, and it's a tie. They suggest a unique solution. Arjun's revelation spreads throughout the hospital, and Reena lashes out at him.

videos.title: Lines Drawn
videos.overview: Radhi is anxious but doesn't have the courage to open up to Dev. Reena makes her stance clear to Arjun when he tries to explain.

videos.title: The Truth Strikes
videos.overview: Dev confronts Radhi and creates a scene at Reena's house. Arjun tells Teju about the board's decision regarding her. When she tells Naveen, he makes a startling revelation.

videos.title: The Final Encounter
videos.overview: Radhi breaks down in front of Reena and begs her to leave. At the railway station, Reena finally meets the person she has been searching for years and makes a decision.

videos.title: New Beginnings, Old Wounds

videos.title: Old Connections
videos.overview: Vijay and Aradhana reconnect after years apart. Meanwhile, Arjun's exam scores drop, and Vijay pressures him to reveal the truth to Reena.

videos.title: A Painful Truth
videos.overview: Reena finally knows who her donor is, which devastates her. At the hospital, she meets Rocky to show him Radhi's medical reports that raise questions she cannot easily ignore.

videos.title: A Growing Concern
videos.overview: Aradhana becomes wary of Raghav reporting her father's false hospitalisation. As Reena and Vijay get ready to leave for Bengaluru, she presents Radhi's medical report to him.

videos.title: A Sudden Crisis
videos.overview: Reena worries about Radhi's health and plans to get a second blood test out of her mother. When that fails, she confronts Radhi about her health that escalates into an emergency.

videos.title: Two Months!
videos.overview: Radhi agrees to consider a medical test but places an unexpected condition on Reena. While Reena struggles with the decision, Manasa encounters a new problem.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Pressure builds as Vijay is urged to return to Bangalore hospital. Meanwhile, Reena tries to protect Radhi and deal with the growing tension around her health.

videos.title: Critical Hours
videos.overview: A routine hospital visit takes a turn when Sharmi’s condition demands immediate attention. While her husband tries to accept the situation, Rocky makes a crucial medical decision.

videos.title: Old Memories
videos.overview: Aradhana and Vijay revisit memories from their medical college days, recalling the difficult path that shaped their lives. And an old connection begins to take on new meaning.

videos.title: The Dead Star
videos.overview: An abandoned corpse is identified to be a famous movie star and the news gains huge publicity. In the past, a beautiful young girl, Velonie, has her interests torn between her secret love, Tony, and her jealous fiancé, Vignesh.

videos.title: Vivek Takes Charge
videos.overview: The murder investigation gains steam as sub-inspector Vivek is assigned to the case. Vivek suspects Vignesh and Tony. He links the place, Ottaparai, to the murder and interviews an old lady. In the past, Velonie instantly warms up with an elderly novelist, Ki Sebastian who checks into the lodge run by her mother.

videos.title: Brothers in Crime
videos.overview: Vivek takes the three sons of the old lady for an enquiry after Dr Paulraj, the autopsy doctor, has reasons to believe that they could be linked to Velonie’s murder. Based on Vignesh’s call records and a discussion with Velonie’s friend, Vivek suspects Vignesh again.

videos.title: Closed, but Unresolved
videos.overview: The police pins the murder on Vignesh and closes the case. There is a public backlash against the police for their hasty conclusion. Vivek is not at peace and wants to do justice to the victim inspite of his obsession with the case affecting his personal life. Jones, the mansion help, gives a lead about Velonie.

videos.title: An Intellectual Killer
videos.overview: Ruby tells Vivek about Velonie meeting a tall and muscular man after Church.Ki Sebastian meets Vivek urging him to solve the case and clear Velonie’s tainted image.

videos.title: From Bad to Worse
videos.overview: The confessions of the old lady in Ottaparai again points to the three brothers. Her deeply disturbing narrative puts Velonie in a scandalous position. A new suspect, a tall and muscular man, emerges. Vivek manages to capture the three brothers but pays a heavy price for it. Velonie’s new scandalous image stirs up the public involvement once again.

videos.title: A Fictitious Fact
videos.overview: Ki Sebastian, determined to clean up the public’s image of Velonie, releases a book on Veloine's life and death. Starting from her childhood, it builds up to the recent times when she falls for a mysterious tall and muscular man. He identifies this man as the murderer. His readers readily buy into it but not Vivek. Vivek pursues a lead given by the three brothers – Valan.

videos.title: The Vadhandhi Continues
videos.overview: Vivek follows his gut instinct about Valan though no evidence links him to the murder. Vivek decides to give up. A chance clue awakens Vivek’s mind leading him to a revelation. But is it too late to save Velonie's legacy?

videos.title: Buried Along the Highway
videos.overview: When the foundation-laying ceremony of a highway project unearths a skeleton, all hell breaks loose. SP Rathika appoints SI Moosa Raaza, a straightforward cop who's infamous for his doggedness, as the Lead Investigator. As he digs deeper, he finds a much bigger mystery - one that leads him to Mani.

videos.title: The Rustic Charm
videos.overview: When SI Moosa Raaza seeks DNA testing to identify skeletal remains, the results reveal a match to the very victim Mani is imprisoned for murdering. Raaza faces intense moral turmoil as he realizes his discovery might result in an innocent man's wrongful conviction.

videos.title: Hidden in Plain Sight
videos.overview: Haunted by Mani's suicide attempt in prison, SI Moosa Raaza is consumed by doubts about Mani's guilt in the double murder. As testimonies crack and friends reveal secrets, Mani himself refuses to defend his innocence. Just as Raaza's intiuition sharpens, a new DNA report shatters certainty-revealing a hidden trace that suggests the true killer still walks free.

videos.title: The Love That Kills
videos.overview: SP Rathika brings in her lawyer-husband Sukumaran to help with Mani's case. Mani opens up to SI Moosa and Sukumaran and recalls what happened with him and Nilavathi. However, Moosa and SP Rathika must find a way to reopen the case against the wishes of their higher-ups, even if it means staking everything. With official channels closing in, Raaza devises a bold strategy to turn the tables.

videos.title: A Severed Hand Points South
videos.overview: Mani's memories of Nilavathi haunt him as Moosa presses forward despite political pressure. DNA results disappoint. Nilavathi's father confronts Moosa about reopening wounds. A gruesome discovery-a human hand dragged by a stray dog-adds urgency, tying Mani's case to a chilling new crime.

videos.title: The Deceiving DNA
videos.overview: SP Rathika and SI Moosa face the IG's hostility over DNA evidence linking six murders. He wants to wrap up the case ASAP. Media frenzy grows, Mani's mother struggles, and Sumaya fears Raaza's obsession. The spectre of a serial killer looms, but politics and human frailty complicate the hunt.

videos.title: Under the Veil
videos.overview: Mani reunites briefly with his family. Moosa and Dr. Dhanapal confront baffling DNA contradictions. However, a shocking discovery reveals the source of the "serial killer's DNA". Still, Moosa begins to unravel gaps in Mani's past that lead to deeper questions and shock.

videos.title: Boon?... Or a Bane?
videos.overview: Moosa's faith shaken by a partly resolved mystery, decides to take a firm hand with Mani and Sundaresan to uncover the hidden facets of Mani's past. As the full story begins to unravel, Moosa pieces together the truth behind the deaths of Nilavathi and Venba. Realizing that truth is indeed stranger than fiction, Moosa is left to wonder if his profession is ultimately a bane rather than a boon

videos.title: First Wave of the Ocean
videos.overview: Lingam's long-awaited police appointment is delayed, pushing him into a high-stakes tournament. But when a fierce match turns violent, a shocking murder changes everything.

videos.title: Shadow of the Cry
videos.overview: The police finally track down Lingam. Inside the prison, he endures brutal torture, humiliation and violence that slowly harden him into a ruthless and emotionally scarred man.

videos.title: The Fury of Fate
videos.overview: The cops harass Lingam by making him the go-to suspect for any crime. Chelladurai also underhandedly uses him as a henchman. Pushed to his limits, Lingam's anger boils over.

videos.title: The Sea Rises
videos.overview: Lingam joins Chellapandian's illicit liquor network and plays a major role in expanding his business. After saving his boss from a deadly attack, Lingam earns his trust.

videos.title: The Season of Betrayal
videos.overview: Lingam marries Ponmalar, hoping to finally build a peaceful life. But a conspiracy unfolds involving poisoned liquor. Enraged, Lingam begins hunting down those responsible.

videos.title: The Chill of a Mild Tremor
videos.overview: Driven by revenge for Chellapandian's death, Lingam hunts down Samiyappan. While helping a young couple, he finds himself in a crisis and is compelled to go into hiding.

videos.title: The Breaking Palm Tree
videos.overview: Lingam rises as the undisputed kingpin of Kanyakumari. As his friendship with Thiru deteriorates, Lingam discovers the puppeteer pulling Chellapandian and Samiyappan's strings.

videos.title: The Burning Sea
videos.overview: Devastated by Bhaskar's death, Lingam swears revenge against Chelladurai, adding to his mother's misery. Lingam gives Chelladurai 30 days to prepare for the consequences.
