videos.overview: After Keerthy rejects the marriage, SS and Jayshree hide it from Ponmalar. SS plans a trip to Ahmedabad to procure stock for Ponmalar Textiles and asks Girija to accompany him.

videos.title: Madhu Convinces Girija!
videos.overview: Madhu encourages Girija not to accompany SS on the Ahmedabad trip, accusing the latter of being selfish. Meanwhile, Jaggu strikes up a new friendship with Meena.

videos.title: SS's Silent Hurt
videos.overview: Jayshree and her sisters plan to reunite their parents by making Ponmalar sleep in their father's room. SS is deeply hurt when they question his business decisions.

videos.title: A Twist on Madhu's Birthday
videos.overview: After Girija leaves for Ahmedabad with SS, Madhu is left alone on her birthday. She invites Jaggu to her house and feeling sorry for her, he visits her. But a surprise awaits him.

videos.title: Meera's Smart Move
videos.overview: As SS leaves for Ahmedabad with Girija, Jaggu and the sisters try to disrupt their trip. Meera’s smart move of joining Ponmalar Textiles surprises everyone.

videos.title: Harini's Unexpected Demand
videos.overview: Harini agrees to accept Siddharth's love with a shocking condition, leaving him torn. Meanwhile, Ponmalar discovers why Keerthi rejected the wedding proposal.

videos.title: SS Under Meera's Watch
videos.overview: After the family's pleas, SS lets Meera intern at Ponmalar textiles. However, rather than concentrating on her training, Meera remains highly observant of SS's every action.

videos.title: Girija Seeks SS's Support
videos.overview: Girija opposes Madhu's love interest, leading to a rift between them. She hopes for support from SS. A heated argument between Priyan and Jayshree unexpectedly brings them closer.

videos.title: SS Lies to Ponmalar
videos.overview: Madhu's hospitalisation forces SS to rush to her and her mother, but Ponmalar has questions. Meanwhile, Siddharth goes to Girija's apartment building in search of a new house.

videos.title: Siddharth Alarms Harini with Truth
videos.overview: Siddharth agrees to Harini's request to live near Girija's house and reveals that he knows the truth. Girija catches Madhu on a call with Jaggu and questions her.

videos.title: Jayshree, Priyan's Special Moment
videos.overview: SS rages at Girija for visiting his shop when his daughter is present. Jayshree helps Priyan admit his pregnant sister to the hospital and they share a heartfelt moment together.

videos.title: Siddharth Takes Harini Home
videos.overview: Priyan is deeply touched as Jayshree gets nutritious postnatal meal for his sister at the hospital. Siddharth introduces Harini to his mother. Velpandi spots them and gets upset.

videos.title: Madhu's Love Confession
videos.overview: Madhu bares her heart to Jaggu, but his unexpected response leaves her shattered. Meanwhile, Siddharth performs his house-warming ceremony and meets Girija.

videos.title: Jayshree's Fumble
videos.overview: Siddharth plays the good neighbour to Girija when she is away from home. Ponmalar again coaxes Jayshree to consider marrying. To pacify her, Jayshree blurts out a lie.

videos.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan
videos.overview: SS resists the auditor's pressure to sell his textile business as Jaggu seeks a solution. At the hospital, Ponmalar runs into Priyan and mistakes his and Jayshree's bond for love.

videos.title: SS Draws the Line
videos.overview: As Thangam and her sons take charge of SS's security, SS asks Jaggu to end the arrangement. When SS confides in Girija, she advises him to sell Ponmalar Textiles.

videos.title: Madhu's Heartfelt Confession
videos.overview: As SS struggles with a crisis at Ponmalar Textiles, Jayshree offers legal help. Elsewhere, Madhu makes an emotional confession to Jaggu and questions why he cannot love her back.

videos.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan's Family
videos.overview: Ponmalar decides to visit Priyan and his family to check on them, leaving Jayshree in shock. Meanwhile, Girija changes Madhu's mind and begins searching for a groom for her.

videos.title: SS Goes Missing
videos.overview: SS mysteriously goes missing, throwing Girija's household into chaos when the groom's family arrives. Ponmalar and her daughters desperately search for SS, fearing for his safety.

videos.title: Jaggu Seeks Thangam's Help
videos.overview: Jaggu approaches Meenu and asks for Thangam's help in finding his missing father. Meanwhile, Harini asks Siddharth to seek his father's assistance in moving the case forward.

videos.title: Girija Avoids SS
videos.overview: SS returns home after going missing for a night. Girija is angry with SS and refuses to answer his calls. As the stress builds, she faints, and Siddharth helps her.

videos.title: SS Faces Girija's Wrath
videos.overview: SS worries about Girija avoiding his calls and goes to her house. Once there, she vents her frustration and disappointment.

videos.title: Ponmalar Talks About Priyan
videos.overview: Madhu and Girija plan to rent out their house without SS's involvement. Ponmalar has a conversation with Jayshree about Priyan.

videos.title: Priyan Plays Reluctant Cupid
videos.overview: Baskar approaches Jayshree using Priyan's phone, creating friction between Jayshree and Priyan. Girija realises SS was indeed kidnapped.

videos.title: Jaggu Doubts Jayshree-Priyan's Bond
videos.overview: Jaggu spots Jayshree having tea with Priyan and suspects they are more than friends. He shares his doubts with Ponmalar, while Meera struggles to convince SS about online sales.

videos.title: Jayshree's Feelings Surface
videos.overview: Priyan's gift stirs new feelings in Jayshree. While the Ponmalar Textiles staff voice their concerns about online sales to SS, Girija reconciles with him and awaits his visit.

videos.title: A Critical Turn for Jaggu
videos.overview: Jaggu has been hospitalised following an accident, which has left SS feeling distressed. Meanwhile, Girija is anxiously waiting for SS at home, oblivious to the situation.

videos.title: Jaggu's Truth Reaches His Sisters
videos.overview: Madhu visits Jaggu in the hospital and lashes out at him for cheating on her. Meera, Harini and Jayshree witness the confrontation and discover the truth about their relationship.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Mission to Free Mohan
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Mohan in jail and promises to get him out. Since she needs Girija’s signature to appeal in court, she asks Siddharth to help reach out to Mohan’s daughter, Madhu.

videos.title: Siddharth Caught in SS’s Suspicion
videos.overview: Photographer Vivek makes Meera the model for Ponmalar Textiles’ photoshoot. The security guard mistakenly assumes Siddharth is meeting Girija and Madhu and informs SS about it.

videos.title: Madhu's Modelling Break
videos.overview: SS is upset with Vivek after seeing Meera as the model, while Vivek approaches Madhu for the next campaign. Elsewhere, Kala's visit to the doctor brings an unexpected twist.

videos.title: When Ponmalar Meets Madhu
videos.overview: Vivek's request for help with Madhu's saree brings Madhu and Ponmalar together for the first time. Elsewhere, Madhu and Girija seek a loan to kick-start their business.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Unexpected Shock
videos.overview: SS advises Girija against starting a business, while Mohan seeks financial aid from outside source. Jayshree visits Priyan to confess her feelings, but she is in for a big shock.

videos.title: Priyan Proposes to Jayshree!
videos.overview: Girija and Madhu are surprised when their loan gets approved by the bank. Meanwhile, Priyan proposes to Jayshree not knowing what she is going through.

videos.title: Velpandi’s Startling Decision
videos.overview: Jayshree confesses to Harini why she rejected Priyan’s love, while Priyan struggles with heartbreak. Siddhu is elated as Velpandi finally accepts Harini as his daughter-in-law.

videos.title: Velpandi Corners Harini
videos.overview: SS meets Punniyakodi for a groom for Jayshree, but Ponmalar understands her daughter’s plight. Harini visits Velpandi, whose strategic move could change the course of her wedding.

videos.title: Jayshree Draws the Line
videos.overview: Jaggu and his sisters learn about Girija’s new boutique. Jayshree meets Priyan and expresses her concerns about taking their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Meera Caught in the Middle
videos.overview: Vivek gives Meera a ride home, but Ashwin notices them, and his insecurity leads to a major drama. Meanwhile, Jayshree finds a lead that could help her get Mohan released.

videos.title: Priyan Fights for Jayshree
videos.overview: Priyan is caught between his love for Jayshree and his sister’s opposition. Meanwhile, Madhu and Vivek grow closer while returning from a shoot.

videos.title: Brother and Sisters’ Masterplan
videos.overview: SS secretly plans to attend the Pooja at Girija’s boutique. Sensing his move, Meera alerts her siblings, and they hatch a masterplan to stop their father from reaching the shop

videos.title: SS' Disappointment Turns to Anger
videos.overview: As SS couldn't attend Girija's shop-opening ceremony, the emotional equation between him and Girija gets shaken, frustrating SS. Jaggu finds out who tried to run him down.

videos.title: SS and Girija's Growing Distance
videos.overview: Girija avoids SS after being disappointed with him. Meanwhile, SS is puzzled about who invited Punniyakodi to Girija's shop-opening ceremony.

videos.title: Kala's Wedding Pressure
videos.overview: Kala starts pressuring Siddharth and Velpandi to approach Harini's family about her son's wedding. Meanwhile, Ashwin becomes possessive about Meera and Vivek's friendship.

videos.title: SS Tries to Pacify Girija
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Priyan to seek his help in approaching a minister for Mohan's release. Meanwhile, SS tries to pacify Girija's anger by referring his customers to her shop.

videos.title: SS Begins to Suspect
videos.overview: Meena is angry with Jaggu for leaking the auditor’s video. SS gets wary that someone is trying to create a rift between him and Girija on learning about Madhu’s search for Chandra.

videos.title: Siddharth’s Clever Plan
videos.overview: Madhu gets furious with Girija for forgiving SS. Siddharth suggests that his parents, Kala and Velpandi visit bride Harini’s family, but without him.

videos.title: Jayshree Avoids the Awkwardness
videos.overview: Harini gets SS’s permission to arrange the groom’s visit at her house. Meanwhile, Jayshree leaves to visit Chandra on the same day to avoid the awkwardness at home.

videos.title: Jayshree Finally Finds Chandra
videos.overview: Siddharth’s parents visit SS’s house. While Jaggu insists that Jayshree’s marriage should happen first, Jayshree, Priyan, and Madhu finally find Chandra. Did she recognize them?

videos.title: Two-Headed Serpent
videos.overview: Based on his excellent academic record, a poor fisherwoman dreams of her son becoming a government officer one day. DSP Maramalli is transferred to Thykara police station a week ahead of the highly competitive RPSE exams. Jhansi pulls off a high-risk stunt, leaving Maramalli helpless. A nervous Jhansi takes over as DSP. Can Jhansi's deception hold against the truth?

videos.title: The Path to the Unknown Destiny
videos.overview: Reeling from the loss of his mother, the fisherwoman's son becomes disillusioned after a wealthy woman reveals how her son became a coveted government officer. In Thykara, Jhansi, guided by her mentor Jayachandran, starts investigating RPSE training institutions. Maramalli continues to fight a silent battle. Jhansi's mask is at risk when uninvited guests show up at the police station.

videos.title: The Faceless Shadow
videos.overview: With his hopes crushed, yet his mind sharp as ever, the fisherwoman's son seeks Shanti Amma's help to land a new job. Jhansi convinces Maramalli's mother that Maramalli is on a covert undercover operation and must not be disturbed. Jhansi resorts to aggression to further unearth the scam. Maramalli gets crafty and makes a smart attempt to escape. Is it the endgame for Jhansi's deception?

videos.title: The Strangled Voice
videos.overview: The fisherwoman's son's life pivots as he takes up his new job near an RPSE Coaching Institute. Young Jhansi and Young Maramalli take up their RPSE exams, oblivious to what the future holds. Young Jhansi's life is thrown into a downward spiral. Jailer Jayachandran takes Jhansi under his wings.

videos.title: Come Forth, O Sword-Bearer
videos.overview: The fisherwoman's son's ambition puts him at odds with a powerful man, and he begins to forge his own path. Jayachandran actively pursues a lead in investigating the suspicious suicide at an RPSE training institute. Jhansi uses yet another trick to close in on the scammers, and is stunned by the involvement of an unanticipated person. A phone call leaves Jhansi shattered.

videos.title: The Fury of the Red Tea
videos.overview: Kumaresan's hidden past comes to light, revealing powerful connections. Believing they have finally figured out the scam, Jhansi's team sets an elaborate trap for the masterminds. But as they focus on their target, the real threat emerges from an unexpected corner. Jhansi and Maramalli are forced into a reluctant alliance to fight their way out.

videos.title: The Fish That Hunted for the Duck
videos.overview: On the day of the RPSE exam, Jhansi discovers that she has been outplayed by Kumaresan's cunning plan. The walls close in on her from all sides, and she is left to fight for survival. Kumaresan's past deeds catch up with him, revealing a darker shade of the scam. Is justice finally served to Jhansi, or is she doomed forever?

videos.title: The Immortal Smile
videos.overview: A quiet rural police station on the verge of shutting down is suddenly thrown into action when a shocking discovery emerges.

videos.title: The Enigma
videos.overview: The frustrating search for the head's identity starts yielding unconnected stories from unexpected sources. The policemen finally get a clue, and it is an elephant.

videos.title: Queen of the Arabian Sea
videos.overview: In Kerala, Sidharthan and Thangamudi find the elephant and reach the place where Muthu worked years ago. A bomb blast at an orphanage becomes a new puzzle to solve.

videos.title: The Fragrance of Henna
videos.overview: In Tamil Nadu, Kaalai Pandian listens to Sittu's story of Muthu and Meena's blooming love. In Kerala, Benny remembers how Muthu calmed an elephant's fury.

videos.title: Sleepless City Blues
videos.overview: The relationship between Muthu and Meena in Madurai comes to light. A chance encounter in the forest reveals how Muthu's courage set Benny's political journey in motion.

videos.title: Things Fall Apart
videos.overview: Sidharthan finds Jessy, who narrates Muthu's stint at the orphanage a decade back, ending in a bomb blast. Benny agrees to meet the investigators.

videos.title: Friends, Foes and Fortunes
videos.overview: Benny reveals more about Sivendra's secretive life and a long-standing rivalry. But Sidharthan suspects there's more to the story than what he's being told.

videos.title: Separation
videos.overview: Meena confides in Jessy about the final days she spent with Muthu. With this lead, Sidharthan finds Bastin, who completes the story of Sivendra and Johny.

videos.title: Nemesis
videos.overview: At a vibrant temple festival, a new side of Muthu comes to light as rising tensions among local youths spiral into chaos. The night takes a dark and unexpected turn.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: Pattalam Babu reveals to Sidharthan how Johny targeted Muthu once he was released from prison and its horrific consequences. The inspector finally pieces everything together.

videos.title: First Innings
videos.overview: Rangan, once a celebrated cricket hero, is now working as a PT instructor. Rukmani, the head of MNCA, hopes that new batch of players will help restore the academy’s legacy.

videos.title: Campus Oath
videos.overview: The juniors take a tour of the academy. Coach Natraj warns to adhere to discipline when the boys’ team returns from a disqualified match. Hostel nights reveal ragging antics.

videos.title: Morning Runs
videos.overview: Coaches Natraj and Selvam test the players' diving skills and patience after they face Rukmani’s fury for being late. Rukmani battles threats that could shut the academy forever.

videos.title: Ghost Practice
videos.overview: Falling for the seniors’ ghost tale, the juniors dare each other to pre-dawn practice. Rishi impresses at the nets, making Velu jealous. Mani, Thangam and Theo’s bond gets strong.

videos.title: Dream Wakeup
videos.overview: Rukmani faces the MNCA’s sponsors who warn about Matheyan’s uncontrolled anger. A fight in the canteen creates cracks between the juniors and seniors. Mani dreams about Thangam.

videos.title: Footwork and Footwear
videos.overview: Matheyan and Jackie help Mani make a video to impress his dad and get money to buy shoes for Thangam. An astrologer predicts that someone from Rangan’s past will reenter his life.

videos.title: Hidden Torture
videos.overview: Seniors turn training into bullying, masked as combined drills, leaving Veera terrified. Thangam’s breakthrough in bowling is hidden by strong family pressure to get married.

videos.title: Revenge Storm
videos.overview: Veera’s gangster father storms MNCA over ragging, forcing Rukmani into a public apology. Rajasekar’s inspection ends with a brutal shutdown threat, and he now vows revenge.

videos.title: Mani’s Mission
videos.overview: Mani confronts Rukmani about the academy shutting down. Rukmani exposes Rajasekar’s drug expulsion past. Thangam and Rishi worry about their parents’ decision about the academy.

videos.title: Pair Up Pressure
videos.overview: Theo and Matheyan form senior-junior training pairs. Rangan takes Mani to spy on Anchor Cricket Academy’s high-tech facilities. A kitchen disaster brings Rishi and Thangam closer.

videos.title: Hidden Feelings
videos.overview: Rukmani is shaken by Rajasekar’s threats. Preparations for the 50th-year alumni gala begin. Mani hides his feelings for Thangam while Rukmani sets to train young Valli in cricket.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Rangan is shocked to see Thangam’s photo among his marriage proposals. Thangam’s growing discomfort around Rangan leads to accusations and outrage and everyone turns against him.

videos.title: Mistakes and Misfires
videos.overview: Shattered by Rukmani's mistrust, Rangan nearly quits cricket, but his aunt persuades him to return only to face cold stares. Rukmani later apologises for overreacting.

videos.title: Golden Jubilee Begins
videos.overview: As the event unfolds, excitement masks rising tensions. Mani lifts Thangam's spirits. Velu's bid to rejoin the team backfires, leading to a clash that Theo halts.

videos.title: Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: Thulasi's speech revives a painful past tied to Rangan. Shaken by the memories, Rangan retreats. Rukmani finds him and together they step forward to face Thulasi and the truth.

videos.title: Rangan’s Return
videos.overview: Rukmani firmly shuts Rajasekar down. A tense match sees Velu steady the students until Rangan joins and turns it around. The alumni win, but the academy begins to heal.

videos.title: Unspoken Wounds
videos.overview: As alumni celebrate Rangan's return, Thangam seethes in silence. Amid cricket talks with the management, Rangan mentions players now battle inner struggles more than the game.

videos.title: The Weight of the Past
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal Rangan's fall, a former Ranji captain silenced for opposing injustice. Thulasi introduces a new MNCA scheme. Rangan and Thulasi silently acknowledge their past.

videos.title: Lines of Trust
videos.overview: When allegations arise against Rangan, Thulasi ensures fairness. Thangam bravely reveals her fear came from family pressure, while Rangan maintains a calm demeanour in response.

videos.title: Open Challenge
videos.overview: Thangam defends Rangan, while others oppose him. Thulasi and Rukmani plan to save the academy. A cricket match brings peace until Girish and Matheyan ignite a rivalry.

videos.title: Cracks in Between
videos.overview: Unresolved tension leads to emotional fallout as Mani's jealousy erupts publicly. Meanwhile, Thulasi and Rangan find unexpected comfort in cricket, uncovering past truths.

videos.title: Inner Battle
videos.overview: Thangam tries to reconcile the differences between Rishi and the boys’ team, but they refuse to heed her words. Meanwhile, Rishi contemplates transferring to another school.

videos.title: Unstable Ground
videos.overview: Selvam's dismissal plunges the academy into chaos, with Natraj managing both teams. Meanwhile, Rukmani and Rangan uncover sexism and ego during the replacement search.

videos.title: Crossing the Boundary
videos.overview: What starts as a bold underground match quickly descends into open conflict, leading to chaos and violence. Rangan arrives just in time to prevent history from repeating itself.

videos.title: Anger Beneath Bruises
videos.overview: Girish fails to threaten Rangan. Rishi doubts himself as Girish provokes him. Rangan hides the injured boys from Ms. Rukmani. Jackie blames Rishi, but the juniors defend him.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: The girls hide the boy's wounds, but tension grows when Rukmani sees Rishi bruised. Rangan protects the team despite suspicion. Away from the academy, Rangan confides in Thulasi.

videos.title: Dreams, Doubts and a Blowback
videos.overview: A counselling session uncovers the dreams of the students as well as Rishi’s feelings. Motivated by Thulasi, Rangan offers support to the students and gains Rukmani’s trust.

videos.title: They Are My Team
videos.overview: Rangan defends his students against misleading police evidence. Theo’s video unveils the truth, yet the damage persists. Natraj storms out in anger, and Rukmini distrusts Rangan.

videos.title: Fault Lines
videos.overview: Rangan officially steps in as the coach, but Padma openly rejects him. Natraj’s harsh words humiliate Mani targeting his friendship with Theo. Mani discovers scars on Rishi’s hand.

videos.title: Pressure Points
videos.overview: Girish faces Rajasekar’s anger over fake evidence. Thulasi encourages Rangan. While Thangam thinks Mani is in love with Theo, Vinay confronts Rukmani over Rishi’s safety.

videos.title: Hidden Battles
videos.overview: Mani fakes illness to escape the academy ground. He learns about Rishi's hidden struggles and his reluctance toward an acting career imposed by his dad. A bond forms between them.

videos.title: Midnight Panic and Confessions
videos.overview: Thangam, Matheyan and others search desperately for Mani as he lies drunk on Rishi’s terrace. Next day, on the ground, Mani explodes, confessing his love for a stunned Thangam.

videos.title: Shifts and Challenges
videos.overview: Mani feels anxious remembering his argument with Thangam. Rishi faces his dad’s pressure to leave cricket. Rangam changes the batting order, facing the wrath of Padma.

videos.title: Voices Under Noise
videos.overview: Theo turns to Matheyan for advice with the girls’ team. At the nets, Rangan’s intense drills test focus and adaptability. Theo calmly guides Padma. Rishi confesses his fear.

videos.title: Silent Drift
videos.overview: Thangam worries about her growing feelings for Mani. Rangan seeks Rukmani’s approval for new players. Rishi confides in her about his dad’s plan. Theo and Matheyan share a moment.

videos.title: One Last Chance
videos.overview: Seeing Valli secretly practicing, Rangan recognises her natural reflexes and determination. Mani pleads with Vinay to give Rishi one chance. Thangam decides to stay away from Mani.

videos.title: Closed Gates
videos.overview: When Rukmani and the principal can't help Rangan to have Valli join the girls’ team, he contacts Thulasi. While Rishi pushes Mani to focus on cricket, the girls doubt Theo’s moves.

videos.title: Unsaid Feelings
videos.overview: Thulasi proposes a scheme to Rangan to legitimise Valli’s entry into the team. Rishi trains Mani. Theo and Matheyan sneak out to celebrate his birthday and confess their feelings.

videos.title: Surface Fractures
videos.overview: During a midnight ride, Theo and Matheyan nearly hit a drunken woman. Later, Rangan introduces Valli to the girls' team, which provokes resistance from most of the team members.

videos.title: Shifting Bonds
videos.overview: Padma suspects Valli manipulated her way onto the team, but Rangan supports her. Later, Rishi guides Mani through each ball in a practice match.

videos.title: Gossip and Revelations
videos.overview: Valli endures harsh mockery regarding her background, which also impacts her father. Although she contemplates quitting, Rangan refuses to allow her to give up.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: Natraj reveals the final lineup and surprises the boys with a celebratory meal. As unity grows, Matheyan confides in Theo about Natraj’s emotionally charged coaching style.

videos.title: Unsteady Minds
videos.overview: Thangam tells Rangan about Valli's poor practice. Theo and Mani have a disagreement from misunderstandings about their friendship, while Thangam remains unfocused during the match.

videos.title: Choices Left Unspoken
videos.overview: Thangam, confused by her emotions, explores love online and eventually opens up to Theo. Meanwhile, Mani decides the best way to cope with his intense feelings is to bury them.

videos.title: Terrace Party
videos.overview: Mani tells everyone he moved on from love to friendship with Thangam. He tricks everyone, including Varsha, into attending a party by falsely stating that it is Rishi's birthday.

videos.title: Viral Turn
videos.overview: The boys struggle in practice after the party and Nataraj punishes them. To showcase Valli's talent, Rangan records her and posts a social media clip that quickly gains attention.

videos.title: Rising Tensions
videos.overview: News of an NRI-funded fellowship by Dhoorai sparks rivalry in the academy. The girls tease Rangan about Thulasi, while Rukmani hints she knows about them, making Thulasi shy away.

videos.title: Night Unravels
videos.overview: Shaken after the practice match, Rishi battles anxiety triggered by Nataraj. Rangan's first visit to Thulasi's house turns tense during an unexpected talk with her grandfather.

videos.title: Unseen War
videos.overview: Rangan and Thulasi spend time together and she talks about her life with Rajeev. Natraj vows payback after a drunk Rishi attacks his house and hurts him.

videos.title: Silent Pressure
videos.overview: Rajasekar realises the flaw in his academy. While Natraj targets Rishi, Padma’s selfish gameplay creates cracks in the team. Mani meets Thangam’s parents and wins their trust.

videos.title: Sudden Arrival
videos.overview: Rishi is shaken by the harsh realities of class divide between students. Rangan’s bold call on field leaves Padma shaken. Matheyan panics when his mother arrives at the academy.

videos.title: Facing Nightmare
videos.overview: Seeing his drunk mother, Matheyan fears his nightmare may come true. While Theo becomes his anchor, Rangan confronts Natraj and declares that he will stand as Matheyan’s guardian

videos.title: Tournament Heat
videos.overview: At an event, Rangan's return is celebrated, but Natraj becomes increasingly insecure. Later, Matheyan feels shattered when Natraj publicly removes him as team captain.

videos.title: Beginning of the Battle
videos.overview: On the field, MNCA starts strong, but Natraj’s provocation hurts Matheyan. MNCA faces a crushing defeat. Rangan helps Matheyan confront his pain. Rukmani faces Rajasekar’s taunts

videos.title: Fear to Fire
videos.overview: Padma discourages the girls, but Theo shuts her down. MNCA's nerves show early. Despite doubts, Rangan shifts focus to strategy, backing his bowlers and trusting their instincts.

videos.title: Falling Apart
videos.overview: Velu ignores Matheyan’s suggestion. Rishi chooses to fight his battle. Rukmani confronts Natraj for benching Rishi, his poor decisions and rigid leadership that cost MNCA heavily.

videos.title: Narrow Loss
videos.overview: As pressure builds before a crucial game, the MNCA boys struggle while the girls deliver a win. Rukmani intervenes in Natraj's decisions, restoring team balance but angering him.

videos.title: Momentum Shift
videos.overview: Just when the boys think their journey is over, Rangan shows Matheyan a slim chance to qualify. Matheyan then reshapes the batting order, despite Natraj's resistance.

videos.title: Silent Sabotage
videos.overview: As the MNCA boys' hopes rest on Anchor's results, Girish plays a calculated game, benching his main players. Meanwhile, in the girls' camp, Padma returns with a change of heart.

videos.title: Against the Odds
videos.overview: Natraj loses his authority and vents his frustrations on the team. He humiliates Matheyan, leading Rukmani to dismiss him. Rangan steps in to assist them.

videos.title: Interrupted Moments
videos.overview: During a group photo, Theo spots Rangan and Thulasi holding hands. Rishi’s father is happy with his success. Rangan and Thulasi share a moment, but Rukmani’s call interrupts them.

videos.title: Rukmani's Treat
videos.overview: Rukmani takes the teams for a celebratory dinner. While Rishi flirts with Varsha, Theo exposes Rangan’s secret. As Thangam tries to confess to Mani, a message from Anu stuns all.

videos.title: Rumours and Rivalries
videos.overview: With no coach for the boys' team, debates over Natraj and Rangan spark clashes. Meanwhile, Thangam grows jealous of Mani's date, with Rishi and Theo secretly stirring trouble.

videos.title: Shift in Bonds
videos.overview: Rumours swirl about Rangan and Thulasi, leaving them unsettled. Mani's approaching date fuels Thangam's restlessness, pushing her to finally confess her love.

videos.title: Awkward Beginnings
videos.overview: The boys learn of Thangam's confession to Mani and spread it across the academy. Mani struggles to cope with the news. Meanwhile, Rangan and Thulasi hesitate to text each other.

videos.title: Date Plan
videos.overview: Matheyan devises a plan to ease Mani's and Thangam's awkwardness. Meanwhile, on the field, Padma's growing isolation leads to emotional outbursts.

videos.title: Unsteady Hearts
videos.overview: Padma’s sudden move to Anchor shocks the MNCA team, and they feel betrayed. Rangan’s reunion with Dharani helps him release past guilt. Thulasi worries about Rajeev’s threats.

videos.title: Triple Date
videos.overview: The triple date begins with excitement for Rishi, Varsha, Mani, Thangam, Theo, and Matheyan. Each relationship finds its rhythm, turning unspoken emotions into something real.

videos.title: Love and Leverage
videos.overview: Rangan helps Matheyan to strengthen their bond. While Padma faces isolation and backlash in her new environment, a viral post turns Thulasi and Rangan’s lives into controversy.

videos.title: Silent Battles
videos.overview: Rishi asks Matheyan support Rangan through the ongoing controversy. Thulasi faces pressure from the media and her party. Padma begins to feel the emotional cost of her decision.

videos.title: Cracks Beneath the Calm
videos.overview: Rishi accepts calmly when Varsha decides to leave the academy. Rangan and Rukmani realise Rajasekar is behind the rumours. While Thulasi faces pressure, Girish targets Matheyan.

videos.title: Lines Crossed
videos.overview: Rajiv’s video as Thulasi’s supportive husband gains sympathy. Matheyan confronts Girish for targeting his mother, while Rangan faces Rajasekhar and declares his stand for Thulasi.

videos.title: New Year Break
videos.overview: Matheyan struggles with his feelings about his mother. Rukmani calmly manages tensions, advising Rangan. She announces a New Year break to help everyone regain clarity and reset.

videos.title: Holiday Begins
videos.overview: Love finds room to grow for Mani and Thangam during the break. Theo brings a nervous Matheyan to her home and introduces him to her parents.

videos.title: Love Under Pressure
videos.overview: Thangam lies to her mother and leaves for Mani's house. At Theo's house, Matheyan faces parental inquisition about his parents, making him uncomfortable and Theo furious.

videos.title: Between Holding and Losing
videos.overview: Matheyan's deep fear of rejection surfaces during a tense exchange with Theo, making her confront her parents. Thangam's mother realises she is hiding something and warns her.

videos.title: Strength and Silence
videos.overview: Despite Mani's concern and meddling, Matheyan and Theo struggle with their circumstances. Rangan introduces new training methods to the boys' team.

videos.title: The Counter Move
videos.overview: Baskar comes prepared with his complaints, but Thulasi is way ahead when she presents video proof. However, Rajasekar has another plan up his sleeve, thanks to Girish.

videos.title: Where Hearts Drift
videos.overview: Rangan anticipates Rajasekhar's move and has a plan prepared. Triggered by the Anchor boys, a casual game at the local ground turns unpleasant as pride curdles into insecurity.

videos.title: The Distance Between Us
videos.overview: A light-hearted moment spirals when Jackie takes offence to a casual remark. Rangan attempts to restore unity, but miscommunication and bruised egos continue to widen the rift.

videos.title: When Control Slips
videos.overview: Tensions explode as Matheyan hits Jackie in front of everyone, leaving both teams shaken. Matheyan later feels guilty, while Jackie is torn between anger and humiliation.

videos.title: Cracks Deepen
videos.overview: Burdened by team issues, Rangan finds clarity from Thulasi. He helps Matheyan face his family struggles and problems with Jackie, urging resolution over avoidance.

videos.title: What Still Matters
videos.overview: Thulasi and Rangan enjoy playful moments together in Chennai. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the boys at the academy despite the girls' efforts to help.

videos.title: Rangan's Challenge
videos.overview: Matheyan visits his mother at a bar, and she promises to quit drinking. At the academy, the seniors accuse Rangan of favouritism, and his challenge leaves him in shock.

videos.title: Healing and Breaking
videos.overview: Rangan reveals that the girls versus boys match is a strategy to push unity among boys. While Mani isolates himself, ignoring Thangam, Matheyan prepares his mother for rehab.

videos.title: Emotion vs Ego
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam try to outperform each other during practice. Hurt turns into determination when the girls realise the boys are looking down on them.

videos.title: Mind Over Momentum
videos.overview: The girls begin intense training to secure a victory over the boys. Meanwhile, the boys' team faces challenges due to changes and instability within the team.

videos.title: Deal with Divide
videos.overview: Amid the challenges faced by the boys' team and their ongoing conflict with the girls' team, Mani receives an offer from Velu. Will this proposal disrupt or resolve the conflict?

videos.title: The Cost of Pride
videos.overview: As the girls thrive on unity and leadership, the boys struggle to find common ground. Will teamwork triumph, or will the boys rise above their differences?

videos.title: Last Ball, Last Chance
videos.overview: The girls win against the odds, while the boys face the consequences of their mistakes. Mani and Thangam reconcile, but Thangam's possessiveness sparks tension with Anu.

videos.title: When Everything Falls Apart
videos.overview: Matheyan and Jackie put their differences aside and reunite, surprising everyone. Meanwhile, Anu's world is turned upside down by a sudden expulsion from Anchor Academy.

videos.title: Dreams or Duty?
videos.overview: Anu starts a new chapter at MNCA as Theo feels jealous about her arrival. Rishi makes the difficult decision to quit cricket to support his father through a financial crisis.

videos.title: Between Missing and Moving On
videos.overview: The academy struggles to move on after Rishi's departure. When exam dates are announced, cricket takes a backseat. Meanwhile, Thulasi heads into a crucial divorce hearing.

videos.title: When Silence Hurts
videos.overview: Exam pressure replaces cricket. The juniors desperately search for study notes and help. Thulasi's divorce hearing takes a major setback when Rajeev refuses a mutual separation.

videos.title: Preparation and Crisis
videos.overview: Velu orders the seniors to not help the juniors, but two of them ignore him. Rangan receives a golden opportunity, but the situation gets worse for his beloved MNCA and Rukmani.

videos.title: MNCA Under Threat
videos.overview: As Rangan hunts for sponsors, the MNCA crisis snowballs, leading to a meeting with the trustees. Anu and Jackie bond over physics, creating tension between Mani and Thangam.

videos.title: Renewed Hope
videos.overview: The exams finally arrive. Thangam receives good news, which becomes a welcome respite for the academy. Rukmani begins accepting MNCA's possible end, but Rangan stays hopeful.

videos.title: Costly Clash
videos.overview: Theo's parents visit her at the academy, but she misunderstands their intentions. While Rangan gives a tour to a potential investor, an unwelcome sight greets them.

videos.title: Love in Fragments
videos.overview: Matheyan rejoices as his mother slowly returns to her old self. At the advertisement shoot, Thangam and Girish grow closer, stirring jealousy in Mani.

videos.title: Weight of Staying
videos.overview: Anu steals the spotlight in a practice match, leaving Thangam jealous, especially as Mani cheers for her. Elsewhere, Rangan is shaken upon learning about the attack on Thulasi.

videos.title: Under Evaluation
videos.overview: Rangan spends a restless night, troubled by the unachievable condition he imposed on the Chennai club. Later, Matheyan is deeply unsettled by his mother's unexpected health scare.

videos.title: Before Impact
videos.overview: Rukmani shocks Rangan by deciding to sell MNCA's assets. Meanwhile, competition drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu, while Anu and Thangam clash openly on the field.

videos.title: Hearts Start to Align
videos.overview: As tensions build across the academy, personal bonds start affecting the game. Rangan reveals the funding deal with Chennai Club to Rukmani and later shares it with Thulasi.

videos.title: Shifting Equations
videos.overview: Thangam confronts Mani over his lies, straining their relationship. Kalyani collapses during practice and shocks Rangan by revealing that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Choice Within
videos.overview: As Kalyani faces an unexpected pregnancy and a life-changing choice, Rangan helps her find her answer. Meanwhile, growing selection pressure drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu.

videos.title: Shift in Play
videos.overview: Kalyani's absence leaves the girls' team struggling. Mani's growing insecurity over Girish drives a wedge between him and Thangam, hurting both their relationship and their game.

videos.title: Words That Hurt
videos.overview: As Kalyani's departure weighs heavily on Rangan, he lashes out at Thulasi. Her emotional distress quickly becomes the subject of discussion at her workplace.

videos.title: Practice, Pressure, Promises
videos.overview: Worried the academy is nearing its end, Matheyan plans a surprise proposal for Theo with Mani and Thangam's help. But Matheyan's bike crashes, leaving her with a knee injury.

videos.title: Parallel Hearts
videos.overview: After Matheyan's proposal, he and Theo revel in their new relationship, while Mani and Thangam fight. The academy travels to Chennai for its most significant challenge yet.

videos.title: One Team, Many Battles
videos.overview: Rangan mocks the team's low spirits, but Theo stands by them and tries to light up the mood. A stop at a Dhaba turns chaotic as a clash with Anchor Academy erupts into a fight.

videos.title: Her Birthday, His Forever
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam decide not to speak until the tournament ends. Rangan's birthday proposal plans for Thulasi take an unexpected turn after Rajeev humiliates them.

videos.title: Beyond the Game
videos.overview: Jackie uncovers MNCA's financial crisis and Rangan's secret sacrifice for the academy. Meanwhile, disaster strikes as Theo suffers a serious knee injury, ruling her out for weeks.

videos.title: Out of Sync
videos.overview: Anu's surprise captaincy takes a tense turn when a crucial call involving Thangam sparks misunderstandings between the two. Later, Rajasekhar's taunts rile up Rangan and Rukmani.

videos.title: Double Pressure
videos.overview: A sudden schedule shake-up catches the MNCA girl's off guard. Clashing egos and crumbling teamwork push the boys to the edge against Madurai Hawks.

videos.title: What Makes a Team
videos.overview: MNCA's internal conflict costs them another match, revealing Rangan's fierce side. Matheyan's and Rangan's guidance encourages the team to confront their egos and insecurities.

videos.title: Us vs Them
videos.overview: Rangan motivates the teams. With the chase collapsing, Matheyan delivers a breathtaking win and takes MNCA into the quarterfinals. Amid celebrations, Jackie gets devastating news.

videos.title: The Quarter-Final Storm
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam's relationship reaches a painful breaking point. The girls fight through a tense quarterfinal. On the boys' side, Mani's early exit intensifies the pressure.

videos.title: When Life Demands More
videos.overview: Theo receives clearance to rejoin the girls' team as captain. Disaster strikes when Jackie learns Matheyan's mother is in critical condition, forcing Matheyan to rush home.

videos.title: Unsaid Goodbyes
videos.overview: Just before the finals, Matheyan faces the darkest moment of his life. Although Rangan stands by him through this tough time, panic spreads when Matheyan suddenly goes missing.

videos.title: A Legacy Reborn
videos.overview: Despite Matheyan's disappearance, Rangan pushes the team forward, reminding them what's at stake. Meanwhile, Matheyan fulfils his late mother's last wish on her birthday.

videos.title: Avargal
videos.overview: A proof-of-life photo from a local kidnapping features their newspaper, pulling the gang into the case. Covertly helping the police to crack it- in the process, they accidentally land their first big headline.

videos.title: Indru Poi Naalai Vaa
videos.overview: A payment blunder bruises the ego of a local boxer, prompting a one-on-one challenge. Just as the gang scrambles for a champion amongst themselves, the kidnapper from previous episode returns, setting the stage for a chaotic showdown as multiple gangs converge on their office, all focused to destroy them.

videos.title: Aan Paavam
videos.overview: A 40-year-old woman shocks the gang by requesting an ad in their newspaper putting herself up for adoption after being abandoned by her children. A new interested party pressures them to sell their newspaper, sparking a rift between Veera and Azhagu.

videos.title: Iruvar
videos.overview: After an intense fight, Azhagu quits Namma Seidhi, leaving the gang in shock. While dealing with the fallout, a vlogger drags the newspaper into an expose, accusing it of promoting low-quality restaurants and calling it a scam. Will Veera and Azhagu bury the hatchet to save the paper, or is this the end of Namma Seidhi?

videos.title: Nizhal Nijamaagiradhu
videos.overview: An anonymous source approaches the gang with news before it happens. Initially wary, they decide to publish his stories, and after missing the first-which proves true-the second one boosts their PR. As trust in the source grows, could this partnership save their sinking newspaper, or his good deeds too good to be true?

videos.title: Naalaya Seidhi
videos.overview: After a major story from the new source backfires, nearly driving away all their advertisers, the gang discovers the identity of the puppet master behind the chaos. He has a clear agenda: to buy Namma Seidhi as cheaply as possible by playing as dirty as possible.

videos.title: Makkal Aatchi
videos.overview: The gang makes the biggest blunder in the history of Newsprint -printing empty pages that reach the community. But a stroke of luck turns the mistake into a symbol of protest. Will they survive the fallout, or is this truly the end of Namma Seidhi?

videos.title: The First Case
videos.overview: Adhiyaman, a police officer on the waitlist for VRS, investigates a case of theft. Later, when a different village reports a similar incident, SI Adhiyaman observes a startling pattern.

videos.title: The Border
videos.overview: Unable to find leads in the investigation, Adhiyaman meets the victims of the theft case. Just as he is about to update the inspector about the case, he finds a clue about the culprit’s whereabouts.

videos.title: Truth Meets Devil
videos.overview: Adhiyaman and his team reach Andhra Pradesh and are shocked to discover a series of murders that follow the same pattern. As they visit the murder locations, more shocking twists await them.

videos.title: The Warning
videos.overview: The officers receive news about another murder while investigating in Andhra Pradesh. While the team splits up to follow different leads and includes villagers in the search, another life is lost.

videos.title: Find The Devil
videos.overview: Statements from the survivors confirm Adhiyaman’s theory about the culprit. Meanwhile, the police finds crucial evidence in the last crime scene that helps in their search across the states.

videos.title: The Conclusion
videos.overview: The evidence leads them to the criminal's last location. As they find more clues of multiple offenders, the police devise a plan to separate the culprits and arrest them. Will Adhiyaman’s plan succeed?

videos.title: Love vs Logic
videos.overview: Sofia is a brilliant scientist who doesn’t believe in the concept of love. She creates a device called the Love Meter to measure true love. Her path crosses with Sid, a charming comic writer.

videos.title: The Challenge Begins
videos.overview: When Sofia’s device causes his close ones to break up, Sid vows revenge. He decides to prove the invention wrong by making Sofia fall in love with him.

videos.title: The 12-Hour Rule
videos.overview: Sofia and Sid end up on a forced date, but the night takes an unexpected turn. When an emotional Sofia returns home, her device shocks her further by revealing that she is falling for Sid.

videos.title: Signals and Silence
videos.overview: Sid manages to win Sofia’s heart with persistence and small gestures. Sofia finds herself missing him on the day that Sid fails to show up.

videos.title: Zero Love
videos.overview: When Sofia accepts her feelings for Sid, the device shocks her with a reading of zero. A heartbroken Sid leaves, and Sofia questions her beliefs about science and love.

videos.title: Love Beyond Logic
videos.overview: Sofia learns a life lesson about true love that needs no proof or measurement. All she has to do now is choose Sid over her beliefs. Will she choose love or logic?

Episode 1
videos.overview: Kavya goes viral after a media interview turns personal. Meanwhile, a popular game from Moon Bolt begins to have real-world repercussions.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While Inspector Bhanumathi steps in to investigate Kavya's case, Dani uncovers a dark web trolling group with a disturbing — and familiar — target.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While Kavya deals with an act of revenge at work, Tara befriends a stranger online. Anoop reminds Kavya of an important upcoming event.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Anoop grapples with betrayal when an incriminating video makes the rounds. Meanwhile, the detectives zero in on a new suspect.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: An attack on another female influencer puts Roshan in the hot seat with investors. Tara's grandmother receives an alert about unusual bank activity.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kavya comes up with a new video game idea. Meanwhile, the detectives uncover a new lead from a suspect's device. Tara is in trouble.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Suspicions mount around a trusted figure. Kavya joins the Moon Bolt team on a beach getaway — but will it end in tragedy?

videos.title: New Arrival
videos.overview: Villagers protest at the Tahsildar Office for a 'just' cause. While the office staff prepares to welcome the Collector, a person arrives in a government-issued beacon car.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Paari gets baffled over the VIP treatment given by the government staff. Just when he realises the misunderstanding and is about to resolve it, he sees Indu, an old acquaintance.

videos.title: Burst Bubble
videos.overview: Paari's ruse gets exposed when Raghavan arrives. As the government staff lashes out at the IT team, the villagers' protest intensifies.

videos.title: Another Argument
videos.overview: Paari learns about the government staffers from his colleagues. Napoleon refuses to give the IT team access to confidential files. Paari and Indu get into another argument.

videos.title: Village Trouble
videos.overview: Napoleon assigns a menial job to the IT team. Indu is reminded of their first meeting when Paari gets a fish tank in the office. Murthy and Prakash struggle to deal with the villagers.

videos.title: House Hunting
videos.overview: Sani offers to help Paari find a house in the village, but the villagers refuse to rent out their place to him. Sharmi's food vlog ends up in a funny misunderstanding.

videos.title: Sleep Ritual
videos.overview: Indu loses her cool with her mom. Napoleon berates Paari for disturbing his sleep ritual. Raghavan asks Napoleon to let the IT team start their work. Paari finally finds a roommate.

videos.title: Father's Fury
videos.overview: Paari's disinterest in attending the UPSC interview makes his father furious. Sharmi's vlog in the office goes viral for the wrong reasons.

videos.title: Interview Call
videos.overview: Indu gets excited as she gets an interview call, but Paari mocks her. Mani feels overwhelmed when Raghavan signs a blank cheque to help Janu. The IT team complains about Napoleon.

videos.title: A New Enemy
videos.overview: Indu gets furious when she finds her missing book in Paari's bag. While Napoleon creates a ruckus about the files in the record room, Paari catches Hari taking a bribe.

videos.title: The Missing Wig
videos.overview: Paari gets berated by Raghavan when Hari frames him. Raghavan panics as his wig goes missing. Indu assumes Paari hid the wig.

videos.title: Matchmaking
videos.overview: Jambulingam fails to recognise Raghavan without his hair. Indu panics when she receives a call from home. Paari gets upset when he learns about a marriage proposal for Indu.

videos.title: Unwanted Guest
videos.overview: Paari joins Raghavan and Hari to inspect government lands in the village. An old lady arrives in the office to ask about her pension. She slips, falls and doesn't wake up.

videos.title: Hit and Miss
videos.overview: Paari suspects Hari's involvement in the encroached lands, but a mishap with Raghavan stops the inspection. The old lady's daughter-in-law comes to the office searching for her.

videos.title: Action, Reaction
videos.overview: Paari and Sani beat up Hari for misbehaving with Sharmi. Paari helps Indu's mother when she faints in the market. An error in a slogan creates chaos.

videos.title: The Start of Love
videos.overview: Indu gets irritated when her mother praises Paari. A sarcastic retort by Paari causes a misunderstanding among the villagers.

videos.title: Escalation
videos.overview: Paari's friends make fun of his weird behaviour towards Indu. Frustrated by the lack of work, Sharmi decides to resign, angering Paari who confronts Napoleon.

videos.title: Party Planning
videos.overview: Paari complains to his brother-in-law about not getting access to files. Prakash and Moorthy lie to convince Indu to attend Sharmi's farewell party and choose a frightening venue.

videos.title: Haunted Party
videos.overview: Indu gets irked to see Paari at the party, but the others convince her to stay. The guys keep sneaking away to drink secretly. What happens when Paari plays a prank on Indu?

videos.title: Resolution
videos.overview: The locals complain to Napoleon about the staff's partying on a disputed land. Raghavan gets an earful from the Collector for the IT team's stalled digitalisation work.

videos.title: Lease, Lies and Lost Goats
videos.overview: The news of lease expiration and relocation creates an uproar in the office. Prakash falls for a village girl who has lost her goat. Hari plots to stop digitisation.

videos.title: A Missing Goat and Hidden Truths
videos.overview: As Veni searches for her missing goat, tension brews in the office over a potential scam. While Napolean grows paranoid about a conspiracy, will the team uncover the truth in time?

videos.title: Truths Unravel and New Dilemmas
videos.overview: Paari and Murthy suspect a scam, but Napolean shuts them down. Indu's accident leads to an unexpected moment with Paari. Jambulingam faces trouble over missing land documents.

videos.title: Buried Truths and Broken Ties
videos.overview: Indu worries about her family pressuring her to marry. As Paari's missing file causes chaos at work, his past with Indu resurfaces, exposing old wounds.

videos.title: Who Took It?
videos.overview: When a vital file goes missing, Indu uncovers a shocking truth. Frantic to cover his tracks, Hari appoints a former thief for a secret mission.

videos.title: Echoes of Theft
videos.overview: While Indu faces pressure to marry, Jambulingam tries to hide his land troubles. Chaos erupts when computers and a gun go missing.

videos.title: A Risky Retrieval
videos.overview: With jobs at stake, the team plots to retrieve the gun and computers. Indu sneaks out in th dead of the night, unaware of the incoming danger.

videos.title: The Uninvited Guests
videos.overview: The IT team sneaks into the bungalow, tunknowingly crossing paths with two groups of thieves. Indu feels uncomfortable when Sathyan arrives in the office the next morning.

videos.title: Bro Code Broken
videos.overview: While Indu tries to evade her marriage, a drunk Paari visits her at night. Prakash informs Sathyan about Paari and Indu's friendship. What happens when Sathyan seeks Paari's help?

videos.title: Staged and Confused
videos.overview: Paari plays mind games with Sathyan, making Indu angry. With a fake proposal, a scam and the entry of a fierce lady cop, chaos brews around the office.

videos.title: Wrong Switch
videos.overview: Indu battles entitled relatives who misuse government schemes. Paari grapples with corruption, moral dilemmas and a humbling lesson about who truly merits help.

videos.title: Shortcut Denied
videos.overview: When Indu learns that her dream job was offered to her through backdoor dealings, she erupts, setting off a domino of confrontations.

videos.title: Between the Lines
videos.overview: A kabaddi mishap sparks an unexpected bond. While Sani's bold action angers Sharmi Prakash's weird antics rattle the office. The announcement of Indu's engagement shocks everyone.

videos.title: The Stamp of Truth
videos.overview: Veni's intimidating brother scares Prakash. While indu suffers silently, Sathyan gets a surprise from a drunken Paari. Sani's distress deepens after Sharmi rebukes him.

videos.title: The Moment of Truth
videos.overview: Paari challenges Indu's engagement, and tensions rise between heart and tradition. When Indu finally looks her uncle in the eye, silence speaks louder than words.

videos.title: Unravelled
videos.overview: Indu uncle's decision about the engagement shocks the family. Caught between gratitude and guilt, Indu gets advice from Raghavan. What is his motive?

videos.title: The Lone Stand
videos.overview: As Hari tightens his web of influence, Paari dares to defy him. Indu's quiet gestures hint at a change of heart, and Janaki's misunderstanding leads to embarrassment.

videos.title: Brake Point
videos.overview: As Paari stages a clever prank to win Indu's smile on her birthday, a hidden enemy plots a deadly move with the brakes. Emotions stir between old flames and failed engagements.

videos.title: Sympathy Syndrome
videos.overview: After surviving an accident, Paari fakes an injury to win Indu's affection. Meanwhile, a serious government audit looms over the team.

videos.title: A Clean Sweep
videos.overview: A surprise inspection throws the entire office into a tizzy. As the IT team comes under the microscope, Paari begins to suspect a deeper conspiracy.

videos.title: Trial and Error
videos.overview: Fired and desperate, the IT team pulls off an office heist, a fake divine sign, and a temple possession stunt to win back their jobs. What happens when their "miracle" goes awry?

videos.title: Served Cold
videos.overview: Raghavan's fury leaves the IT team in despair. Indu's plea to her famous uncle, Jeyaraj, sparks a tense meeting. While the team's fate is unknown, Indu and Paari have a fallout.

videos.title: Unspoken Farewells
videos.overview: As the team prepares to leave the village, Prakash, Sani and Paari try to tie up loose ends. But the weight of unspoken words and broken bonds leave them far from closure.

videos.title: The Spark Before the Storm
videos.overview: A goldfish leads Paari back to the office, where a shocking discovery exposes deep-rooted corruption. He tries to gather proof, but a desperate act threatens to erase everything.

videos.title: Burning Secrets
videos.overview: Raghavan files a police complaint against Paari for the fire at the office, and Napolean escalates it to the Collector's office. Will Paari become a victim of a deeper conspiracy?

videos.title: Unexpected Returns
videos.overview: Guru's intervention saves Paari, but Hari conspires with Jeyaraj. Jaanu's unexpected return scares the office staff. Can they get rid of Jaanu before she uncovers their secret?

videos.title: The New IT Team
videos.overview: When Sathyan arrives with a replacement IT team, arch-rivals Napolean and Paari are forced to team up - one to protect the office secret and the other to win back Indu's heart.

videos.title: A Missed Confession
videos.overview: After Paari is humiliated, the old IT team reunites to drive Sathyan out. As Indu decides to confess her love for Paari, he discovers a crucial lead about Hari's mysterious boss.

videos.title: The Assistant Officers!
videos.overview: Jeyaraj warns Paari to stay low, raising doubts. As playful office antics spiral into petty revenge and hidden agendas, a photo threatens to unveil secrets better left buried.

videos.title: Petty Revenge
videos.overview: As Jeyaraj balances belief and doubt, Indu fights for Paari’s attention. Raghavan helps Janaki from societal injustice. The office staff panics when Prakash goes missing.

videos.title: A Forced Marriage
videos.overview: When Veni's brother compels Prakash to marry her, Murthy disowns him. With the newlyweds feeling lost and the office in chaos, can Indu and Paari manage to change Murthy's mind?

videos.title: Just Friends?
videos.overview: Old feelings unfold, and new misconceptions take root as Paari’s mother visits his office. When Jeyaraj learns her truth, Indu is forced to choose between her heart and loyalty.

videos.title: Split Screens
videos.overview: Indu draws a line with Paari after his pranks go too far. While Raghavan is impressed by Jaanu's charm, Prakash and Veni take over Murthy's home and wallet.

videos.title: Misguided Missions
videos.overview: Jaanu likes Raghavan's new wig. Paari and Indu's road trip planned through deception, spirals into a public humiliation that shakes their fragile relationship.

videos.title: Blessings and Blunders
videos.overview: Paari draws a line with Indu after a rift. Veni's food cart brings hope and trouble. Raghavan takes Jaanu to the temple, but fate strips him of more than just his inhibitions.

videos.title: Things We Hide
videos.overview: Raghavan's wig mishap shatters him until Jaanu confides her problem to him. Paari retrieves Indu's stolen handbag, but his hopes are crushed when she asks for the unthinkable.

videos.title: Moves and Motives
videos.overview: Paari pretends to move on from Indu, while Raghavan sheds his inhibitions for love. Jeyaraj cautiously returns to the game just as a high-profile inspection looms over the office.

videos.title: Rejections and Recreations
videos.overview: Indu and Paari are teamed up as the office races to recreate the missing Patta documents before the Collector’s visit. Raghavan gets humiliated by Jaanu's judgemental parents.

videos.title: Signed and Sealed
videos.overview: Before the Collector's visit, an oversight by Indu threatens to expose their forgery operation. Paari takes a risky step, but his affinity with Indu goes through an emotional hit.

videos.title: Warmed Hearts, Cold Truths
videos.overview: Paari struggles to comprehend the deep reverence Indu holds for her uncle, Jeyaraj. His accidental discovery of a forged file threatens to expose a powerful man’s secrets.

videos.title: Operation Impress
videos.overview: Paari tries to impress Jeyaraj with food and books. Raghavan's mother meets Jaanu at the office. A public health project forces Paari and Jeyaraj into an unexpected alliance.

videos.title: Ground Realities
videos.overview: Jeyaraj's resistance threatens to ruin Paari and Indu's efforts with a health scheme. While Murthy is hurt when Napolean ignores a personal crisis, a property file sparks suspicion.

videos.title: The Cost of Truth
videos.overview: Paari unknowingly triggers a storm, unraveling Jeyaraj's carefully staged negotiation. A sickle-wielding saviour gets a desperate Murthy his leave.

videos.title: Framed!
videos.overview: Paari's bold revelation earns Jeyaraj respect from the villagers. A shocking twist exposing a hidden betrayal threatens to destroy everything Paari believes in.

videos.title: Truth or Trap
videos.overview: Paari uncovers shocking evidence pointing to Raghavan's corruption. While Jeyaraj plots to frame Raghavan, Paari is caught between exposing the truth and earning Jeyaraj's trust.

videos.title: Inside Job
videos.overview: While Paari works on a fake design at Jeyaraj's house, Sani tries to sneak out a file at the office. Paari suspects foul play when Dhamodharan secures a key government tender.

videos.title: Decorations and Doubts
videos.overview: The office celebrates Raghavan and Jaanu's surprise engagement announcement. Paari's secret probe uncovers proof of Raghavan's corruption, but a saint's warning could alter things.

videos.title: Tough Choice
videos.overview: As Raghavan gets engaged, Paari, struggling between love and justice, decides against exposing the truth for Indu's sake. But a dramatic showdown leaves the village in shock.

videos.title: Faith on Trial
videos.overview: Raghavan faces an inquiry over bribery charges. While evidence mounts, Paari is dazed by the unwavering faith of Raghavan’s mother and the speechless dignity of the accused himself.

videos.title: False Light
videos.overview: Tensed for having ruined an innocent man, Paari digs for the truth - only to find that he has been a pawn in a deeper game. His confession leaves Indu shattered and Raghavan enraged.

videos.title: Cracks and Clues
videos.overview: Indu wrestles with her heartbreak and distrust. As Napolean tightens his grip on the IT team, Paari takes the risk to get closer to exposing a deeper conspiracy.

videos.title: Blind Spots
videos.overview: As Raghavan drowns in betrayal and self-doubt, Paari tries to make him see the reality. A court notice arrives that could seal Raghavan’s fate unless the real mastermind is exposed.

videos.title: The Great Pretender
videos.overview: Paari convinces Raghavan to fake corruption in a frantic bid to access Dhamodharan's testimony and reclaim justice. Jaanu too plays her part as Raghavan stages his downfall.

videos.title: Confessions and Consequences
videos.overview: Paari and Indu's secret romance is finally out. A carefully orchestrated sting operation backfires when Hari flips the script, turning Raghavan's trap into his own public undoing.

videos.title: Echoes of a Prophecy
videos.overview: As Hari vanishes with the incriminating evidence, Paari, Indu and Raghavan are shaken as careers, trust and love are all on the line. Jaanu risks everything to defend Raghavan.

videos.title: Destiny's Detour
videos.overview: During Raghavan's inquiry, shocking revelations and personal ties surface at the Collector's office as an unexpected ally from his past rises to his defence. Will justice find its way?

videos.title: The Return and The Reckoning
videos.overview: Raghavan reclaims his position as the Tahsildar, shaking up the corrupt office. As tension rises, Hari goes missing. When things seem to calm, a knock at the door alters everything.

videos.title: The Hidden Guest
videos.overview: Indu and Paari's affinity finally comes to light, and it is celebration time. With secrets tightening around Jeyaraj, one error could unravel everything he is plotting to protect.

videos.title: Festive Fallout
videos.overview: As love and joy bloom with Indu's surprise morning lesson and Veni's festive Thaali ceremony, a hidden power move imperils the village's peace. Raghavan brings devastating news.

videos.title: Deadline Drama
videos.overview: News breaks that the office will shut down, and Paari plans to rally the villagers and impress the visiting Collector. However, an unexpected twist threatens to unravel everything.

videos.title: One Month to Go
videos.overview: In the last month of the office, Raghavan encourages each staffer to rise beyond their comfort zone. Indu faces resistance in office as she readies for a life-changing interview.

videos.title: The Shortcut and the Long Road
videos.overview: Paari races against time to sneak Indu into a surprise interview under Napoleon's watchful eyes. While Indu nails her shot, Paari faces a bitter truth about confronting his family.

videos.title: Civil Lies
videos.overview: Indu and Paari face Chezhiyan’s huge pride in government service. Prakash’s relentless study stuns Veni and his friends. An unexpected encounter at the bus stand sparks a new tension.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: Paari outwits Hari with a trap and closes in on the truth. A frantic call leads to shocking revelations. As loyalty is tested, a name is finally to be exposed, changing equations.

videos.title: The First Invitation
videos.overview: As police arrives at Jeyaraj’s door, secrets are unraveled. Indu faces the burden of hiding her career change from the one man who idolises her government status - Paari’s father.

videos.title: Cover-Up
videos.overview: Indu’s family tries to hide her IT aspirations from Chezhiyan. However, a confession and a kitchen eavesdrop unravel it all, leaving the future of the wedding hanging in balance.

videos.title: Between Pride and Apology
videos.overview: Indu’s hidden career choice shocks everyone. When Chezhiyan pays a surprise visit, apologies are made, and lessons are learnt. But unresolved tensions linger between him and Paari.

videos.title: Shadows at the Altar
videos.overview: At Raghavan’s wedding, tension arises as Paari and Chezhiyan’s strained father-son relationship plays out amid festivities. Unexpected guests threaten to disrupt the celebration.

videos.title: The Price of Blood
videos.overview: An accident at the venue throws everyone's lives into turmoil. Jeyaraj is forced to confront his past mistakes. Paari risks everything to save the person he once failed to protect.

videos.title: Hope Served Hot
videos.overview: Indu and Paari's attempts to lift a heartbroken Muthu’s spirits backfire hilariously. An unexpected confession from the ever-shy Chetta reveals a love that’s been simmering quietly.

videos.title: Silence of the Scold
videos.overview: Indu finally stands up to Napolean’s harshness. The team uncovers the silent sacrifices of the man they thought was their tormentor and give him the farewell he truly deserves.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: A cheerful bachelor party at Jeyaraj’s farmhouse turns into a night of confessions and revelations. Paari stumbles upon a letter from his past, one that could change equations.

videos.title: A Friend in the Frame
videos.overview: Paari’s suspicions about Jeyaraj deepen after seeing a photo in Kumaresan’s home, triggering an investigation. Indu begins to connect the dots, uncovering secrets too risky to chase.

videos.title: Exit Protocol
videos.overview: As the digitisation project ends, heartfelt goodbyes, bold decisions, and budding romances fill the air. Paari is set to leave, but a startling revelation about Jeyaraj stops him.

videos.title: Locked Truth
videos.overview: Sangu seeks forgiveness from Prakash. Paari cleverly manipulates a family visit to infiltrate Jeyaraj’s guarded office and uncovers a game-changing secret, right under his nose.

videos.title: Fallen Mask
videos.overview: As Paari digs deeper into the land scam, powerful forces begin to close in. With secrets unraveling and loyalties tested, a tense encounter forces everyone to show their true faces.

videos.title: Burned Bridges
videos.overview: Paari must choose between exposing a vicious land scam or let a guilty Jeyaraj atone privately by sacrificing everything. Indu grapples between justice and protecting her family.

videos.title: Curtain Call
videos.overview: On the last day, the staff faces a moral dilemma when Jambulingam, the person behind the closure, asks for help before the doors shut for good. Will they choose duty over resentment?

videos.title: Judas Kiss
videos.overview: Paari confronts betrayal from someone closest to him. He learns the full extent of a land scam and faces a heartbreaking confession that challenges his trust and shakes his future.

videos.title: Red Wedding
videos.overview: A deeply personal revelation shakes Indu and Paari’s world, testing their trust and forcing them to face difficult choices that will change their lives forever.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Tarunika's life is ruined when a sex tape of her husband is leaked at their 16th- anniversary party. With Gunaseelan in jail and two kids to look after, she returns to practice law.

videos.title: Her Honour
videos.overview: Working on a drug case, Tarunika unveils a murder and a political cover-up within a school. With her reputation at stake, how will she prove the innocence of a friend's son?

videos.title: The Taste of Victory
videos.overview: Tarunika learns that a banned fertility clinic is back in business. Suganya takes the kids to visit Guna in jail. Guna finds Tarunika drifting apart and suspects Hari Deepak for it.

videos.title: Tainted
videos.overview: The escort from Guna's case goes public with vile claims. Tarunika clashes against Vel Pandiyan in court.

videos.title: Old Flame
videos.overview: A critical foetus surgery case takes Tarunika and Hari to Coimbatore, reigniting old sparks. At  home on bail, Guna tries to reclaim his love.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: ALH takes up Guna's case after his lawyer backs out. With Joseph, Hari and Sneha's efforts, Guna wins. An announcement and a declaration by Guna and Hari leave Tarunika baffled.

videos.title: The Birth of the Sandals
videos.overview: Rathnam hides diamonds worth 10 crores inside a pair of slippers and hands them to Thyagu, who misplaces them. When he realizes the worth of the sandals, he sends his son, Ilango, to find the pair.

videos.title: The Elusive Pair
videos.overview: Ilango arrives at Ekambaram's house and is shocked to see a large crowd gathered to pay their last respects. Just as Ilango finds the slippers, a man walks away with them.

videos.title: Sandals in Chaos
videos.overview: Ilango successfully retrieves the slippers. The father and son panic when they cannot find the diamonds inside the slippers. They return to Ekambaram's house, only to receive another shock.

videos.title: Sandals and Secrets
videos.overview: Thyagu and Ilango become restless in their search for the discarded slippers. On the other hand, Rathnam arrives at Ekambaram's house to look for them himself and confronts Thyagu.

videos.title: The Cursed Sandals
videos.overview: Thyagu tricks Rathnam and gets him beaten up by Ekambaram's family. The police arrest Rathnam as Thyagu celebrates thinking the diamond slippers will be his. However, his happiness is short-lived.

videos.title: The Vanishing Sandals
videos.overview: Thyagu and Ilango's final attempt to recover the diamond slippers fails when the police catch them. Surprisingly, no diamonds are found, leading to their release. But where are the diamonds?

videos.title: Hoisting the Flag
videos.overview: Day 0: Flag Hoisting Day 1: Procession of the Goddess On the first day of Mayana Kollai festival, Sambaloor town wakes up to the news of a factory fire. Meanwhile, the personal life of the factory’s union leader, Shanmugam, gets complicated. His daughter, Nandini, demands the police’s attention to the matter. Sakkarai, the sub-inspector, gives a cocky response.

videos.title: The Myth
videos.overview: Day 2: Street play Inspector Regina, on realizing the gravity of Shanmugam’s personal problem, springs into action. Kothandaraman, a fire specialist, arrives at the site to draft a fire report for the insurance company. As day two of the Mayana Kollai festival unfolds, Sakkarai goes looking for clues. With Nandini’s help, he gets a critical tip that sends shockwaves by introducing a new suspect.

videos.title: The Procession
videos.overview: Day 3: Procession of the Goddess in the Chariot of Her Soldier Shanmugam and his family aggressively pursue the likely suspect. The stakes are too high for Regina and she takes some damage control measures proactively. Kothandaraman's patience wears thin. The conflict between Regina and Shanmugam is all set to explode.

videos.title: The Immersion
videos.overview: Day 4: Immersion of the Goddess Sakkarai and Nandini reach just in time. A charming love story, set against a tense rivalry, unfolds. Regina and Shanmugam go through a gamut of emotions as they discover the recent past of the children's lives. Sakkarai and Nandini share the difference in their perspectives of the town. The locals toss a big yellow head of the previous year’s idol into the lake.

videos.title: The Looting
videos.overview: Day 6: Soorai - Food from the Deity's Statue Dark clouds engulf the families of Shanmugam and Regina. The autopsy doctor informs them that there is more than what meets the eye. Kothandaraman suspects the factory maintenance. Sakkarai and Nandini unlock Nila's social media profile. As Sakkarai finds out more about the teens, he feels disillusioned. Nandini asks him a pertinent question.

videos.title: The Trance
videos.overview: Day 7: Goddess' Dance The families find solace in the memories of their kids. Kothandaraman investigates inside the burnt factory. Sakkarai and Regina fear the worst and she makes a hasty arrest. Through the enquiry, Sakkarai finds out the answer to the question previously posed by Nandini. He is disturbed. The DNA results from the autopsy test are out - Nandini can barely handle the news.

videos.title: Firewalker
videos.overview: Day 8: The Firewalking Ceremony The cops continue to systematically investigate the Nila-Adhisayam case. The doctor attending to Nandini suggest that she needs psychiatric help and Shanmugam shoots it down immediately. Kothandaraman works the case tirelessly. Sakkarai bends the rules in pursuing his suspect. Shanmugam and Regina, desperate to avenge the crime, take matters into their own hands.

videos.title: The Silence
videos.overview: Day 9: The Swing Kothandaraman now has all the details for the fire report. Nandini's psychiatrist identifies gaps in her memories. Mukesh Vadde is vexed on seeing how futile their plans have turned out to be. A lonely figure walks up to the edge of the cliff. The entire town is at the Mayana Kollai’s grand finale - The 'Oonjal.' The Goddess is done with Her work. Now, She rests.

videos.title: The Beginnings
videos.overview: Nandini is on trial for Guna's murder, defended by respected lawyer Chellappa, a father figure to Sakkarai. Chellappa invites Sakkarai to the Ashtakaali festival but is soon found dead in a locked cottage with a missing gun. Sakkarai becomes the investigating officer, creating tension with Inspector Moorthy. In the locked room murder, Sakkarai finds a hidden shocker!

videos.title: The Confluence
videos.overview: Amidst the festival chaos, Sakkarai grapples with the mute woman from the crime scene, desperate to uncover her identity. Nandini befriends a powerful inmate, while Malathy voices her mistrust of Inspector Moorthy. As Amman processions flood Kaalipattinam, young women from all walks of life emerge with fierce determination. Sakkarai receives a shocking call that blows the case wide open.

videos.title: ⁠The Outliers
videos.overview: A verbatim confession from the 7 young women who surrendered at different police stations, each claiming to have killed Chellappa sends Sakkarai's head spinning. He requests Nandini to be his eyes and ears in the sub-jail the women are lodged in. In lieu of the festival, a low-key funeral is held for the grand man, Chellappa. Dhamu steps up in a time of need, making an immense personal sacrifice.

videos.title: The Knot
videos.overview: Sakkarai diligently searches for connections among the eight women, and Nandini offers him a promising lead. Sakkarai uncovers Chellappa's fraught relationship with the local private school, revealing a potential motive for its owner, Prayamvata. Just when he thinks he has a handle on the case, Sakkarai receives devastating new information-Chellappa may not be the savior he once believed him to be

videos.title: The Conundrum
videos.overview: A stage play in the festival reinstates Sakkarai's resolve to find the young women justice. Sakkarai finds a pathbreaking lead at the crime site. With fresh forensic reports, he imagines the sequence of events on the fateful night. Dhamu's shocking confession solidifies Sakkarai's new image of Chellappa. The young women in the prison pull a risky stunt. Nandini and Sakkarai get the women to talk.

videos.title: The Guardians
videos.overview: 10 years ago: Ravi and Naagamma are a happy, loving couple from the fishing community. Naagamma's world turns topsy-turvy when she discovers Ravi's dark secrets. She takes an extreme measure to set things right. Risking her life, she takes up the role of a protector. Chellappa gets sucked into the vortex in an effort to help Naagamma's efforts to restore a broken path.

videos.title: The Unravel
