videos.overview: Kiruba and his team get the location of the stolen bike. He, along with Lakshmi, Shanmugam and Charles, race against time to save the children.

videos.title: Love Over Fear
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra get caught up in the middle of a riot. Will the kids get their Parachute back? Will Shanmugam and Lakshmi get to them before it's too late?

videos.title: The Identity
videos.overview: The Aachi Mess boys are all grown up and running their restaurant successfully in Koyambedu Market. Thillai is released from jail and comes across the four boys.

videos.title: The Unknown
videos.overview: Desperate for girlfriends, Kuttymani and Settu try to talk to a pretty girl using a unique method, which ends in a disaster. Meanwhile, Urundai is on the hunt for a mysterious bag.

videos.title: The Recognition
videos.overview: Urundai meets Ravi to talk about the mysterious bag. Inspired by a little tea seller, the boys launch a mobile restaurant in the new market. Ravi finds Thillai, shocking Maran.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Ravi entrusts Thillai with a new business, leading to a surprising reunion with his old love. Mayil gets released from jail and visits the boys.

videos.title: The Conflict
videos.overview: The boys await Mayil's return with the key to Aachi Mess. A murder rocks Thillai's water factory. Conflict erupts when Urundai hides his man from cops in the mobile restaurant.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Mayil finally knows the truth behind his arrest. Bhargavi advises Ravi on how to recover Benz's bag. Urundai's father finds the Aachi Mess receipt in Benz's belongings.

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: Twelve years ago, encounter specialist Samidurai was assigned to kill Ravi. Janaki learns that Maran knows Thillai. What happens when Aachi's boys refuse to give the bag to Benz?

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: The Aachi Mess boys fight to get back their van. The fight for the bag grows intense as Pilot also gets kidnapped.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: Naidu finds shocking evidence in the bag. Mayil meets Ravi with a hidden agenda. Thillai visits Janaki to reveal what happened to her father.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Fuming over Naidu's murder, the Aachi Mess boys and girls decide to kidnap Ravi. Meanwhile, Janaki gets crucial evidence about her father's death from an unlikely source.

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: Anu meets a priest, who hands her an ancient box to be transferred to a temple in Iyerpuram. Although she is not keen on going, destiny brings her to Mithran, who offers to travel with her.

videos.title: The Mysterious Destination
videos.overview: Anu reaches the temple and decides to hand over the box, but things are not as simple as they seem to be. She finds herself stuck in the village with no way out.

videos.title: The Codex
videos.overview: A documentary filmmaker, Pathi tries to decipher the codex required to open the box. While Anu continues to struggle in the village, more people arrive with different agendas to get the box.

videos.title: Bheeja Mantra
videos.overview: The group of visitors manage to open the box but are shocked to find what it contains. An unexpected visitor and a shocking death make Anu nervous about the future. She also comes across a prophecy.

videos.title: Deciphering The Codex
videos.overview: Pathi is surprised by his son Vikas’s deciphering skills as he tries to solve the codex. Anu and her father discuss the village’s past. More people discover the 3D prototype of the box.

videos.title: Future Written In The Past
videos.overview: The village comes under Interpol's radar. Pathi realises that the inscriptions on the box can help in solving all the mysteries. Anu gets a vision in her sleep, which changes her perception.

videos.title: The Riddle
videos.overview: Anu finds the key to the temple. Pathi uses Vikas’s help in deciphering the codex. The gateway to the chamber is found but the Fifth Veda is missing!

videos.title: The Fifth Veda
videos.overview: The group is still coming to terms with the chamber’s secrets. While they try to find the missing Veda, Anu realises that the village prophecy means that she is the key to unveiling the Fifth Veda.

videos.title: Square One
videos.overview: Gilly and his trio of companions are enjoying a contented existence in the peaceful town of Rettamugadu. However, their tranquillity is disrupted when Gilly has a fateful encounter, altering the course of their lives entirely.

videos.title: Four Feet Under
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by the situation, Gilly reaches out for help to navigate his turmoil, unaware of the intruder's ties to a criminal network. Gilly inadvertently discovers a locket pendant. Meanwhile, Chezhiyan and his senior officer are hot on the trail of a high-profile criminal.

videos.title: Friend or Foe?
videos.overview: Paari is being tormented by Rico and is coerced into disclosing the whereabouts of his partner. The children, feeling lost and uncertain, are jolted by the daunting realization of the immense task they must undertake.

videos.title: A Beautifull Mind
videos.overview: Sandy learns what Vinay is up to. Chezhiyan may have found important evidence in Raagi’s case. The kids find a clue that might help with their mission. Mahalingam is upset with Sandy. The number of adversaries against the kids is on the rise.

videos.title: Young Blood
videos.overview: Influenced by a powerful mafia figure, an unannounced inspection is conducted. In Rettamugadu, Leo forms a closer bond with Chezhiyan. A misstep by Sandy disrupts the kids' next plan of action and inadvertently creates a pathway for a new threat to emerge. Sandy takes it upon himself to nullify the risk.

videos.title: Back to Square One
videos.overview: Mahalingam attempts to break free from his confinement, while Raagi, along with the kids, visits her mother. The children reach a new unfamiliar place. Will this adventurous detour spiral into a series of unfortunate developments?

videos.title: A New Hope
videos.overview: The parents of the children are frantically searching for their missing kids. Chezhiyan might have made a major breakthrough in Raagi's case. The children must strategize a countermove to divert the trailing police.

videos.title: Larcenist
videos.overview: Despite being faced with tasks beyond their abilities, the kids must find a way to overcome them. Raagi confronts her deepest fear. While trying to mitigate a looming threat, Leo uses the opportunity to impress Airaa.

videos.title: Sought
videos.overview: The kids, the cops and the gangs find themselves facing their greatest challenges yet, with the stakes higher than ever before. When their narratives collide, chaos ensues, propelling a chain reaction of explosive encounters. Yet our heroes may not give up.

videos.title: Secretary Saar!
videos.overview: Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam welcomes its newest Panchayat secretary, Sidharth, a reluctant urbanite fresh out of college. On his first day, everything that can go wrong, goes wrong and spirals into chaos as he grapples with the quirks of rural life.

videos.title: Marathula pei irukkam la?
videos.overview: A haunted tree stands between Siddarth and his CAT preparations. He tries to throw some light on this issue.

videos.title: Oru Narkali ka itna sandai?
videos.overview: Siddarth gets a new office chair with wheels. This somehow affects the power dynamics of the entire village.

videos.title: Poopunitha neerattu vizha!
videos.overview: While Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam celebrates a puberty function, Villagers have issues with Menstrual Health awareness slogans. This puts Siddarth in an awkward position.

videos.title: Kudi Monitorayum kedukkum
videos.overview: As his friends party during the weekend Siddarth has FOMO. But a computer monitor actually goes missing.

videos.title: Inimey pechukku idam illa
videos.overview: Siddarth buys a second hand bike but runs into a new problem. When their pride is challenged the panchayat office gives an answer.

videos.title: Rendula onnu
videos.overview: There is only 50% probability between head or tails, One name or the other, pass or fail.

videos.title: Sound Amma
videos.overview: As Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam celebrates the Republic day, Siddarth gets a different view of the village.

videos.title: Tinku, Raj Kamal & Balaji
videos.overview: Athu lthu Yethu is a celebrity game show hosted by Sivakarthikeyan. Celebrities for this episode are Tinku, Raj Kamal and Balaji.Balaji wins this episode of Athu lthu Yethu. There are also performances by standup comedians Senthil and...

videos.title: Never Ending Fun
videos.overview: Ma Ka Pa launches the new season of your beloved game show. Excitement peaks as the main cast of the show, Siragadikka Aasai joins as special guests.

videos.title: The Professor's Past
videos.overview: Bharathi and Saras's son, sees a potential match in Deepika. However, the groom's father has a connection with the bride's family.

videos.title: Unravelling Ties
videos.overview: Worried about the turn of events, Mr. Bharathi plans to cancel Vaseegaran's betrothal. Saras fumes on learning about his love story.

videos.title: Past Revealed
videos.overview: Deepika's surprise visit leads to tension within the family as lies unravel. Conflicts emerge, pushing Mr. Bharathi to confront his past.

videos.title: Secrets Unveiled
videos.overview: Saras demands more information from Mr. Bharathi about his past, who decides to reveal everything... a little too much in detail.

videos.title: Revelations Unfold
videos.overview: Mr. Bharathi's touching tale makes Saras sentimental. Meanwhile, Ms. Bharathi spots Deepika wearing the infamous anklet necklace.

videos.title: New Beginnings and Resolutions
videos.overview: With secrets laid bare, Mr. Bharathi accepts a date with Vimala. The families get ready for Vaseegaran and Deepika's wedding. But Ilayaraja learns his father's secret.

videos.title: Rainy Reunion
videos.overview: Saras witnesses Mr. Bharathi and his past love reconnecting. How will she tackle her emotions?

videos.title: Running into Reality
videos.overview: As Ms. Bharathi opens up to Saras, Vaseegaran and Deepika take a firm step. Will the families accept their new reality?

videos.title: Meenaskhi Humiliates Pushpa
videos.overview: Shakti teaches a good lesson to a goon for misbehaving with Yamuna. Pushpa loses her temper when Meenakshi gets the contract to prepare ‘prasadam’ for the temple. Later, Pushpa humiliates Meenakshi.

videos.title: Pooja Meets Maali
videos.overview: Pooja meets Maali and orders him to kill Shakti. Ashok wishes to conduct the naming ceremony for the baby, but Saranya sets conditions. Shakti goes to collect votes in favour of Meenakshi

videos.title: A Spicy Revelation!
videos.overview: Rathinasamy, the owner of Ooty's famous Amudha Café, reveals his past to his son, Karthik. Will Karthik be able to fulfil his dying father's last wish?

videos.title: Frying Times Ahead!
videos.overview: A reluctant Sachu agrees to meet Rathinasamy and stay with his family in Ooty. What happens when Rathinasamy’s daughter, Amudha, begins to suspect him?

videos.title: Going Through the Grind!
videos.overview: Sachu develops a bond with Sophie, the family cook, who reminds him of his mother. He is shocked to learn of the pain behind her smile.

videos.title: It's Boiling Hot!
videos.overview: Sachu learns about Karthik’s past. To avoid causing unrest in the family, Sachu decides to return to Chennai, but Karthik has other plans for him.

videos.title: In Search of the Secret Ingredient!
videos.overview: Sachu resolves to find the truth behind his parents' separation. While Sophie offers him moral support, a shocking twist in her life leaves her shaken.

videos.title: A Feast with a Twist!
videos.overview: Sachu stumbles upon a path to the truth that he has been looking for. While Sachu finds answers to everyone's concerns, who will solve his problems?

videos.title: The King's Gambit
videos.overview: A murder case in Jharkhand clashes with Tamil Nadu CM Arunachalam’s corruption trial, prompting his daughter, Amudhavalli, to intervene. CM advisor Kotravai has mysterious visitors.

videos.title: Thalaimai Seyalagam
videos.overview: CBI officer Nawaz Khan takes up the Jharkhand murder case. Meanwhile, in Tamil Nadu, DGP Manikandan probes into a horrifying discovery. Political unrest grows along with rising suspicions.

videos.title: Whispers of Deceit
videos.overview: Manikandan discovers a link between Kotravai and a mysterious figure named Durga. On the other hand, Nawaz Khan follows a trail of clues leading to an ex-journalist.

videos.title: Interlocking Circles
videos.overview: Nawaz Khan's investigation leads him to a police informer and a confrontation with Durga. Kotravai taking charge of politics sparks danger, while Manikandan faces betrayal.

videos.title: A Web of Intrigue
videos.overview: Nawaz Khan encounters a false lead, shifting his focus. A suspended Manikandan continues investigating the case with more determination but gets involved in a violent incident.

videos.title: Chasing Shadows
videos.overview: As Kotravai fights for her life, Arunachalam's fate hangs in the balance. Manikandan and Nawaz Khan follow separate leads to Delhi, seeking answers amidst escalating tension.

videos.title: The Final Stand
videos.overview: With the verdict looming, Kotravai returns, signalling a last-ditch effort to secure power. As the courtroom drama unfolds, Manikandan and Nawaz Khan stumble upon the truth.

videos.title: The Coronation
videos.overview: A twist of fate affects the CM's position. Nawaz Khan and Manikandan close in on their targets. Amidst the chaos, secrets emerge, and alliances break, changing Tamil Nadu's politics forever.

videos.title: The Huntress
videos.overview: When a wildlife photographer’s mysterious death is blamed on a deadly forest spirit called Vanaratchi, Crime Branch Inspector Rishi Nandhan is sent to Thaenkaadu to investigate the case, along with sub-inspectors Ayyanar and Chitra.

videos.title: Devil is in the Details
videos.overview: The lack of physical evidence and the supernatural phenomena around the murder case baffles everyone. Rishi is haunted by a mysterious ghost from his past. Meanwhile, the Vanaratchi claims another victim.

videos.title: In the Shadows
videos.overview: During a search for an abducted man inside the forest, police sniffer dogs get scared and behave wildly. Rishi and the team consult an entomologist regarding webspinner insects. Meanwhile, a handmade Vanaratchi doll mysteriously ends up in the hands of a little girl.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Rishi and Ayyanar have a clash of opinions. Fear spreads throughout the village as more Vanaratchi sightings are reported. Sathya assigns beat officer Kathy to help Rishi and his team in the investigation.

videos.title: Something Wicked
videos.overview: Sathya and Irfan try to track down poachers who conduct illegal activities in the forest. A forest night vision camera captures a horrifying video. Villagers hold an urgent panchayat meeting. Rishi and his team arrest a suspect and question her.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Panic strikes when Kathy and another forest guard go missing in the forest during a routine night patrol. Rishi’s traumatic past with Viji is revealed. Meanwhile, a young village woman gets a visit from the Vanaratchi.

videos.title: Deliver us from Evil
videos.overview: The exorcism of a Vanaratchi-possessed woman gets interrupted by a group of unruly villagers. While Rishi digs deep and studies the victimology, Chitra and Ayyanar lock horns and get into a heated argument.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: Sathya and Irfan are abducted and tortured by poachers. While the rescue team searches for them in the forest, Rishi, Kathy, Ayyanar and Chitra conduct an investigation of their own to find the two officers before it’s too late.

videos.title: The Secret Cavern
videos.overview: Rishi, Ayyanar, Chitra and Sathya venture into a dark and mysterious cave to investigate a crime scene. The truth behind the tribal people’s deadly ritual is revealed. Kathy decides to confess her love to Rishi.

videos.title: Close Encounters
videos.overview: One major clue in the investigation leads Rishi to find shocking revelations and discoveries. The team realises that the lives of many innocent people are at stake if they don’t do something soon.
No description

videos.title: God's Hands
videos.overview: Sent to juvenile detention for a crime he did not commit, Prabha vows to become a judge. Now a famous lawyer, he stops neighbourhood boys from going astray.

videos.title: No Escape
videos.overview: Prabha's application to become a judge becomes an uphill task when his past catches up to haunt him. The sports meet gets attacked by a gang, who are after Veera and Kumar.

videos.title: Salvation & Obsession
videos.overview: A video proof helps Prabha free Veera and Kumar from jail. Prabha learns who is the culprit in his juvenile case, but Veera and Kumar do the unthinkable.

videos.title: The Surrender
videos.overview: After Veera and Kumar do away with Paathaalam, instead of getting the praise they wanted, they find themselves on the radar of the Senguttuvan gang and Inspector Arul Kumaran.

videos.title: The Crossover
videos.overview: Prabha's action makes him a target of the Senguttuvan gang. When his parents are also put in danger, he reluctantly calls Paramasivan.

videos.title: False Victory
videos.overview: Veera and Kumar receive a mixed welcome once they get bailed out. Prabha finds a clever way to retaliate against Arul, who finally reveals the master of Prabha's miseries.

videos.title: Falling Into Hell
videos.overview: Prabha runs into Veera, Kumar and Bunk Suresh while escaping an attack when he realises some harsh truths. Hardened by resolve, he decides to root out the source of his problems.

videos.title: The Journey to Salvation
videos.overview: A vicious attack on Kiruba on the sports ground angers Veera, who riles up his fellow gang members to retaliate. On top of that, Prabha receives devastating news.

videos.title: Sheer Will
videos.overview: While executing the hit on Senguttuvan, Kumar makes a risky decision that angers Bunk Suresh. Veera, caught between his boss and best friend, has to make a tough choice.

videos.title: Sky on Fire
videos.overview: The past once again catches up with Prabha during the judge's interview. On his way back, he gets an ominous phone call and learns that Veera and Kumar have gone missing.

videos.title: First Blood
videos.overview: Veerappan shows his true self. He talks about his origin and his journey into the world of crime. What makes him take up the gun and become a feared bandit?

videos.title: Into The Wild
videos.overview: Veerappan becomes a wanted poacher, smuggler and murderer. He gets a chance to start afresh, but soon, DFO Srinivasan enters his life with different plans.

videos.title: The War
videos.overview: The officers wounded by Veerappan decide to take him down. The best officers set out on a war against the infamous bandit, but will they succeed as Veerappan stands ready with his army.

videos.title: The Hunt For
videos.overview: The police build a large force of determined officers to hunt and capture Veerappan at any cost. What happens on the hunt?

videos.title: Bait Worms
videos.overview: When the battle against Veerappan becomes tough, the police place baits to trick the infamous poacher and his gang. What ensues is more loss in the crossfire.

videos.title: The Beginning
videos.overview: Despite several rounds of battle, Veerappan remains invincible. Was his voluntary exit from the forest the only way to capture him? What lies next for the wanted criminal?

videos.title: Detour
videos.overview: It’s 2005. A van full of people traveling from Navamalai to a city nearby is forced to take a detour through the village of Kattiyal. The van goes missing in the forests, leaving Sakthivel and Karunagam bereft with grief at the loss of their children. In the present day, Gautham and his family set off on a road trip one fateful night when a detour down the same route changes their lives forever.

videos.title: Mission: Kattiyal
videos.overview: When Gautham manages to find his way back along with a reluctant Shakthivel, Karunagam and Peter, his car is nowhere to be found nor his family with all signs of abduction leading them to the dreaded Kattiyal. Meanwhile, Exogenyx’s heir, Prakash’s mercenaries have landed on the coast of Kattiyal and set off into the forest on their mission.

videos.title: Deeper into the Abyss
videos.overview: The mercenaries led by Farhan make their way through the forests as Farhan realizes that Jagan is holding back Prakash’s actual plans. Karunagam reveals the secrets behind Kattiyal and its devastated state, Shakthi's bigoted father, Sairaj, and his descent into madness. The four men venture deeper into Kattiyal only to be attacked by mutant-like creatures that lead them to fall into a cavern.

videos.title: Sins of the Fathers
videos.overview: As Gautham and the gang realize they are in the old mining caverns of Kattiyal, they head deeper in and stumble into Sairaj’s new lair. The mercenaries enter the abandoned factory and find their way down to the underground lab, where they encounter a grotesque prayer altar made by the mutants.

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: Meanwhile, Gautham and his group barely escape the gruesome mutant giant Vettaiyan and stumble upon a horrific tribute in the caverns for the Mother-Goddess that causes Shakthivel to spiral. The group then manages to find Gautham’s family only to be on the run from the mutants.

videos.title: Red Alert
videos.overview: With many lives lost, the mercenaries and Gautham’s gang finally get together and hatch an escape plan. But, the obstacle that stands in their way is the giant mutant monster, Vettaiyan, and his army.

videos.title: Muthu Suspects Manoj
videos.overview: We don't have an overview translated in English. Help us expand our database by adding one.

videos.title: A Life of Solitude
videos.overview: Adhithya, a wealthy man plagued by a mysterious disease, lives in seclusion. However, an electrifying encounter with Mythiri changes this loner's life.

videos.title: The Lifeline
videos.overview: Following a near-death experience after meeting Mythiri, Adhithya stumbles upon Eliyas's creation MY3, a life-like humanoid robot, which could change his life.

videos.title: A Backup MY3
videos.overview: As the delivery date for MY3 nears, Eliyas and his team land in trouble due to an unforeseen incident. With time running out, Eliyas seeks the help of his ex-girlfriend.

videos.title: Mythiri Undercover
videos.overview: Mythiri accepts the challenge. Eliyas and his team secretly orchestrate her actions. How effectively will Mythiri become MY3?

videos.title: Love Is In The Air
videos.overview: Adhithya's childhood friend, Tara, pays him a surprise visit. Mythiri experiences first-hand how difficult this situation can be.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Adithya bares his soul to 'MY3' and expresses his deepest desire. Eliyas meets Adhithya's doctor and learns the mystery behind his perplexing illness.

videos.title: MY3 vs Mythiri
videos.overview: With great effort, Eliyas and his team finally get MY3 back on its feet. However, this leads to chaos and confusion in the house.

videos.title: A Partner For Life
videos.overview: After Adhithya and 'MY3' share a romantic moment, he makes a life-changing decision. As Mythiri struggles to continue her act, Eliyas concocts a plan.

videos.title: Mending A Broken Heart
videos.overview: Adhithya's happiness gets shattered when he learns the truth about MY3. As his problem persists, Mythiri encounters yet another tough challenge.

videos.title: A woman like you
videos.overview: 70 year old Sundari, fed up of her son's coddling, plots her escape towards an unknown destination joined by her granddaughter Niveditha and daughter-in-law Kaveri. Niveditha, a 24 year old cricketer wants to get away from her boyfriend who she's at an impasse with while Kaveri, 'who's just a mother', has had enough of her thankless service to the family.

videos.title: Escape velocity
videos.overview: The trio rest for the night at a questionable motel. Kaveri strikes an unlikely friendship. Rajaratnam's sudden and untimely sickness threatens their trip.

videos.title: A different beat
videos.overview: After Sundari thwarts her son's efforts, the women land up at a cultural festival. Nivi stumbles upon an exciting prospect. Kaveri is visited by a ghost from the past. The trio have to deal with an unexpected problem.

videos.title: Break from a break
videos.overview: The trio's car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. They take refuge in a small village in the back of beyond, where Kaveri meets her counterpart. Sundari seeks an address. Nivi begins to understand her mother.

videos.title: Just a mother
videos.overview: On Sundari's cue, the women embark on a temple trip, where they bump into a foreign couple. Nivi is surprised to find Vikram at a local market, who invites the women to camp with his gang. Kaveri visits a gharana with Vikram. Sundari finally gets the address she's been after.

videos.title: Are you happy?
videos.overview: A major disagreement drives a wedge between the women. As Julia and Robert get married, the women find themselves revisiting their pasts.

videos.title: Hearing is not listening
videos.overview: Nivi and Kaveri rue their behaviour as they wait to hear from the doctor. Kaveri calls Rajaratnam after what seems like a lifetime. Nivi realises she knows nothing about her folks.

videos.title: Rule Number 5
videos.overview: The family is reunited. Just as the women begin to rejoice on their new and improved lives, there is a knock on the door.

videos.title: Lalagunda Bommaigal
videos.overview: An embittered, heartbroken but sharp-tongued young butter-biscuit maker, is told by a holy man that she will find love. But his prediction comes with a caveat in this sardonic love story.

videos.title: Imaigal
videos.overview: A woman facing imminent blindness finds a man who promises to love her, regardless. Will their love endure when life gets in the way?

videos.title: Kaadhal Enbadhu Kannula Heart Irukkura Emoji
videos.overview: A hopelessly romantic, cinema-obsessed 90s kid, embarks on her quest for a ‘grand love story’, directing her life through multiple plot points and romantic film tropes. As she lives in her dream world, what does reality have in store for her?

videos.title: Margazhi
videos.overview: A simple tale of adolescent love. A troubled girl gets smitten with a young boy and begins to fantasize about him. But is the love of a silent heart ever expressed?

videos.title: Paravai Kootil Vaazhum Maangal
videos.overview: A college professor gets a distressing call. As she sets off to deal with an uncertain situation, memories of meeting a man unfold.

videos.title: Ninaivo Oru Paravai
videos.overview: When you lose your memory, have you lost a key to your past or to the future?

videos.title: The Game is Afoot
videos.overview: The only thing good in 14-year-old Vyom’s life is his quiz partner and potential life partner, Tara Venkat. But the universe seems to have different plans. Tara Venkat mysteriously disappears!

videos.title: Elementary
videos.overview: When Vyom becomes the prime suspect and is labelled a ‘murderer’ in school, he decides to clear his name with the help of his four friends. It looks like they have cracked the case open!

videos.title: The Plot Thickens
videos.overview: After the initial failure, Vyom is even more determined to find the real culprit. With his detective skills, he identifies three new suspects, a new ‘friend’ and a sworn enemy.

videos.title: Sleep-walking Detective
videos.overview: Vyom and his friends seem to be on the right track. Their number one suspect gets arrested for the murder, but there is something more than what meets the eye.

videos.title: No Ghosts Need Apply
videos.overview: With no more leads left, Vyom and his friends start chasing more clues and come across shocking revelations. Is the real culprit a human or something supernatural?

videos.title: An Obvious Fact
videos.overview: The stakes for Vyom are higher than ever when his mother, the school's principal is hounded by the press about Tara's mysterious death. What will he do to save her reputation?

videos.title: Logic is Rare
videos.overview: Shital’s accident pushes Vyom and his friends to speed up their investigation. But with no suspects, will the friends find the killer before more people get killed?

videos.title: Puzzled Out
videos.overview: Not all that ends well is well. The case is solved but is it really solved? Will Vyom be able to save the life of the one person he has just realised he loves more than himself?

videos.title: On The Run
videos.overview: Rayar and his brothers hide in the forest after committing three murders. Meanwhile, the state party in power devises a strategy to dethrone Rajamanikkam, the town's third-generation chairman.

videos.title: Honeymoon Journey
videos.overview: Rayar is close to his next target, but he is pushed into an emotional dilemma by the police. On the other hand, Rajamanickam is back in power after he counters the MLA’s plan to overthrow him.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Rayar must save his wife from trouble. Meanwhile, the ruling party initiates its plan to take overthrow the Sivagnyanam family. Aware of the state’s plan, Sivagnyanam looks for a worthy successor.

videos.title: Election Game
videos.overview: Rayar stays a step ahead of the police. On the other hand, the election for the post of the new chairman ends favourably for Sivanyanam. Suriyakala’s name emerges as the successor to the coveted post.

videos.title: Funeral
videos.overview: The police plan to catch Rayar and his brothers when they reach their hometown. Suriyakala chooses a trustworthy aide to support her against her relatives. The lives of Rayar and Suriyakala's families cross paths.

videos.title: Ruse
videos.overview: The police approach Rayar's trusted friend after the minister gives them an ultimatum to catch him. Nachiyar, Rayar’s sister, asks him to help out Suriyakala. They travel to Rajapalayam.

videos.title: Oath of Office
videos.overview: Rayar interrogates Ravi Chellappa. Meanwhile, Suriyakala challenges her father-in-law, Sivagnyanam, with the help of Nachiyar.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Suriyakala proves herself to be efficient in handling political power. The people are pleased with her. However, her success doesn’t sit well with her father-in-law.

videos.title: Crown
videos.overview: Rayar accomplishes his revenge mission but gets caught before he can find the mastermind behind all the incidents.

videos.title: The Accidental Farmer
videos.overview: Upon inheriting a piece of barren farmland, Chella unwittingly takes up farming to repay the debt. Just as he's all set to give up after realising how hard he would have to work, he stumbles upon something that leaves him with a unique experience.

videos.title: The Desparate Vow
videos.overview: Chella sets off in search of the mysterious plant and reevaluates his priorities throughout the journey. When he realises it was a herb that can be cultivated, he finds that he's not ready to quit farming just yet.

videos.title: And Company
videos.overview: With Nalamakka's help, Chella tries to convince the villagers to help him; however, almost no one agrees. He manages to form a core team of people with their own hidden agendas, while Sevala makes a shocking discovery about the mysterious herb.

videos.title: High Stakes
videos.overview: Although Sevala originally planned on revealing the truth about the herb to his team, he decides to keep mum. Meanwhile, Chella is forced to do all the heavy lifting, as Sheela joins the team. Durai, on the other hand, has a secret plan to stop Chella.

videos.title: Cultivation And Promotion
videos.overview: After handling Durai, Chella and the team begin to harvest their bounty. They and Dr Moorthy showcase the herb's medicinal properties to the villagers and receive a surprising response.

videos.title: Out Of The Village
videos.overview: While Chella and the team begin to work on their next batch, Dr Moorty sees patients who have travelled from afar. Trouble starts brewing when Anti Narcotics Force Officer Anu stumbles upon their operation.

videos.title: Walking Into The Trap
videos.overview: Chella and the team innocently explain their operation to Anu, unaware that she is an undercover officer. Everything goes downhill as the team encounters obstacle after obstacle, and Anu finally gathers enough evidence to nab them.

videos.title: Nothing But The Truth
videos.overview: A shocked Chella is left in tears when he sees that his farmland has been burnt to ashes. Meanwhile, the police led by Anu discovers that all the evidence has been destroyed.
We don't have an overview translated in English. Help us expand our database by adding one.

videos.title: The Homicide of A Young Women
videos.overview: Inspector Viktor, an eagle-eyed police officer who has been going through a personal crisis, is assigned to investigate the homicide of Nivetha, a young, unmarried woman.

videos.title: A New Lead for Viktor
videos.overview: Viktor questions the victim's lover, Prabhakaran. He also finds a video recording on Nivetha's phone which leads him to a 'Thirukural' couplet.

videos.title: A New Victim
videos.overview: The second victim is identified as Krishnamoorthy, an architect. Viktor gets a vital clue on the killer as he investigates further.

videos.title: Scrutinizing the Past Records
videos.overview: Previously, Viktor and his wife, Geetha, are seen having a heated argument that gets violent. At present, Viktor scours the city police records for killings in the past that match with the killer's MO.

videos.title: Viktor Receives a Warning
videos.overview: The news about the serial killer is leaked to the press. Later, Viktor gets a cryptic warning from the killer before he can save his next victim.

videos.title: Finding Potential Evidences
videos.overview: Viktor and Kishore meet Prabhakaran's wife and Keerthana's friend, amongst others. They get a lead on a Red-coloured car that may belong to the killer.

videos.title: Viktor Gets Flabbergasted
videos.overview: Viktor and Kishore question possible suspects based on the killer's car details. Viktor also gets a surprise lead from the victims' phone-call histories.

videos.title: An Eye on the Killer
videos.overview: The police squad under Viktor spy on the killer, round the clock. Viktor also breaks into the killer's house and stumbles upon his personal diary.

videos.title: Mind Games
videos.overview: On the speculated day of his next killing, the alarmed killer and a resolute Viktor engage in a series of mind games that can have only one winner.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Six months after neutralising Sekar, Viktor has taken time off to care for Gayathri while searching for his missing wife. Meanwhile, Senior Inspector Kishore and his boss Thilak discover the bodies of two murdered cops in a car belonging to psychologist and motivational speaker Lankeshwaran.....

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The comissioner, aware of the Thirukkural connection, convinces Viktor to help with the double murder case. Although having provided an alibi, Lankeshwaran draws the suspicion of Viktor when he discreetly quotes a Thirukkural couplet. Meanwhile, a constable's body is discovered in the trunk of a car near the police station.....

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When the police find a Thirukkaral note with Muthu's body, Viktor gets permission from the commissioner to question Lankeshwaran once more. Ego clashes over Lankeshwaran's involvement in the murders leads Viktor, along with Kishore, to set up discreet surveillance on the suspect.....

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Viktor, along with Kishore and Constable Sabari, follows the location of a GPS tracker activated by the techie who helped him with Sekar's case. While Viktor finds the tracker, he realises the techie is still missing. Meanwhile, Sabari is run over by a car, and Kishore, who tries to help her, is knocked unconscious.....

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While Viktor gets no response from Kishore or the constables, Gayathri finds the techie's body in a mysterious car parked near Anjali's house. When the commissioner learns of the turn of events, he reprimands Viktor and Thilak and gives Viktor a last chance to find Kishore.....

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Viktor, devastated at Kishore's loss, is thrown off the case but convinces Priya to help him investigate Lankeshwaran privately. Thilak, reinstated to investigate the case, meets with Lankeshwaran and opens up to him about his strained marriage. Meanwhile, Priya tells Viktor that he could be Lankeshwaran's next target.....

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A devastated Thilak breaks down in front of Lankeshwaran when he learns about his wife's attempted suicide. Meanwhile, Viktor has a major breakthrough in his investigation that allows him to finally arrest Lankeshwaran.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While Thilak is fuming about Viktor sidestepping him, Lankeshwaran blackmails Viktor into handing over all evidence against him to his accomplice.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: While Thilak closes the case believing the accomplice was behind the murders, Lankeshwaran manipulates him into thinking Viktor is responsible. Meanwhile, Viktor breaks into Lankeshwaran's house and stumbles upon an important piece of evidence that could blow the case wide open.....

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The recordings along with Gayathri's positive identification of the other person with Sekar lead Viktor to a startling revelation about Lankeshwaran and Geetha.

videos.title: Rough Beginnings
videos.overview: Following the stories of 6 students, Engga hostel explores the relatable and curious life inside a Tamil Nadu engineering hostel.

videos.title: Identity ‘Cry’sis
videos.overview: Ajay grapples with his identity. Ahaana is troubled by her popularity and Raja is jealous of Ahaana. Senthil finds it too easy to get into clubs while Paandi struggles.

videos.title: Kadhal Complications
videos.overview: Kadhal (Love) is in the air! Ajay has a crush on Ahaana. Paandi, Senthil and Chitthappu are by his side. What could go wrong?

videos.title: Make a Wish
videos.overview: Ajay endeavors to do what no man has been able to do before - escape Birthday bumps. He hides from the boys only to be caught by Ahaana and Raja.

videos.title: Final Exams
videos.overview: Frenemies Ajay and Chitthappu partner to figure out ways to pass the final exam the night before but their characters are put to the test.

videos.title: The Achievers' Board
videos.overview: In the 90s, the people of Veerappannai take pride in marrying off girls as soon as they reach puberty. But teenaged Tamil Selvi dreams of becoming a doctor rather than a young bride.

videos.title: The Red Pain
videos.overview: Tamil fears that her dream of becoming a doctor will fail as soon as she reaches puberty, as her parents won’t defy customs. She prays to God so that she never hits puberty, only to be disappointed.

videos.title: The Kuruvammal Challenge
videos.overview: Tamil hides her puberty and violates the village's most important tradition to continue with her education. But when her mother discovers her condition, Tamil convinces her to let her continue going to school.

videos.title: Hall Ticket
videos.overview: As the village's 1st female student who has progressed to class 10, Tamil is often bullied. Will she defy the village head and step outside the village to take the test in the town public school?

videos.title: Three Flowers
videos.overview: Tamil and her mother travel to town for the public examination. However, Tamil's father gets injured in an accident, and her mother begins to think of it as god’s way of punishing the family for defying customs.

videos.title: No Boundaries for Bold Women
videos.overview: Tamil's friend Kayalvizhi is due to get married. They come up with a plan to stop it by defying a custom that restricts women's entry to the temple. This move overturns all the traditional practices of the village.

videos.title: The Revolution
videos.overview: Inspired by Tamil, every woman now wants to enter the temple. Tamil feels happy thinking about the changed fate of the women in her village. But Thavasi’s son soon crushes her plans.

videos.title: Ayali
videos.overview: Ezhil and Sakthivel's marriage gets arranged. But the women in the village now take a stand against any custom that challenges their freedom and try to stop the union.

videos.title: Weighing Scale
videos.overview: When Ram and Titus, aspiring actors, are close to grabbing a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, a moment of carelessness endangers the life of a stranger. Titus, ridden with guilt, urges Ram to surrender to the police, but Ram refuses to let go of the aspirational life he craves. Things take an eerie turn when the latter is haunted by a weighing device he finds in his late grandmother’s belongings that weighs his sins in addition to his body weight.

videos.title: Cellular
videos.overview: Having been raised in the shadow of her mother, Vannamayil decides to do as she likes for once, and the unfortunate happens. But Vannamayil gets the scare of her life when she gets an otherworldly call.

videos.title: Compressor
videos.overview: When Raghu chances upon a bundle of cash, he asks his live-in girlfriend Shruthi to either plan a vacation for the two, or buy an air conditioner. She buys a second-hand AC, and the object begins to trouble Raghu. When he goes missing all of a sudden, Shruthi begins to investigate.

videos.title: Car
videos.overview: Britto is on a brave quest to overcome the fear of his abusive father and his car. Every time his mother questioned his father for beating him, little Britto would get locked up by his father in his car with a watchdog standing guard. Inside that dark and dingy car, Britto’s fears manifest in many forms. Decades later, Britto decides to fight back, but the ghosts of his past return.

videos.title: Mirror
videos.overview: After he is thrown out of his hostel, Sethu, who is suffering a terrible break-up, moves into the attic of an old house. He questions his own sanity for a moment when a ten-year-old girl named Nazia talks to him through an old dresser mirror.

videos.title: Plunged into Darkness
videos.overview: It's been six months since Divya's fall, and she is still in a coma. Rohit and Daniel try to sell her sports centre. Upon hitting a roadblock, Rohit does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Waking Up from the Abyss
videos.overview: As Divya tries to recollect the events of the fateful night, Rohit panics when he learns that she is out of her coma. Meanwhile, Daniel gets closer to Maya.

videos.title: Web of Lies
videos.overview: Caught secretly filming women and selling drugs at the sports centre, Ilango becomes a suspect in Divya’s fall. Moreover, a break-in raises further suspicion.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Divya tries to piece her memories together. While Rohit learns the actual value of the property and acts swiftly to sell it, Daniel digs deeper into Rohit’s past to stop him.

videos.title: Prey in the Shadows
videos.overview: Divya's suspicion against her brother grows stronger when she learns of his financial troubles. With Divya on the warpath, Rohit and Daniel take desperate measures to stop her.

videos.title: Truth Unwinds
videos.overview: When Malar learns the truth about Rohit, she shares her concerns with Divya. Things take an interesting turn when she reveals his whereabouts on the night of her fall.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Divya confronts Maya and learns shocking truths about her accident. Lakshmi forces Jeeva to leave the country to stop Divya from finding the final missing piece in the puzzle.

videos.title: Moon Walk
videos.overview: Semba from the slums and star dancer Vikram are very different from each other. Their love for dance is the only common ground between them but this common ground is also the reason for the stiff competition between them.

videos.title: Face Off
videos.overview: Vikram gets called out in school for something he never did. However, problems between his sister Shweta and Semba’s brother, Dinesh, lead to a dance battle between team Semba and Vikram.

videos.title: Free Spin
videos.overview: The new kid on the block, Keshav, is rejected by Team Vikram, but Semba accepts him. Dinesh tries to get into Vikram’s good books but ends up instigating Semba to participate in Dancing Teens.

videos.title: Jump and Flip
videos.overview: With Keshav’s mother’s help, Team Semba participates in the Dancing Teens competition. At school, Vikram gets into undue trouble once again, and Keshav faces a big blow while helping Vikram.

videos.title: Step Up
videos.overview: Semba and Vikram unite over their love and compassion for Keshav. When the team faces problems at the National level of Dancing Teens, the unassuming watchman, Balan, steps in to help.

videos.title: Bounce Back
videos.overview: On reaching the International Arena of Dancing Teens competition in Mumbai, Vikram and Semba realise their shortcomings. Keshav’s condition worsens, and Balan’s dark past gets revealed.

videos.title: Twist and Turn
videos.overview: As team India’s rivalry with China worsens at the dance competition, Dinesh and Shweta’s relationship continues to be in troubled waters. Will they be able to survive it all?

videos.title: Burn It Up
videos.overview: Things come together as all mysteries are solved and misconceptions cleared. Will Team India win, is the only question on everyone’s mind. Will Semba and Vikram win over their enmity too?

videos.title: Once Upon A Time...
videos.overview: Anbu and the Boy have unique problems of their own. Whenever the Boy hears someone expressing a desire, he feels the urge to destroy the object of the desire. Anbu, on the other hand, is a part of a nine-member pickpocket gang and seems to always be shrouded in bad luck.

videos.title: The End To A New Beginning
Meet Ganeshan
videos.overview: Ganeshan, a busy bee who runs several businesses to meet the needs to provide to his family. However, his biggest problem is Gunavathi, a tyrant.

videos.title: Sornam Is Furious
videos.overview: Guna intimidates Ganesan and sends him back. Afterwards, Sornam gives a fitting reply to Gopal for lashing out at Ganesan.

videos.title: Ganeshan, Guna Lock Horns
videos.overview: Ganeshan requests his owner to lend him some money to meet his siblings' needs. Later, he creates a ruckus when Guna insults him.

videos.title: A Stranger's Gift to Ganesan
videos.overview: Sornam creates a ruckus when Ganesan yells at her for demanding money. Next day, a stranger visits Ganesan's house and presents him a gift.

videos.title: Sornam, Guna's Tiff
videos.overview: Sornam and Guna argue over carrying out the ritual. Later, Chithra calls Ganesan and gives a happy news.

videos.title: Rangarajan's Stubborn Decision
videos.overview: Rangarajan adamantly refuses to invite Ganesan and family to the ceremony. Elsewhere, Guna evicts the tenants as they bad-mouth her.

videos.title: The Pirates Of The Kodambakkam
videos.overview: The suicide of a despondent producer whose film has been pirated by Tamil Rockerz prompts industry-wide chaos. Producer Madhi is determined to stop his new big-budget movie from meeting the same fate. ACP Rudra faces heat from the IG for an unnecessary encounter.

videos.title: Aye, Aye, Captain!
videos.overview: Rudra joins the Cyber Crimes Division to lead the effort to protect Garuda, but stopping the threatened piracy does not seem to be his priority. The Tamil Rockerz's challenge has riled up fans of Athiradi star Adithya, the lead of ‘Garuda’.

videos.title: The Gossip Protocol
videos.overview: Rudra meets the team. Dhayalan’s origin story is revealed. Young impressionable fans of Athiradi star Adithya are manipulated with the intention of shaking the tree to see what falls out.

videos.title: Seed and Leech
videos.overview: There is panic on the streets of Chennai as Adithya’s fan club raids the illegal CD/DVD market. Rudra becomes a puppet master, pulling strings from behind the scenes to gather information. A rift grows between old friends Kiran and Arun.

videos.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales
videos.overview: A new development offers Rudra a direct line to the motive behind the Tamil Rockerz targeting ‘Garuda’. Ghosts from Madhi’s past climb out of their graves. The conflict between Arun and Kiran escalates.

videos.title: Peer Tracker
videos.overview: It's all hands on deck as the cyber team roots out the network of contributors used by the Tamil Rockerz. Madhi gets entangled in the grapevine as gossip around ‘Garuda’ pushes him further into trouble. Rudra and the team set out on a manhunt armed with only part of a clue.

videos.title: Walk The Plank
videos.overview: Madhi’s deal with the devil forces him to circumvent the cyber team’s InfoSec guidelines, giving the Tamil Rockerz an opening. Rudra must fix a leak and catch up before the situation gets out of hand.

videos.title: Shiver Me Timbers
videos.overview: Rudra and the team reach the endgame. Implications surrounding why and how he was brought into the case force Rudra to reconsider a lot of things. Madhi learns that even dead snakes can bite.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 1
videos.overview: Aadhav visits Decathlon, by the twist of fate he meets Prathana there. He eventually becomes a regular customer for her sake, until one day he decides to let her know his real intention.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 2
videos.overview: When Aadhav and Dheeksha travel to a lively village, a new bond bloom between them. Meera tries to flirt with Aadhav which triggers Dheeksha’s possessiveness and prompts her to grow closer to Aadhav.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 3
videos.overview: The past unfolds where Prathana accepts Aadhav’s proposal and they wallow in love. A new couple moves next door to Aadhav’s flat, both the couples forge a friendship.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 4
videos.overview: Aadhav struggles to set his life back on an even keel after an unfortunate event. Simultaneously Dheeksha also goes through a rough phase because of her narcissistic boyfriend.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 5
videos.overview: Aadhav and Dheeksha’s friendship starts to flourish while they try to mend each other. Impulsive Aadhav dashes to the Bandhipur forest to pull off his heart’s desire.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 6
videos.overview: Impressed by Aadhav’s efforts, Dheeksha makes a big decision, her friends and family feels jubilant about it. Deeksha and Aadhav goes to her familial house in Kerala.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 7
videos.overview: An unforeseen plight disrupts their smooth sailing relationship. They both mutually come to a conclusion with a heavy heart.

videos.title: Dhammam
videos.overview: While readying a patch of agricultural land with his tween daughter, a middle-aged man ends up slitting a man's throat during a tussle over land. He must face the consequences when the injured man's family labels the fight as attempted murder.

videos.title: Kottai Pakku Vathalum... Mottai Maadi Sitharum!
videos.overview: During the COVID-19 pandemic, a sub-editor tries his best to avoid being laid off and decides to impress his editor with a special interview of a saint who claims to have conquered time and has been living for centuries. What he doesn't anticipate is the terms laid out by the saint which also include a death threat.

videos.title: Mirrage
videos.overview: A girl travels to Chennai and arrives at an abandoned villa which has been booked by her company for an overnight stay. When strange things begin to happen around her, she realises that she is caught in the middle of paranormal activity. She must now fight for her life against the manager of the villa who will stop at nothing to see her dead.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: A woman in her early thirties returns home from work and gets ready for bed when she receives a series of phone calls with the last one coming from a sniper, who has her in the crosshairs. She must now confess her deepest, darkest sins if she wants to live.

videos.title: Expectation Vs Reality
videos.overview: As the new college year begins, Mojo actively tries to put a team together to take part in the Meme Fest. Meanwhile, Apoorva University gets a new dean who comes up with his own plans. Is there a conflict in the offing?

videos.title: Make This man Famous
videos.overview: With the popularity of the Meme Boys spreading, battle lines are drawn between the group and the dean, The dean tries to establish a task force to identify the faces behind the Meme Boys

videos.title: To Catch A Memer
videos.overview: The dean gets an unexpected ally in his crackdown on the Meme Boys. Meanwhile, as they get ahead of themselves, internal differences brew within the Meme Boys, leading to an unpleasant confrontation

videos.title: Confusions Of Apoorva University
videos.overview: As mistrust arises and the cracks widen, will the Meme Boys come together or disband their team? An unexpected move by the dean puts them at a further disadvantage.

videos.title: Mission Unpossible
videos.overview: With the bean tightening the noose and the deadline closing in to post their tournament-defining meme, the Meme Boys must pull off an impossible heist-like operation to save themselves.

videos.title: Gangs Of Apoorva
videos.overview: A rigged student union election orchestrated by the dean proves to be the last straw and leads to an all-out war between the students and the dean powered by the Meme boys. The issue becomes a matter of public and media debate

videos.title: The Dean Wants To Know
videos.overview: Apoorva University and the mediascape come to a standstill as they prepare to witness the epic showdown of Meme Boys vs Dean Narayanan on Primetime News. The Meme Boys must decide once and for all whether to reveal themselves to the public?

videos.title: Thoughts Become Things?
videos.overview: With the Meme Boys arrested under the pretext of issuing a death threat to the dean, they must do whatever it takes to prove their innocence while a vengeful Narayanan is out for blood. However, unexpected help arrives.

videos.title: Greed
videos.overview: Rekha and Vijay, married and living in a city, face serious challenges when the social media platform, Clicker, enters their lives. Rekha is overjoyed with her new-found success on Clicker and is ready to go to any extreme to retain her online popularity.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Krishnamoorthy, a retired banker and a strict disciplinarian, is finding it tough to deal with a real-life situation when a threat from the digital world forces him to face unexpected consequences.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Priya and Vidhya's friendship takes a hit when Varun, a handsome young man, enters their lives. And social media platforms, instead of bringing the friends closer, only heighten Priya's woes permanently changing her equation with her friend.

videos.title: Lust
videos.overview: Sandhya is a postgraduate student who harbours numerous dreams and ambitions. Raghavan, an IT professional, on the other hand, lives a monotonous life. The two instantly hit it off after connecting on dating app Qupid. But the seemingly perfect relationship suddenly begins to develop cracks with unforeseen twists and turns.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: Sanjay is an actor who is loved by the masses and the classes alike. The star is highly active and vocal on the social media platform Expressit. However, Sanjay is not aware of the surprise that Expressit has in store for him a surprise that will challenge his reputation, his family, and, ultimately, his decade-long career.

videos.title: Enter Password 'Eclipse'
videos.overview: Shruti, a psychologist, is on a mission to spread awareness about digital depression. She meets ACP Arivazhagan to discuss the dangerous side of the digital world.

videos.title: Hacked
videos.overview: As the ACP digs deeper into finding Eclipse, the hunt intensifies. Aadinath sets his trap and so does Navin. While Mr. and Mrs. Sethupathi go about their lives, someone plots a deadly game.

videos.title: Viral Wave
videos.overview: A heartbroken ACP Arivazhagan seeks Shruti’s help to regain composure. Aadinath's world comes to a standstill when an old acquaintance enters his life. Venkat yearns to express himself.

videos.title: Locked Up
videos.overview: Priya works towards achieving her goals while the turn of events shocks Venkat. Tara and Navin get closer. ACP Arivazhagan's investigation intensifies while Aadinath starts to settle old scores.

videos.title: The Missing Clue
videos.overview: Navin visits Aadinath while the cops call Venkat for an interrogation. Shruti’s search turns out to be futile, and so does ACP Arivazhagan's investigation. But things change when the ACP talks with Venkat.

videos.title: Hidden Files
videos.overview: The ACP finds a vital clue but hits a roadblock again. Priya’s life starts changing as she fights her inner demons. Venkat, Navin, and Aadinath go about their chaotic lives as Eclipse enters the picture.

videos.title: Unmasked
videos.overview: As things unfold, new revelations hit ACP, Shruti, and Priya. While guilt plagues Venkat, Navin proves he is the master of chaos again. Aadinath gets ready to lead his dream life.

videos.title: Reset
videos.overview: Shruti finds the person she has been searching for as the ACP solves the crime. Priya seeks redemption while Navin chases victory. As everyone's lives resolve, a new, faceless entity threatens to disrupt everything.

videos.title: Chapter 1 - Maragatham
videos.overview: Ananth, a successful writer, unwillingly revisits his family home. Meanwhile, an estranged father dives into the past to learn about the journey of Venkatesan and his wife Maragatham in their home called 'Anantham.'

videos.title: Chapter 2 - Seetha
videos.overview: Ananth learns the story of a married couple who lived in the house in 1971—Sundar and his visually impaired wife, Seetha. He witnesses Seetha's plight during the days she spent within the walls of Anantham.

videos.title: Chapter 3 - Rekha
videos.overview: Set in 1975, witness the struggling lives of Sandeep, an IIT graduate, Rekha, his happy-go-lucky wife, and their two children.

videos.title: Chapter 4 - Ananth
videos.overview: Ananth recalls the first time he fell in love in 1985 and how it changed his life forever.

videos.title: Chapter 5 - Krishnan Menon
videos.overview: Three beautiful women living in 'Anantham' experience laughter and love after Krishnan Menon, a new paying guest, moves into their home.

videos.title: Chapter 6 - Lalitha
videos.overview: Tenants Lalitha and Balu return to stay at Anantham. But, will they have a peaceful stay at Anantham despite the horrible sins committed during their previous stay?

videos.title: Chapter 7 - Parvathy
videos.overview: Ananth meets a young psychotherapist, Parvathy, who tells him about her painful journey and how she broke barriers and embraced her true potential while living at Anantham.

videos.title: Chapter 8 - Venkatesan
videos.overview: Venkatesan returns home to spend his remaining days at Anantham. As he nears his end, will he reconcile with his son and embrace peace?

videos.title: Section 174
videos.overview: Sub-inspector Paridhi is supposed to be on leave. But circumstances lead him to take charge of routine cases at the Vembur police station, and soon an unexpected call makes the routine in the station go for a toss.

videos.title: The Torch
videos.overview: Paridhi is in a race against time to find the criminal and solve the case. But when he finds himself at a crossroad as a personal emergency demands his time and attention, Karappu has the answers.

videos.title: The Hunt Widens
videos.overview: The uprooted evidence further complicates the case, and while the investigation gains pace, the new leads only create more complexities. Paridhi and the team form many theories, but an unexpected situation awaits them.

videos.title: Handcuffed
videos.overview: Paridhi’s unexpected finding solidifies the case and reaffirms that they are on the right track. Paridhi believes he has found the culprit, but the suspect brings to light what Paridhi has overlooked.

videos.title: An Unconventional Interrogation
videos.overview: Paridhi is sure he has found the right man and handcuffs him. But the lack of evidence threatens to derail his efforts. Desperate to save himself, Paridhi takes the unconventional route.

videos.title: The Ordeal
videos.overview: Paridhi is very close to solving the case, but his unconventional approach puts him into trouble. With his investigation losing pace and time running out, can Paridhi find a way out?

videos.title: The Last Piece of the Puzzle

videos.title: The Introduction
videos.overview: Retelling real-life paranormal stories is what Jenny and her team does best, and their show, Dark Tales, is proof of that. But the otherworldly may be closer than they think.

videos.title: The Failure
videos.overview: Dark Tales faces a crisis, but its team won't go away without a fight. Meanwhile, a secret from Sekar's past shows Jenny a way ahead.

videos.title: The Prep
videos.overview: Once Dark Tales is axed and Jenny sells her idea to the channel, the team settles on a haunted house in Yelagiri. Enter Shenbagam and her two children.

videos.title: The Show
videos.overview: Lights, camera, live! Shenbagam recounts her experiences in the house, and Jenny uses special effects to keep the viewers hooked. But one of the extra actors is just not ordinary.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: The unthinkable happens while the world watches. When the crew tries to escape their ordeal, something is hell-bent on keeping them inside the house.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: ACP Guru tries his best to help the trapped crew but in vain. Finally, Jenny reaches the end of her tether and makes a compromise.

videos.title: The Climax
videos.overview: The culprit responsible for everyone's misery makes his appearance, and he has no intention of letting anyone go. However, Sekar is the only one who can stop him.

videos.title: Sun, Beach, Drugs, and Crime
videos.overview: A rave party, shootout, and a politician's conspiracy send Adira on a guilt trip from the past, as the Siolim drug party case continues to haunt her. Can Varun and Kavya help Adira on the road to redemption?

videos.title: Two Bullets, One Lie and A Mask
videos.overview: Adira has to believe in her instinct, and this makes her suspicious of everyone around. Varun and Kavya are both haunted by their past. Meanwhile, a familiar stranger visits Varun and an uninvited guest visits Kavya.

videos.title: When Desperation turns Unlucky!
videos.overview: Kavya tries her best to bury the past, even as it keeps simmering. Varun finds a key which can open his memory vault. On the other hand, Adira is desperate and gets closer to a vital piece of the puzzle, but her luck runs out.

videos.title: Maya and Murphy's law
videos.overview: Regardless of Adira's deception tactics, the odds are against her. Kavya runs away from the clutches of death, but Hades follows her. On the other hand, Varun's odyssey to find Maya leads him into a death trap.

videos.title: A Key to the Puzzle?
videos.overview: Starting with Kavya, Adira begins to solve the puzzle. On the other hand, Varun is trapped between the four walls and his lost memory. He uses a secret key to open the memory vault. The beast is caught in Adira's booby trap.

videos.title: Love, Sex, and Games
videos.overview: Varun recollects that Maya was more than just a game for him. Adira ducks the bullet, but her target is spot on. The game intensifies, and the real players are finally revealed.

videos.title: The Game Begins
videos.overview: Varun learns the game and starts to play. Adira puts all the missing pieces together but fails to solve the puzzle. On the other hand, Maya opens a Pandora's box of unpleasant memories for Varun.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: The monster is unleashed once again. Adira and Varun have to play the game not to win but to survive. Will the monster spare them, or is there a twist to the tale?

videos.overview: While trying to set things right, Mugilan finds himself in a situation where his most trusted aides have let him down. Mugilan retaliates to Rajendran's action to pressurise him.

videos.overview: In the race to become the prime confidant, Saravanan and Mugilan play games. But the tables are turned due to a sudden change, giving one of them an edge to become the successor.

videos.title: Red Eagles
videos.overview: Trying to pick up the pieces, Maghi tries to reach out to Mugilan in distress. Unfortunately, things go haywire on Mugilan’s front leaving him vulnerable.

videos.title: Allegiance And Betrayal
videos.overview: Going back and forth in the occurrence of events, the life of the undisputed gangster starts to crumble, drawing a thin line between allegiance and betrayal.

videos.title: Flush In
videos.overview: After seeing his family off, Bala peacefully settles down in his new apartment, only to find random time travellers from different periods popping out of his bathroom, one by one. Will he be able to stop this madness before anyone else finds out?

videos.title: Jobs
videos.overview: Until they find a way to get back to their original time periods, the time travellers in Bala’s place decide to find jobs in today’s world. Can they safely land in sustainable jobs, despite their quirks and limitations?

videos.title: Midnight Masala
videos.overview: Rubbishing a delicacy that Killi prepares at home, the housemates decide to go out for dinner. Unfortunately, the city shuts down due to the sudden death of a politician. As they hunt for food around the city through the night, back home Killi is looking for someone to test his delicacy on. Who ends up getting what they wanted?

videos.title: Adhaan Plan!
videos.overview: Bala’s family arm-twists him into meeting a girl for the prospects of marriage. In view of his American Dream, Bala decides to kill every possibility of getting married. Bharathi and the housemates, arrive at a ‘brilliant’ plan to help Bala create a bad impression on the girl. But the gods have their own plans!

videos.title: Crush Next Door
videos.overview: Hannah loses heart to Kabir- a stranger, the moment she meets him at the apartment elevator. When Kabir later visits Bala’s apartment asking for a favor, Hannah goes out of the way to hold him back and make an impression. As she starts going overboard, her conscience pops out to question her. How much of her nature would she compromise to impress Kabir?

videos.title: Shrooms
videos.overview: Killi by mistake consumes magic mushrooms (hallucinogen) stored secretly at his restaurant by his assistant. When he reaches home he starts hallucinating that the house is a battlefield; that he is a warrior of the Cholan army, and that the housemates are from the enemy camp. As he locks the door, the housemates have no choice but to play along until they find a way to get out.

videos.title: Run Buggy Run!
videos.overview: During a heated argument in their office, Bala challenges his macho colleague Britto, that Buggy would beat him at the upcoming office marathon. With no rhyme or reason, Buggy suddenly gains a crazy fan following, and the housemates put immense pressure on him to train for the marathon. Could any of this affect the ever so emotionless Buggy?

videos.title: Bottle Neck
videos.overview: When Bala’s work-from-home session is marred by Hannah’s music audition video shoot, he reacts in a fit of rage and accidentally spoils her voice forever. With the main music event scheduled for the very next day, Hannah is unable to come to terms with her pathetic new voice. Will Bala be able to make up for his mistake in time and salvage the mess for Hannah?

videos.title: Horoscope
videos.overview: Bharathi reads out the horoscope of all the housemates for the day, and it says that Bala would ‘meet the woman of his life’. Buggy being a rationalist, challenges to prove the horoscope wrong. Luckily for Bala, the office party is on that very evening and he might find ‘the woman’ there. Now, to what lengths would Buggy go to beat the stars?

videos.title: Flush Out
videos.overview: Bharathi finally manages to create a time machine for the housemates to get back to their original time periods. She starts off by testing it on herself. Does it work? Do the other time travellers in the house risk it too? How happy would Bala feel to see his friends off forever?

videos.overview: After fleeing from prison, TOP is all set to pull off 3 crimes with his loyal team RIGHT, LEFT, BASE and STRAIGHT who were convicted for a sloppy bank heist. The team manages to pull off the first crime and decides to loot money from a British lady, Helena, for their second gig.

videos.title: Interracial
videos.overview: Helena Wellesley, a British woman, is desperate to reclaim her grandfather’s infamous painting at an auction. After arriving in India, she seeks the help of gangster twins, Johnny and David, to convert dollars to rupees illegally. However, she loses all the money to a mysterious gang. Later, TOP and his team attack Helena.

videos.title: The Wrong One
videos.overview: Kalki, a religious politician, faces the heat from various feminist organisations for proposing to restrict modern outfits for women. Helena, who's upset for not getting hold of the painting, joins hands with David and the 'TOP'less team to steal the painting. However, an unexpected situation awaits the 'TOP'less gang.

videos.title: The Cleavage
videos.overview: Kalki reveals the truth of the Topless painting, created by the British painter, Richard Wellesley. In the meanwhile, BASE continues to be held captive at Kalki's house. His team members, LEFT and RIGHT, make a plan to rescue him. In the meanwhile, David gets mortally wounded.

videos.title: The Blue Ball
videos.overview: BASE strikes a deal with Kalki and agrees to help him find the painting. In the meanwhile, Johnny comes in search of his dead twin and meets Kalki. The duo strikes a quick deal, thanks to LEFT and RIGHT. On the other hand, Helena gets frustrated as she still does not have the painting.

videos.title: Gangbang
videos.overview: As the situation intensifies, LEFT and RIGHT head towards Kalki's house to return the painting and rescue BASE. On the other hand, Helena swings into action to get hold of the painting. Amidst all this drama, a shocking truth unfolds.

videos.title: Finding Virgin Mary
videos.overview: Kamakshi is entrusted with the responsibility of hunting down the international bootlegger, Furkin, known for smuggling the 'Virgin Mary' artifact from a museum in Paris. In the meanwhile, Interpol agent and Kamakshi's partner, Karoline, land in Pondicherry for a vacation.

videos.title: "French Toast(ed)
videos.overview: Kamakshi discovers that Karoline has been arrested by the police. The police agree to release Karoline in one condition. Karoline and Kamakshi are to pair up and find the drug lord, Furkin and locate the Virgin Mary!

videos.title: Liar, Liar!
videos.overview: Karoline traps Old Monk, Furkin's partner. However, Kamakshi fails at catching hold of Old Monk and he manages to escape. Karoline and Kamakshi develop disputes and start hating each other.

videos.title: Pants on Fire!
videos.overview: Later, Kamakshi finds Old Monk but shoots him by mistake. Meanwhile, Furkin's new partner, Vikram, locates Karoline and Kamakshi and starts chasing them.

videos.title: Drunken Brawl
videos.overview: Furkin's men start chasing Karoline and Kamakshi but the two manage to escape. The two head to the club and Kamakshi gets drunk on alcohol. In the meantime, Furkin and his men reach the club and Kamakshi shoots Furkin!

videos.title: Secret Service
videos.overview: Furkin's men try to hunt down Karoline and Kamakshi. Karoline is informed about Furkin's men trying to chase them. Karoline and Kamakshi reach a safe place.

videos.title: Live and Let Die
videos.overview: Furkin's men find the hideout and reach the spot where Karoline and Kamakshi have been hiding. On the other hand, Furkin learns about the informer, Devaraj and kills him.

videos.title: A Botched Mission
videos.overview: The sniper captures Karoline and Kamakshi and shoots Vikram. Karoline and Kamakshi manage to escape from the sniper but get caught in Kunjumohan's search activity. On the other hand, Furkin kills Victoria when he comes to know she was a traitor.

videos.title: Deal with the Devil
videos.overview: Karoline and Kamakshi continue with their mission after escaping from the cops. They also track Furkin's location and ask Chidambaram for his help for additional force.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: As the battle to recover the Virgin Mary continues in full swing, a high voltage fight takes place between Karoline, Kamakshi, and their teams against Furkin’s notorious gang. Who wins the battle?

videos.title: Vara Vendiya Nerathula Correct Ah Varuven
videos.overview: An ardent Rajnikanth fan, postman Raja skips his duty of delivering the last eight letters and goes to watch Rajini’s latest release. Later that evening, he meets with an accident and slips into coma. When Raja wakes up after 23 long years, he remembers about those undelivered letters and gets on to his bicycle to deliver them. His daughter, Rajini, joins him.

videos.title: Ketta Payyan Sir Indha Kaali
videos.overview: In 1995, Rishi posts a suicide letter for his mother. In the meanwhile, Santosh, a man in his 40s, kidnaps two older men. When Raja finally delivers Rishi's letter, his mother hands it over to Santosh, unaware that Santosh is wanted by the cops. What will Santosh do? When Raja realises that he's in a trap, will he manage to escape?

videos.title: Pera Ketta Odane Chumma Adhurudhula
videos.overview: The second letter that Raja has to deliver is to scientist Dr. Isaac. The letter is written by Dr. Issac's wife who leaves him for his negligence when he fails to take care of her while she is pregnant. What happens when Raja and his daughter Rajini take the letter to Dr. Isaac who's now old and has developed a dissociative personality disorder? Incidentally, Rajini tells Raja that she is adopted and seeks information about her real parents. Raja, unable to recover any information, passes out.

videos.title: Thirumbi Vanthuten Nu Sollu
videos.overview: In 1995, Anitha writes a letter to Dr. Chandrasekar. When Raja and Rajini deliver the letter to him, he gets nostalgic about his time with Anitha. He remembers his college days, their love, and how she broke up after she was diagnosed with brain tumor. After hearing his story, Rajini and Raja help Chandrashekar attend his college reunion and meet Anitha.

videos.title: Kettavangalukku Neraya Koduppan Aana Kai Vittuduvaan
videos.overview: Twenty-three years ago, before Raja became unconscious, Sameer and Vidya had applied for a divorce, leaving their son with Vidya's brother Dr. Vishwa. Later, their son died of a seizure attack. When Raja meets Sameer after he regains his consciousness and hands him the pending letter, Sameer realises that it's from his son. He goes into a state of shock after reading it.

videos.title: Yemaatharavana Vida Yemaravan Thaan Muttal, Na Yemandhutten
videos.overview: Raja and Rajini take the next letter to John. After reading it, John reveals that it's a letter from his father who wanted to meet him one last time. In the meanwhile, Rajini notes the ‘from' address and visits the old age home where John's father lived. To their surprise, John has already reached there. The caretaker informs John that his father has passed away, and hands him a bag full of money that his father had left behind. The caretaker also reveals a story that John’s dying father had told him, and that makes John and Raja feel a deep sense of guilt.

videos.title: Nallavangala Sodhippaan Aana Kai Vida Maattan
videos.overview: Vishal, the person to whom the sixth letter is addressed to, is agitated upon reading the letter since it was the answer to his search for his lost family. As Vishal prepares to leave for Coimbatore to follow up on the letter, Rajini and Raja accompany him.

videos.title: Natpu Na Enna Nu Theriyuma?
videos.overview: Ibrahim and Ravishankar, two best friends, used to communicate through letters after they were seperated in their childhood. Raja finds one such undelivered letter with him. When he and Rajini set out to deliver the letter, they discover that the person the letter is addressed to has grown very old!

videos.title: Kedaikuradhu Kedaikkama Irukkaadhu Kedaikaama Irukardhu Kedaikkadhu
videos.overview: In 1995, a man explains to his four sons the philosophy of not desiring another person's possession by citing the 'Thirukural' poem as an example. When Raja finds a letter addressed to Mr. Sakthivel, he and Rajini reach the location to hand over the letter to him. Instead, the letter is received by his brother, Mr. Rajavel. But the contents of the letter force Raja and Rajini to set out on a path to find Mr. Sakthivel.

videos.title: Katham Katham
videos.overview: Rajini and Raja have now delivered all the eight letters but the duo still needs to resolve a mystery from one of the letters. When Raja tries to do this, it turns out to be the most emotional moment for Rajini. What letter is this and will Raja, the postman, be able to solve the mystery?
