videos.title: The Awakening
videos.overview: Shankar, a small-time smuggler challenges his boss Ramajayam, who is involved in the business of bootlegging. With the help of police officer Kathiravan, Shankar succeeds to ditch Ramajayam and hands over the liquor to Vinayagam. Shankar comes across Chandrika, a cabaret dancer, and fights with the goons who try to misbehave with her. Chandrika gets impressed with Shankar and they fall in love.

videos.title: The Power Game
videos.overview: During Aasaithambi’s party, Ramajayam has a tiff with the minister. Kathiravan guides Shankar to take advantage of the situation and conquer Ramajayam and Reddy's business. When Aasaithambi who comes to rescue Ramajayam and Reddy at the police station, Shankar insults him. Shankar takes control over the city's entire illicit liquor and brothel business

videos.title: The Rise of the Demon
videos.overview: Shankar, who has fallen in love with Chandrika, ill-treats his wife Sumathi. When the situation becomes worse, Sumathi leaves the house. Sudalai advises Shankar to be careful with Chandrika but he does not bat an eye. Meanwhile, Kathiravan visits Shankar as he fears of losing his power over Shankar.

videos.title: The Wolf Hunter
videos.overview: Sudalai shows Chandrika’s picture to the minister who gets tempted to spend a night with her and requests Shankar to arrange for it. When Shankar denies his request, the minister uses his power against Shankar. Kathiravan advises Shankar to fulfill the minister’s demand. When Shankar finds out that Sudalai was behind this, he decides to kill him.

videos.title: The Seed of Chaos
videos.overview: When everything gets into its place and Shankar's men are released, Ramajayam sends his men to destroy Shankar's brothel. An enraged Shankar picks up Ramajayam’s man Govindharaj, kills him and buries him in the walls of his house.

videos.title: The Balancing
videos.overview: When an inspector comes to investigate about Reddy’s death, people show their support for Shankar. When Govindharaj’s widow comes to complaint about Shankar, Kathiravan tries to ignore her. During Shankar’s birthday, Kathiravan comes and expresses his interest in Chandrika. This irks Shankar and kicks him out of the house.

videos.title: Clean Slate
videos.overview: When Thalaivar demands to sleep with actress Kamnini, Shankar refuses to fulfill his wish. Meanwhile, Shankar gets to know about the Babu and Lalitha betraying him and loses his cool and goes on a killing spree. He kills all of them and buries them in his house. However, Babu manages to escape and save his life.

videos.title: Fall of the Demon
videos.overview: Due to the pressure from the Governor, Govindharaj’s case gets transferred to CBI. Kathiravan brainwashes Babu and convinces him to become approver. The police reach Shankar’s house and gather proof against him.

videos.title: The Rebirth
videos.overview: During his time in prison time, Shankar gets a few inmates to help him plan his escape. Shankar falls in love with Devi, wife of a fellow inmate, and includes her in his plan. With the help of Jayavel Shankar escapes from prison.

videos.title: The Conclusion
videos.overview: After escaping from the prison, Shankar gets hold Kathiravan but he leads Shankar to Babu and escapes. Shankar confronts Babu and later escapes to Odisha to hide at his father's house but eventually gets caught. Shankar is sent to back to prison where he meets his fate.

videos.title: The Sugar
videos.overview: With the firing chaos in ‘Bawa Lodge’, the mystery starts with the introduction of Theresa who has been transferred for the 25th time to the vast drug trafficking city of Chennai. Meanwhile people stuck indifferent situations are introduced

videos.title: The Host
videos.overview: Deva gets introduced as an arrogant beast. An advocate fighting for proper judgment to shut down the corrupt industry, two struggling villagers who are trying their luck, a doctor and his loneliness and an ambitious PT teacher who plans to arrange money to build the unsteady school building by sending students to a reality show are introduced.

videos.title: Fortune and Failure
videos.overview: Aadhira finds excess of sulphuric acid in Century Copper factory and fights for justice. Two villagers travel to Chennai to cash in their fortune. Theresa gathers details about Deva to attack him for ceasing the drug trade.

videos.title: No Vacancy
videos.overview: Situations make people enter the dusty and blood shedding web of the ferocious drug lord Deva. Simultaneously agenda for destroying the well webbed trap of drug lord has been drawn out.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Deva gets clue about snitchers inside his territory and Theresa plans the first step to trap Deva inside his own territory.

videos.title: The Collision
videos.overview: Background filled with dreadful betrayal and blood shedding action runs in Deva's mind. Messed up with assumptions and threats, Deva traps all people inside 'Bawa Lodge'.

videos.title: The Weave
videos.overview: Ambiguity increases inside Bava Lodge after warnings arise from Police.

videos.title: The Awakening

videos.title: Meet The Devil
videos.overview: Special unit inspector Thanigai assures Savitri, the tribal women, that her daughter will be soon be found. Thanigai later has a secret meeting with Solomon, a flesh trade kingpin, which is discovered by Inspector Andrea. Read Less

videos.overview: Thanigai takes charge of his special unit but Savitri’s words continue to haunt him. During his birthday, Thanigai visits the temple with his family, where Savitri is already present. What is Savitri upto?

videos.title: The Clock Starts Clicking
videos.overview: Thanigai is now confused and wants answers but as he searches for answers, more questions await him. The only difference is that now even time is against him.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: Malini is in the hospital and Thanigai is desperate to seek revenge, however, the Commissioner asks him to remain calm. Thanigai comes up with an idea to trace Bhupati.

videos.title: Cleansed By Fire
videos.overview: Attack is the best defence. Thanigai and his team set out to find clues and discover some shocking truths. They decide to burn down the place where girls are tortured.

videos.title: Guilt Trip
videos.overview: When Thanigai’s sister is troubled by gangsters, he fears for her life. Thanigai undergoes a transformation and feels guilty of his corrupt deeds and promises to do what is right. Meanwhile, Solomon and Bhupathi have a meeting to clear their misunderstandings.

videos.title: A Fresh Approach
videos.overview: Thanigai and his team set out to channelize all their energy to find Chelli. The team reaches the beach from where Chelli was kidnapped and make a fresh start of investigating the case. The investigation point towards Solomon.

videos.title: Two Can Play A Game
videos.overview: After his colleague is killed, Thanigai gets furious and comes up with a new plan to eliminate his enemies. He joins hands with Bhupathi and targets Solomon’s gang members.

videos.title: Unholy Pact
videos.overview: Thanigai discovers that Commissioner and Solomon are partners and he needs to come up with a new plan to eliminate his enemies. Thanigai uses the media to his advantage and makes a pact with Bhupathi.

videos.title: Time Up
videos.overview: As the clock ticks, Thanigai meets his nemesis but this time he is outnumbered. Will Thanigai’s plan workout or would be he become a victim himself.

videos.title: Lion Vs Wolf
videos.overview: After eliminating all the enemies, Thanigai is rushed to the hospital, where Chelli and her mother visit him. Chelli’s mother reveals the truth to Thanigai which shocks him. Thanigai must now decide if he wants to live his life like a cunning wolf or a fearless Lion.

videos.title: The Dead Jester
videos.overview: During an altercation, a 24-year-old Mahati accidentally kills her husband, Ram, and seeks the help of her boyfriend, Indrajith, to dispose of the body. However, trouble begins when the girl’s parents come to her house. She must now hide the dead body and her boyfriend.

videos.title: King of Smiles
videos.overview: Mahati desperately wants her parents to leave so she can dispose of Ram’s body with Indrajith’s help. However, a new problem, that can put her into deeper trouble, is waiting to descend upon her.

videos.title: Mr. Lipstick
videos.overview: Mahati and Indrajith dump Ram's body but panic when they see police officers patrolling the area. They manage to escape but are troubled by the thought that they may have left behind some clue.

videos.title: Snicker Me Not
videos.overview: Ram’s parents arrive and end up having an argument with Mahati’s parents. Meanwhile, the search for Ram intensifies triggering extreme paranoia in Mahati. A shocking videotape surfaces and gives a new twist to the story.

videos.title: Smile! Or I'll Shoot!
videos.overview: Mahati and Indrajith are shocked when they hear the truth from the mystery man. They need to come up with a new plan to shift the blame on others and escape punishment.

videos.title: Dimple Kapadia
videos.overview: While Ram’s parents take the help of a police officer to solve the case, Mahati also tries to negotiate a deal with him. Later, the police officer calls all of them to a mortuary to identify a dead body.

videos.title: Laughing Stock
videos.overview: It is revealed that Mahati’s father discovered the truth about Ram on the day of their marriage but chose to remain silent. When Mahati comes to know of this later, she is infuriated and decides to teach him a lesson. But before she can do this, Indrajith messes up big time.

videos.title: Smile Please
videos.overview: After a long and intense standoff between Mahati and her father, she inflicts the perfect revenge on him for all his misdeeds towards her.

videos.title: Off to the Village
videos.overview: Witness some surprises and a lot of drama when 12 sophisticated beauties turn themselves into absolute Village Belles, living a life of minimal comforts

videos.title: Game Starts Now!
videos.overview: Rio and Andrews introduce the participants. Later, the game begins with a bang when the contestants are asked to pack the bags and bid goodbye to their loved ones.

videos.title: Girls Get a Grand Welcome
videos.overview: The contestants begin their journey by following the map to the village where they get a grand welcome by the community. Later, Host Andrews introduces them to everyone.

videos.title: Contestants Cook for the Villager
videos.overview: Experiencing a completely different habitat, the contestants come across some sweet surprises, fears and emotional moments. They also perform rituals and cook for the villagers.

videos.title: Mahalakshmi in the House
videos.overview: Contestants settle into their new house with lots of joy and happiness. With the entry of two new contestants and a new Mahalakshmi, looks like the real game has finally begun

videos.title: Drama Galore
videos.overview: Akshara, the first Mahalakshmi in the house, gets the girls working for money. Later, conflicts and arguments arise between the contestants after a hard day earning for the food.

videos.title: Girls Turn Farmers
videos.overview: The contestants learn the value of crops and farming when they enter the field for the task. Later, they get paid by the real farmers for their amazing work in the field.

videos.title: Time for Elimination
videos.overview: The contestants fight each other in a task to become the next Mahalakshmi. Later, the village panchayat announces the candidate who gets eliminated from the show. Who is it?

videos.title: Fight for Being Mahalakshmi
videos.overview: The competition gets tougher as the girls take one step further to prove their abilities in being the next Mahalakshmi. Later, a dear contestant gets eliminated from the show.

videos.title: Work Till You Drop
videos.overview: The contestants visit a Banana plantation for their next task. Things get a little out of hand, but the spirits remain high. Later, Elimination round brings more drama into the house.

videos.title: Soundarya, the Next Mahalakshmi
videos.overview: Soundarya wins the Mahalakshmi post with her amazing performance during the task. Later, the girls leave everyone in shock when they perform Silambattam for the crowd.

videos.title: Sanam on the Blacklist
videos.overview: City girls give their best in cooking the traditional village savouries as their new task. Later, Andrews conducts the nomination round in which Sanam falls on top of the blacklist

videos.title: Karagam for the Audience
videos.overview: The audience are left in awe when the contestants perform a traditional Karagam dance in the panchayat. Later, girls nominate Sanam to be their next Mahalakshmi.

videos.title: Contestants Give Their Best
videos.overview: Girls face an exciting and a competitive environment with the stunning tasks assigned by Host Andrews. From painting the houses in the village to a game of confessions, the contestants face quite a few challenging hurdles to reach the safe zone.

videos.title: The Fight to Be Mahalakshmi
videos.overview: Drama runs high as girls compete in two groups to select the next Mahalakshmi of the house. Later, the village panchayath declares the eliminated contestant. Who is it?

videos.title: A Visit to the Handloom Industry
videos.overview: The girls learn to weave saris and the importance of art and hard work that goes into the handloom industry. Later, the contestants convince the girls in the village to be their partners in the fashion show

videos.title: On the Ramp
videos.overview: Prepare to be amazed as the city queens swap their styles with the village belles and walk the ramp to steal our hearts.

videos.title: Belles Learn to Climb Trees
videos.overview: Host Andrews makes life harder for the girls with his new task, coconut tree climbing. Later, a major conflict arises between Meenakshi and Shilfa. Why?

videos.title: The Boss Girls
videos.overview: Girls get to be the boss for a day and pay the villagers for the odd jobs done for them. Later, the girls face heat when the village panchayath meets for their next elimination process.

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: Brace yourself for a spooky ride as the contestants visit a haunted house for their latest task. Who will make it out fine?

videos.title: Competition Gets Tougher
videos.overview: Clashes between the contestants during the elimination process raises the heat in the house. Andrews conducts a wrestling competition for the girls as a decider for the safe zone.

videos.title: Groom Hunting
videos.overview: Andrews stages an alliance meet for the contestants. With the potential grooms like Rio Raj, TSK and other small screen stars in the house, the contestants perform their best to impress them.

videos.title: What a Challenge!
videos.overview: The contestants get positive feedback from small screen celebrities, thus boosting their morale and confidence. Later, they face an advantage task that puts their mind and body to work.

videos.title: Mega Task for the Contestants
videos.overview: Misunderstandings and conflicts arise in the house when Andrews conducts the nomination round. Later, like never before, Andrews comes up with a mega task that can help the contestants rise to the top of the list.

videos.title: The Grand Finale
videos.overview: As the competition reaches the culmination, Host Andrews announces the winner from the top 5 contestants of the show. The rest of them receive a token of appreciation for their best and outgoing qualities.

videos.overview: After the plan goes horribly wrong, Ganesh and Michael are forced to deal with its repercussions. Meanwhile, Rangarajan confides in his sister, Vasantha, about the situation.

videos.title: Indigo
videos.overview: While Rangarajan seeks the help of a spiritual counsellor to “cure” Ganesh, Vasantha speaks Rangarajan. He finally succumbs to pressure and agrees to meet Karthik.

videos.title: Turquoise
videos.overview: It is Ganesh’s birthday and Karthik stops by at his house to meet the family. Karthik and Rangarajan have an awkward meeting and Vasantha persuades Rangarajan to let go of his ego and respect Ganesh’s choice.

videos.title: Pink
videos.overview: Rangarajan has a change of heart and accepts his son’s same-sex relationship. Ganesh continues to play gay and begins to enjoy Karthik’s company.

videos.title: Orange

videos.title: Meet The Sufferers
videos.overview: Here are four stories of love and hate. There's a divorcee, head-over-heels in love with his chirpy daughter; a couple living-in together, much in love, and much against the idea of marriage; a married-and-ready-to-bite-off-each-other's-heads couple, and finally there is the pair that defines 'being in love'.

videos.title: Suffering From Chaos
videos.overview: Meera and Santosh ruin the wedding announcement by crashing their car into the bar counter leaving bride-to-be, Tanvi disappointed. Just when Tanvi's bestie Divya and to-be-fiancé, Ragav try to mellow down the mess, new secrets are revealed.

videos.title: Suffering From Chronic Fighting
videos.overview: On spilling the beans about their live-in relationship, Badri and Divya get cornered by the rest of the gang. Ragav, Santosh and Meera instigate them by creating situations to pick a fight. Will the perfectly happy couple take the bait?

videos.title: Suffering From Perfection Deficiency
videos.overview: Ragav confesses on how hard it is to be the 'perfect boyfriend', while Tanvi still unaware of this, is living in her own bubble of an ideal relationship. Divya knows a big secret and is conflicted about telling Tanvi.

videos.title: Suffering From External Problems
videos.overview: Meera pulls the disinterested Santosh for a marriage counselling session. That the cousellor turns out to be an uber hot lady, is just an aside. An important aside! Badri faces his biggest fear and Ragav-Tanvi broach 'The Topic'.

videos.title: Suffering From High Expectations
videos.overview: Badri's worst nightmare comes true as he tries his best to impress Divya's father. Tanvi and Ragav hire a candid photographer who is a bit too nosy, while Santosh sets off to his audition for a big movie director.

videos.title: Suffering From Pressure To Perform
videos.overview: Meera sabotages Santosh's important audition. Tanvi and Ragav finally break their one big rule of 'saving for D-day'. Smriti is disappointed with her grades, while Divya is antsy and anxious about her dad's approval of Badri.

videos.title: Suffering From Dependency
videos.overview: Balakumar is all jittery as he is going on a date. Meera and Santosh are on a nostalgia trip… travelling separately, of course! Divya awaits her father's verdict on Badri, while Badri doesn't seem to care.

videos.title: Suffering From A Secret Overdose
videos.overview: It's the day of the pre-engagement party and all hell breaks loose. All secrets are unraveled, leading to chaos and drama.

videos.title: Suffering From Kadhal
videos.overview: The truth is out there. There's confusion, heartache, anger, despair… and hope.

videos.overview: Meera and Santosh ruin the wedding announcement by crashing their car into the bar counter leaving bride-to-be, Tanvi disappointed. Just when Tanvi's bestie Divya and to-be-fiancé, Ragav try to mellow down the mess, new secrets are revealed.

videos.title: Suffering From Chronic Fighting
videos.overview: On spilling the beans about their live-in relationship, Badri and Divya get cornered by the rest of the gang. Ragav, Santosh and Meera instigate them by creating situations to pick a fight. Will the perfectly happy couple take the bait?

videos.title: Suffering From Perfection Deficiency
videos.overview: Ragav confesses on how hard it is to be the 'perfect boyfriend', while Tanvi still unaware of this, is living in her own bubble of an ideal relationship. Divya knows a big secret and is conflicted about telling Tanvi.

videos.title: Suffering From External Problems
videos.overview: Meera pulls the disinterested Santosh for a marriage counselling session. That the cousellor turns out to be an uber hot lady, is just an aside. An important aside! Badri faces his biggest fear and Ragav-Tanvi broach 'The Topic'.

videos.title: Suffering From High Expectations
videos.overview: Badri's worst nightmare comes true as he tries his best to impress Divya's father. Tanvi and Ragav hire a candid photographer who is a bit too nosy, while Santosh sets off to his audition for a big movie director.

videos.title: Suffering From Pressure To Perform
videos.overview: Meera sabotages Santosh's important audition. Tanvi and Ragav finally break their one big rule of 'saving for D-day'. Smriti is disappointed with her grades, while Divya is antsy and anxious about her dad's approval of Badri.

videos.title: Suffering From Dependency
videos.overview: Balakumar is all jittery as he is going on a date. Meera and Santosh are on a nostalgia trip… travelling separately, of course! Divya awaits her father's verdict on Badri, while Badri doesn't seem to care.

videos.title: Suffering From A Secret Overdose
videos.overview: It's the day of the pre-engagement party and all hell breaks loose. All secrets are unraveled, leading to chaos and drama.

videos.title: Suffering From Kadhal
videos.overview: The truth is out there. There's confusion, heartache, anger, despair… and hope.

videos.title: The Legend of Bhishma
videos.overview: The people of Hastinapur are attacked by Rakshasas. Bhishma comes to save the people. Later Shantanu comes to know from Ganga that Bhishma is his son and accepts him.

videos.title: Ambadevi Accuses Bhishma
videos.overview: At Ambadevi's Swayamvar Sabha, Bhishma defeats Raja Salva, who has been chosen by the princess as her future husband. Ambadevi feels devastated when Salva refuses to marry her after his defeat. She accuses Bhishma of humiliating her and demands that he marry her!

videos.title: Dhrithrashtra and Pandu are Born
videos.overview: Ambalika and Ambika mourn the demise of Vichitravirya. Both give birth to sons and Satyavati names them Drithrashtra and Pandu. Ambika feels dejected because her son, Dhrithrashtra is blind. Later, Amba Devi seeks justice from Parashuram.

videos.title: A Marriage Proposal for Gandhari
videos.overview: Parashuram challenges Bhishma to a fight. But Lord Shiva appears and stops them. To take revenge on Bhishma, Ambadevi is reborn as Shikandini, the daughter of King Drupad. Bhishma wishes to get Gandhari, the princess of Gandharadesham, married to Dhrithrashtra.

videos.title: Dritrashtra to Wed Gandhari
videos.overview: Subala agrees to get Gandhari married to blind Dritrashtara. Shakuni opposes this proposal. Meanwhile, at Hastinapur, Dritrashtra rejoices when he learns that he will be crowned king after his marriage to Gandhari.
